jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Roger is the operating system for dental clinics. We automate the workflows that dental teams shouldn't be doing manually – from treatment plans to patient communication to revenue optimization. We're early, well-funded, and moving fast. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who wants to own real problems, not just tickets.

Tasks

Profile & Experience

  • Senior-level with significant experience shipping and operating production systems
  • Track record of owning projects end-to-end: from concept through delivery to production
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Design, Data, and other stakeholders
  • Preferred stack: Ruby on Rails, Go, Dart/Flutter – but strong fundamentals matter more than specific languages

How You Work

  • You think beyond your own code – you understand business context, user needs, and product goals
  • You take ownership proactively and drive projects to completion without waiting for instructions
  • You communicate openly and clearly with stakeholders, technical and non-technical alike
  • You make decisions under ambiguity and escalate when it matters
  • You enable other engineers through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and raising the bar

Agentic Engineering Mindset

  • You use AI agents as a force multiplier – not a crutch. You orchestrate, review, and own the output
  • You write specs and plans before prompting. You know that skipping design thinking is where projects fail, not the AI
  • You review AI-generated code with the same rigor as any PR – if you can't explain what a module does, it doesn't ship
  • You test relentlessly. A solid test suite is how you turn an unreliable agent into a reliable system
  • Your fundamentals are strong enough to evaluate, correct, and improve whatever AI produces – architecture, security, performance
  • You understand the spectrum: you know when to vibe-code a prototype and when to apply full engineering discipline

Requirements

What We Expect

  • Own scope, timelines, and stakeholder alignment for your projects
  • Make and be accountable for technical decisions
  • Build and maintain broad context – know the system, not just your service
  • Continuously raise engineering standards: testing, documentation, CI/CD, observability
  • Actively shape how the team works with AI tooling – contribute to evolving our practices as the technology matures

Benefits

Why Roger?

  • A market worth billions that still runs on fax machines and phone tag. The opportunity is absurd
  • A team small enough that your decisions shape the product – not a committee's
  • Hard, interesting problems in a space most tech companies ignore
  • Engineers who care about craft – we argue about architecture, not politics
  • Competitive salary, equity participation, and solid benefits – we'll talk specifics in the process

Bist Du bereit, Teil unseres kleinen, leidenschaftlichen Teams zu werden und Deine Fähigkeiten einzusetzen, um die Möbelbranche zu verändern?

Worauf wartest Du noch? Mach den nächsten Schritt und werde Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte!

Aufgaben

  • Du versetzt Dich in unsere Kunden hinein und entwickelst verständliche und anschauliche Aufbauanleitungen, die den Aufbau unserer Möbel so einfach wie möglich machen.

Qualifikation

jobs.title: Media Buyer (m/w/d) Meta & Google
jobs.description:
Wir wachsen und suchen keine Unterstützung – sondern eine starke Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt und Kunden eigenständig nach vorne bringt.

Als Media Buyer (m/w/d) für die Plattformen Meta & Google wirst Du Teil unserer Performance-Marketing-Agentur in Kiel oder arbeitest Remote. Unser Fokus liegt auf dem Aufbauen und Skalieren von Online-Shops und der Lead Generierung. Wir arbeiten als Boutique Agentur, heißt, wir arbeiten nicht eine Anzahl an Kunden ab, sondern haben ausgewählte Kunden, für diese geben wir alles und nehmen uns die Zeit.

Wenn Du Dich für Social Media, Strategie und starke Creatives begeisterst, bist Du bei uns genau richtig. Die wöchentliche Arbeitszeit beträgt 40 Stunden.

Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und setzt nachhaltige Paid Social Strategien und Kampagnen auf Meta und Google und im besten Fall auch auf TikTok und LinkedIn um.

  • Du verantwortest ein mind. 6-stelliges monatliches Marketing Budget und triffst eigenständig Entscheidungen

  • Als Verstärkung unseres Teams hilfst Du bei der Planung und Umsetzung aller Performance-Marketing-Aktivitäten, sowie bei der Umsatzsteigerung und Kundengewinnung für unsere Kund*innen.

  • Du entwickelst Konzepte und erstellst Briefings für Creatives für unser Brand & Design Team sowie Content Creator*innen.

  • Du entwickelst beratend, strategisch und nachhaltig unsere Kunden. Sie sind Dein Daily Business, indem Du eigenverantwortlich die Qualitätssicherungs- und Monitoringprozesse steuerst und daraus die richtigen Handlungsempfehlungen ableitest.

  • Du bringst proaktiv neue Ansätze und Ideen ein, um bestehende Kanäle und Kund*innen weiter auszubauen und neue Kanäle zu erschließen.

Qualifikation

  • Mind. 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Performance Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Paid Social und mind. 100.000€ Adspend im Jahr verwaltet.

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Creative Strategy und Direct Response Ads

  • Du schaffst es, Dich schnell in neue Themengebiete einzuarbeiten, bist kommunikationsstark, handelst in hohem Maße kundenorientiert und verfügst über sehr gute analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten

  • Du arbeitest gerne Hands-on und setzt neue Maßstäbe, um die Qualität Deiner Arbeit stets zu gewährleisten

  • Du besitzt neben sicheren Deutsch- auch gute Englischkenntnisse

  • „No Bullshit!“, du bist in der Lage auch großen Kunden Ideen zu pitchen und diese zu führen.

Benefits

Diese Benefits sind für uns selbstverständlich:

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Je nach Skillset und Erfahrung zahlen wir dir ein Jahresgehalt von mind. 42.000€.

  • Mind. 2 Teamevents/Jahr + Workation

  • Steuerfreie Sachbezüge und Corporate Benefits

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich von Zuhause aus. Alternativ in unserem zentralen Büro in Kiel

  • Freie Zeiteinteilung: Hobbys, Familie, etc. sind genauso wichtig. Arbeite so, wie es für Dich am besten passt

  • 28 Tage Urlaub: Pro Jahr Unternehmensangehörigkeit gibt es einen Tag mehr

  • Du bekommst für Deinen Arbeitsplatz alles, was Du brauchst: Macbook, Monitor, Firmenhandy etc. Du kannst ihn Dir selbst zusammenstellen, damit du effektiv arbeiten kannst.

  • Ein hoch motiviertes Team, das jeden Tag Vollgas gibt und mit der gleichen Motivation sich die Zeit nimmt, Dir all ihr Wissen weiterzugeben

  • Kurze Kommunikationswege über Slack & Co.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Plattformen Meta & TikTok

  • Wir bilden Dich zum Experten für Social Media Advertising aus und stetig weiter. Zusätzlich hast du mind. 1.000€ Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr.

  • Teilnahme an fachbezogenen Konferenzen, Meetups und Kursen zur Weiterbildung - ohne geht es einfach nicht

  • Dir fehlt was? Sprich es bitte an!

Klingt spannend? Ist es auch!
Auf dich wartet ein Team aus 13 Personen die alle den Anspruch haben, das Maximum für jeden kunden aus den Accounts rauszuholen.

jobs.title: Business Recruiter, Foundation (G&A)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're looking for an experienced recruiter to join our Business Recruiting team and support hiring across Notion's Foundation (G&A) organization, including People, Legal, and Finance.

You'll partner closely with hiring managers and leaders to build thoughtful hiring strategies, navigate specialized searches, and bring exceptional talent to Notion. You'll thrive in this role if you're a hands-on recruiter who takes ownership, exercises sound judgment, and brings curiosity, creativity, and a solutions-oriented mindset to your work.

 

This role is based San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own full-cycle recruiting across People, Legal, and Finance, independently driving searches from intake and sourcing through assessment, offer, and close.

 - Build trusted hiring partnerships, developing a deep understanding of business needs, proactively communicating progress, and bringing solutions to hiring challenges.

 - Develop creative sourcing and talent strategies for specialized roles, using market research, talent mapping, and targeted outreach to engage exceptional candidates.

 - Deliver an exceptional candidate experience, building meaningful relationships and thoughtfully engaging candidates throughout the hiring journey.

 - Embrace new ways of working, thoughtfully leveraging AI and modern recruiting tools to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience supporting specialized or niche roles in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

 - Proven ability to independently source, assess, and close exceptional talent, including hard-to-find candidates.

 - Strong hiring manager partnership skills, with the confidence to advise, navigate tough conversations, and influence hiring decisions.

 - A proactive, solutions-oriented approach, using data, market insights, and sound judgment to overcome challenges and drive searches forward.

 - Excellent communication, organization, and attention to detail, with the ability to prioritize, navigate ambiguity, and deliver an inclusive, high-touch experience.

 - A collaborative, team-first mindset—we're all gardeners here—with curiosity and a willingness to experiment with AI and emerging tools to improve how we work.




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $170,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Sie haben schon einmal aus SAP-Auszügen und verstreuten Excel-Listen ein Datenmodell gebaut, mit dem ein Fachbereich wirklich arbeitet? Und Sie möchten Business Intelligence jetzt in einem Unternehmen von Anfang an aufbauen und Ihre Handschrift darin hinterlassen?

Über unseren Mandanten

Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis und macht BI und Analytics jetzt zu einem eigenen Thema.

Warum diese Rolle

Sie sind die erste Person, die BI und Analytics im Unternehmen verantwortet. Die Plattform ist gesetzt: Microsoft Fabric und Power BI, mit SAP als wichtigster Datenquelle. Die Datenbasis ist noch lückenhaft, und das Wissen über BI wächst in der Organisation gerade erst. Beides bauen Sie mit auf.

  • Weil Sie die BI-Landschaft von Anfang an prägen und Ihre Entscheidungen darin Bestand haben.

  • Weil Sie direkt an die IT-Leitung angebunden sind und Ihre Ergebnisse im ganzen Unternehmen sichtbar werden.

  • Weil in einer Aufbauphase Ausprobieren dazugehört und eine erfahrene IT-Leitung Ihnen dabei Rückhalt gibt.

Das sind Ihre Aufgaben

  • Sie bauen die BI-Landschaft auf Microsoft Fabric auf: Datenanbindung, vor allem aus SAP, Lakehouse oder Warehouse sowie Pipelines und Dataflows.

  • Sie entwickeln zentrale, wiederverwendbare Datenmodelle in Power BI, auf denen weitere Berichte aufsetzen.

  • Sie erstellen die ersten Basisberichte für die Fachbereiche.

  • Sie etablieren Report-Governance: Workspaces, zertifizierte Datenmodelle, Namenskonventionen, Berechtigungen und Deployment.

  • Sie machen Lücken in der Datenqualität sichtbar und bereinigen sie gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen.

  • Sie nehmen Anforderungen auf, holen die Beteiligten an einen Tisch und setzen Prioritäten.

  • Sie befähigen die Fachbereiche zu Self-Service mit klaren Leitplanken und zeigen den Kolleginnen und Kollegen, wie man einen Bereich und eine Analyse strukturiert.

Zur Einordnung: Ihr Schwerpunkt liegt auf Analytics und Engineering, also auf Datenanbindung, Datenmodellen, Berichten und Governance. Sie setzen selbst um und klären die Anforderungen direkt mit den Fachbereichen. Data Science und Machine Learning spielen in dieser Aufbauphase eine Nebenrolle.

Das bringen Sie mit

  • Ein Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, Statistik oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung

  • Fundierte Praxis mit Power BI aus zwei bis drei Jahren oder mehr: Power Query, DAX und Datenmodellierung

  • Erste Erfahrung mit Microsoft Fabric, etwa mit Lakehouse, Data Factory oder Dataflows Gen2, sowie sicherer Umgang mit SQL

  • Erfahrung im Auf- oder Ausbau von BI-Lösungen im eigenen Unternehmen, gern auch als einzige Person für das Thema in einem kleineren Haus

  • Freude daran, mit Fachbereichen Anforderungen zu klären und Wissen weiterzugeben

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit den internationalen Standorten

  • Von Vorteil: Verständnis von SAP-Daten (ECC oder S/4HANA) sowie Zertifizierungen wie PL-300, DP-600 oder DP-700

Das erwartet Sie

  • Eine Fachrolle mit voller Verantwortung für Ihr Thema und kurze Entscheidungswege

  • Arbeitsplatz im Großraum Kassel: Die Rolle lebt vom direkten Austausch, deshalb arbeiten Sie überwiegend vor Ort. Eintritt ab Anfang 2027.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, Bikeleasing und Weiterbildung, zum Beispiel für Microsoft-Zertifizierungen

Interesse?

Senden Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf mit Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestem Eintrittstermin.

WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion's mission is to make toolmaking ubiquitous—from wikis and documents to notes, tasks, and databases. Strong product intuition and user focus have driven adoption across organizations of all sizes. Millions of users now rely on Notion's building blocks to get work done.

As Notion scales, there's a unique opportunity to build the data foundations that help our product and company reach their full potential. You'll design and build reliable, trusted datasets that accelerate decision-making across product and business functions, directly impacting our roadmap and growth.

This role is based in our San Francisco Headquarters. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Define ETL processes and infrastructure to make data readily available across the company

 - Build core datasets as single sources of truth for product and business teams (product, marketing, sales, finance, customer experience, data science, operations, IT, engineering)

 - Partner with data scientists and stakeholders to understand their needs and design, build, and monitor pipelines that scale with our growing data

 - Implement automated workflows that reduce operational costs, define SLAs for timely data delivery, and democratize data through self-serve dashboards, discovery tools, and AI-enabled exploration

 - Self-starter who gathers high-impact needs from business partners, designs technical solutions, and communicates clearly about deliverables, timelines, and tradeoffs

 - 5+ years of experience as a data engineer building core datasets and supporting business functions, with a passion for analytics, data modeling, and solving complex problems

 - SQL expert, proficient with aggregation, window functions, UDFs, self-joins, and optimization techniques for writing correct, high-performance queries

 - Highly comfortable with object-oriented programming (Python, Java, Scala)

 - Expert at using AI and agent-based tools to accelerate data development for yourself and others, including defining guardrails, workflows, and context for safe, production-scale data work

 - Experience at a fast-scaling or SaaS company, with enthusiasm to contribute in such an environment (current Notion users especially welcome)

jobs.title: GTM Manager
jobs.description:
tl;dr

  • After 14 years in construction tech, Lea & Jonas are building the AI foundation for the construction industry

  • 6 of the 20 largest construction companies in the German-speaking region already rely on Kuro every day, representing over €40bn in combined annual construction volume

  • Construction has some of the most complex, unstructured data you can throw at an LLM. At Kuro, you can tackle some of the hardest problems in applied AI every day

  • Curious about the bigger engineering challenge? Explore the vision and open problems at kuro.build

About us

Lea and Jonas scaled two of Europe's leading construction tech companies - Capmo and alcemy - and saw firsthand the challenges holding the industry back. Now they're tackling the root cause: the 50% of construction work still lost to manual data handling.

Kuro is building the AI foundation for construction. We're reimagining how construction professionals get work done and make decisions by leveraging AI to augment back-office workflows and make core data accessible. We are not pursuing marginal improvements, but a step change for construction.

One year after launch, Kuro runs every day inside the back offices of DACH’s largest construction companies, which together build more than €40 billion a year. We automate their core workflows and help them make faster, better decisions.

We’re just getting started. The construction software companies that reached billion-dollar scale did it by owning core back-office workflows, and that’s where we already are. With AI, we believe the next category leader can be 10x bigger. We raised a €10M seed round to build it.

We are 15 people based in Berlin. You will join a group of technical ex-founders and builders who are ambitious and kind.

Learn more: Join Kuro - Berlin

The Opportunity

As GTM Manager, you'll play a key role in driving Kuro's commercial growth by generating new business opportunities, engaging prospective customers, and turning go-to-market initiatives into results. You'll be hands-on across the customer journey, from prospecting and building relationships to supporting POCs and transforming them into long-term customer relationships.

You'll work directly with our Founding GTM Manager to bring our go-to-market strategy to life, while collaborating closely with our Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams. Together, you'll strengthen our commercial activities, improve how we engage and convert customers, and help scale Kuro's go-to-market engine as the company grows.

What You'll Do

  • Drive top-of-funnel activities through prospecting, targeted outreach, lead qualification, and relationship building.

  • Manage and develop customer opportunities from first contact through product demonstrations, POCs, and commercial discussions.

  • Create compelling customer presentations, proposals, and business cases to support commercial conversations.

  • Maintain and improve CRM, pipeline reporting, and sales processes, including identifying opportunities for automation.

  • Work closely with the Founding GTM Manager to execute commercial initiatives, coordinate customer-facing activities, and share relevant market and product feedback.

Your Profile

  • 2–4 years of experience in business development, sales, account management, or a similar customer-facing GTM role, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology.

  • Proven hands-on experience in prospecting, outbound sales, pipeline generation, and managing customer relationships.

  • Strong commercial mindset and communication skills, with the ability to engage both business and technical stakeholders.

  • Technical curiosity and an analytical, structured approach to solving problems and identifying opportunities.

  • Proactive, highly driven, and execution-oriented, with strong organizational skills and the ability to take ownership in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • Fluent in German and English (more languages are a plus).

Why Kuro

You are joining Kuro when it matters most. The product is live, our customers are using it daily, but their journey with Kuro has only started, and you can shape it from the get-go. There is no playbook, the world is changing at an unprecedented speed, and you can shape how one of the most critical industries around the globe wins in this new era.

The process

  1. Talent Acquisition Call - Intro, fit, motivation & logistics (30 min)

  2. Impact Call: Deep dive & Get to know Product (45 min)

  3. Challenge: A time-boxed challenge (≤4 hours)

  4. Challenge review and deep dive (60 minutes)

  5. Final Culture Interview (45 Min)

jobs.description:

Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

As the CASS Oversight Manager, you are responsible for ensuring that client money and custody assets held by Upvest Securities are protected, segregated and accounted for in full compliance with the FCA’s Client Assets Sourcebook (CASS).

You will act as the primary day-to-day authority on CASS, bridging the gap between complex regulatory requirements, our operational processes, our client’s needs and our scalable investment API. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance, Client and Operations teams to ensure our client asset framework remains robust, evidenced and audit-ready, enabling Upvest to scale its financial infrastructure to millions of end-users while maintaining the highest levels of integrity and trust with regulators, clients, and partners.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the CASS oversight framework: Maintain and continuously improve Upvest's CASS risk assessment, controls matrix, policies and procedures across CASS 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10, providing clear guidance to the business on what is and isn't permitted.

  • Work with our B2B clients, sales and client impact teams to actively shape solutions and provide advice that enables Upvest to support engaging and accessible investing for millions of end users in a CASS compliant way.

  • Oversee reconciliations and client money calculations: Oversee daily client money calculations and internal and external reconciliations of client money and custody assets, ensuring breaks are investigated promptly, shortfalls are funded and root causes are addressed.

  • Manage breaches and regulatory reporting: Maintain the CASS breach register, assess materiality, drive remediation and support FCA notifications where required. Own the monthly CMAR submission and act as the primary contact for the annual CASS audit, closing out findings to completion.

  • Keep the CASS Resolution Pack live: Ensure the resolution pack is complete, current and retrievable within regulatory timeframes, and that it is updated whenever banks, custodians, key vendors or critical staff change.

  • Embed CASS into how we build: Partner with Product and Engineering teams to assess the client asset impact of new products, features and system changes, and to ensure our ledgers, payment flows and custody integrations do what the rules require by design.

  • Enhance governance and culture: Produce clear CASS MI for the board and risk committees, deliver CASS training across the organisation, and track FCA developments to assess their impact on Upvest.

  • Manage external relationships: Support due diligence and periodic reviews of banks, custodians, and maintain acknowledgement letters and mandate registers in the prescribed form. Feed into TISA and other appropriate forums to gain further industry insights.

What you bring:

  • Deep CASS Expertise: Thorough working knowledge of CASS 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10, including client money calculations, reconciliation methods, acknowledgement letters, resolution pack requirements and the SMCR context in which the SMF18 operates.

  • Hands-on Client Asset Experience: Several years in a CASS operations, oversight or audit role in practice or at a broker, platform, custodian or wealth manager, with practical experience of breach handling, CMAR reporting and CASS audits.

  • Regulatory Analysis Skills: Proven experience in interpreting FCA rules and guidance and translating them into clear actionable operational procedures and controls.

  • Stakeholder Management: Strong communication of regulatory requirements to internal and external stakeholders, including engineering and product teams, external auditors and third-party custodians and banks.

  • Self-Starter Mentality: A highly organised approach with the ability to work independently, prioritise appropriately, and thrive under pressure, particularly around reporting and audit deadlines.

Meet Siena

Siena is the Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns.

It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on.

The team

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.

If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading.

The Role

Siena is about to launch several products in quick succession, and we're not looking for someone to execute a brief well. We're looking for the person whose taste the rest of the company gets measured against: someone who can't look at a landing page without having an opinion, who'd rather kill a launch than ship something mediocre, and who has owned creative direction before, not just contributed to it.

This is a craft title, not a headcount title. You'll ship personally for the first year and set the bar for everyone who comes after, building toward a small internal agency (two to three people across design, motion, and content) that can brief, position, and launch without outside help.

What You'll Do

  • Own narrative and positioning across every launch. Design as strategy, not decoration

  • Own every artifact that goes to market: landing pages, launch video, decks, social

  • Own the design system, from v3 onward

  • Set the bar, full stop. If it ships under the Siena name, you made it or you signed off on it

Who You Are

The Bar: If you're missing any of these, this isn't the role for you.

  • Taste, above everything, with specific, defended opinions about what's good and why

  • A track record of owning creative direction, not just contributing to it. Agency or in-house, brand refresh or full launch, you've been the person whose call was final, not the one waiting on notes

  • AI as a working tool, not a threat to your taste. You've already built something with AI (an app, a prototype, a mockup) and want to get technical enough to ship a landing page yourself within a year. Anti-AI is disqualifying

Strong Signal: Not dealbreakers, but what separates a good hire from a great one.

  • Narrative thinking: you already have a point of view on how a brand like Siena should be positioned, not just how it should look

  • Range that travels. Your background doesn't have to be SaaS. Fashion, art, consumer brand, editorial: what matters is whether your taste holds up somewhere new

  • A pattern of shipping in chaos, not around it. Multiple launches in flight, feedback that moves in hours not weeks

Nice to Have: Bonus, not required.

  • Experience building or scaling a small internal creative team

  • Motion or video production skills alongside visual design

  • Direct, founder-facing creative leadership experience at another startup

Not a Fit If:

  • You need a creative director above you setting the vision, or a team to delegate to on day one

  • Your best work happens on a slow, considered, one-project-at-a-time pace

  • Too much scrutiny too fast doesn't sound exciting, it sounds exhausting

Why Siena?

Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.

Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.

A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.

A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one.

Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build.

Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we.

AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.

Our values

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback - both giving and receiving it - because they care more about getting things right than being polite.

They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.

Our approach to AI

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.

Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows.

At Siena, we're not just looking for people who can do a job. We're looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that's you, we look forward to your application.

How we hire

Description

Our quantum sensing technology is already operating in customer environments across United States, Asia and Europe. As our installed base grows and we move from first deployments to repeat orders, ensuring the reliability and performance of every system becomes increasingly important.

As our Global Service Specialist, based at our Munich HQ, you’ll be part of a rapid-deployment team that resolves complex and escalated technical issues across our worldwide installed base. You’ll step in where regional service teams and partners need deeper expertise, and support installations, commissioning, and repairs when situations require it.

You’ll work directly with leading semiconductor foundries, IDMs, and OSATs, ensuring our systems operate reliably and consistently meet their specifications. You’ll collaborate closely with our Engineering and Applications teams, combining technical problem-solving with a strong customer focus.

This is also an opportunity to help shape our global service function from an early stage, introducing the processes, tools, and standards that will support our growing international installed base.

 

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

 

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

 
 

What will you do

  • Act as the technical escalation point for regional service teams and distribution partners, resolving issues that require deeper system expertise.

  • Deploy rapidly to customer sites across Europe, the US, and Asia to resolve critical system issues and minimize downtime.

  • Support installation, commissioning, and qualification of our quantum sensing systems when required, working closely with our Munich-based engineering teams.

  • Perform advanced troubleshooting, calibration, and repairs across optical, laser, mechanical, electronic, and software subsystems.

  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues systematically, collaborating with Engineering and R&D when root causes go beyond service-level expertise.

  • Work closely with Field Application Engineers, who focus on measurement execution and customer applications, to ensure a seamless customer experience.

  • Support spare-parts planning and service logistics across the global installed base, ensuring critical parts are available for rapid response.

  • Document service activities, technical findings, and root causes, feeding recurring issues and improvement opportunities back into Product Development.

  • Build trusted relationships with customers and partners through clear technical communication and professional service in demanding semiconductor environments.

  • Help establish and continuously improve our global service processes, including escalation workflows, maintenance procedures, troubleshooting guides, and technical documentation.

 

What is expected of you

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in field service, service support, or equipment engineering roles, ideally with semiconductor, optical, laser, inspection, or metrology equipment.

  • A proven track record of resolving escalated or complex system issues that first-line service could not solve.

  • Strong practical troubleshooting skills across complex electromechanical systems, ideally combining optics, lasers, precision mechanics, electronics, and control software.

  • Experience working in semiconductor fabs, cleanrooms, or similarly demanding technical environments, with an understanding of relevant safety and operating procedures.

  • Familiarity with laser safety and interlocked systems, or willingness to complete the necessary technical and safety qualifications.

  • Experience with spare-parts management, service documentation, and ERP or service ticketing systems is an advantage.

  • A structured, independent, and solution-oriented approach to technical challenges, especially under time pressure.

  • Strong communication skills and a customer-focused mindset, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and build trust with customers, partners, and internal teams.

  • Willingness to travel internationally on a frequent basis, often at short notice, to support customers and partners across the US, Europe, and Asia.

  • Fluency in English. Other languages (e.g. German, Mandarin, Korean) are a plus.

  • A degree in Engineering, Physics, Mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent technical training and relevant practical experience.

 

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

  • Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.

  • Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

 

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

HEAD OF OPERATIONS JOB DESCRIPTION

About 1st Formations

At 1st Formations, we empower entrepreneurs to start, run, and grow their businesses with confidence.

Running a business shouldn’t be slowed down by company formation, statutory compliance, accounting, or payroll. From day one, these essentials should be seamless, reliable, and intelligently handled - freeing founders to focus on building and scaling.

We’re a leading UK provider of company formation and compliance services, building a modern, fully integrated technology platform that supports founders at every stage of their journey. Our platform brings together formation, compliance, accounting, payroll, and ongoing business support in one cohesive experience.

No stitched-together services.
No legacy workflows disguised as software.

Just a single, scalable platform built for ambitious founders who want to move fast, stay compliant, and grow with confidence.

Why Join Us Now?

You’ll be joining a business with strong momentum, clear direction, and real opportunity for progression.

● £18m annual revenue, including £9m ARR

● Over 1 million companies formed

The Role

We are seeking a commercially minded Head of Operations to drive day-to-day operational performance and execution excellence across 1st Formations and its associated business lines.

The Head of Operations is responsible for driving operational performance, alignment, and execution across 1st Formations' customer-facing operations and associated service lines. Key Responsibilities

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (AI/Data)
jobs.description:
About Codat

Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.

Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.

The Role

We're building the Advisory Intelligence Platform: Codat's client intelligence delivered inside the assistant a banker already uses (Microsoft Copilot first). Ask it anything about a client and it answers from the client's real books. Don't ask, and it still tells you what's changed, why it matters and what to do about it. Under it we're building the semantic layer, so every answer uses the same definitions, the signal layer that spots what's changed for a client, and the reasoning layer, a Codat-side LLM that turns those signals into advice. The first bank goes live this year. You'll be building the data and reasoning behind all of it.

This is a hands-on job for software engineers who want to build the systems a model reasons over, not configure a warehouse. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS. The product lives inside the AI assistant our clients already use, and we build it the same way: agents do the repetitive work, engineers do the hard parts. You'll build it and you'll run it. Nobody hands it over the wall once it's live. You'll also get a real say in where it goes next. That means making your case to engineers, product and the commercial team, and bringing them along with you.

What You'll Work On

  • The semantic layer. Measures, dimensions and definitions the model is allowed to use, so every answer it gives is the same answer. Yours to grow, persona by persona.

  • The signal layer. Detecting what's changed for a client and surfacing it before the banker asks. You'll be designing and building this.

  • The reasoning layer. A Codat-side LLM that turns signals into advice. Our calculations are the ground truth it reasons over. You own the calculations the model relies on, and the names, definitions and structure that let it pick the right one.

  • The agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers behind the assistant. What tools it has, how they're built, how they fail, and the evals that prove they work.

  • Everything from raw source data to the number the assistant quotes: the pipelines, services and data models, with the testing and observability to prove the number is right and the evals that catch the model quoting the wrong one.

You'll Probably Have

  • Built production systems from scratch, writing the code yourself rather than configuring managed services. You think about interfaces, failure modes and how the next person will change your code. If we ask about the hardest system you've built, you'll have a story ready.

  • Served data to an LLM and seen where it goes wrong: ambiguous definitions, poor retrieval, no evals. You know why "the model will work it out" isn't a data strategy.

  • Worked with data along the way, and liked it. You may never have been called a data engineer. You've built things that move, shape and serve data, and you know how they break, and how a model breaks on top of them.

  • Solid C#, Python or another backend language. Your code comes with tests, and you leave things tidier than you found them.

  • Depth in at least one of SQL, Spark, Databricks/Delta Lake, Dagster/Airflow/Temporal or dbt. Bonus if you've shaped any of them into something a model can query, through a metrics layer, metric views or an MCP server.

  • Time with CI/CD, Docker, cloud infrastructure (we're on Azure) and observability. Even better if you set them up for a team.

  • An interest in the business behind the data. If someone asks for a number the data can't support, you'll say so, and you'll build the guard-rail so the model says so too.

  • Treated your own workflow as something to engineer. AI has already taken over the repetitive parts of it, and you're the person others ask how to do the same.

How We Work

We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish.

There’s no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would. What we don’t want is anyone staying online late to prove a point.

Compensation: £90K – £110K • Offers Equity

At Unmind, we're here to create better mental health.

We believe mental health should be a source of strength, not struggle – for people, teams, and entire organisations.

We combine science, technology, and human care to help companies like Uber, Disney, Major League Baseball, and the NHS improve mental health and drive performance.

Now we’re looking for more brilliant people to help us do it.

🚀 Our Values

We’re building a company where ambition and empathy go hand in hand.

Outpace the rest – Move fast. Deliver excellence.

Stronger together – We go further, faster, together.

Client first – We win, when our clients win.

🌈 Inclusion & Belonging

We’re building a place where everyone feels seen, heard, and supported – and where difference is celebrated.

If you need adjustments during the process, tell us when you apply or email Learn more about how we hire and our commitment to equity in our Candidate FAQ →

🎯 The Role — Principal Information Security & Data Protection Officer

Working closely with Commercial, Engineering, Product and Legal to lead Unmind's Information Security and Data Protection programmes and act as Unmind's designated Data Protection Officer (DPO). We process health information at scale, so trust is central to what we offer. We're looking for a hands-on, senior individual contributor who can own both disciplines end to end and give the business clear, practical advice.

This role sets security and privacy requirements, advises and assures.

Overall responsibility for;

Information Security

  • the management of Information Security within the business;

  • maintaining ISO 27001:2022 and Cyber Essentials certification, chairing the ISMS Board and running the ISMS day to day – policies, risk management, controls, evidence and internal audits;

  • liaising with Engineering, Product and Data & AI on information security threats and vulnerabilities and recommending mitigations;

  • Information Security incident management and remediation;

  • managing the Application and Infrastructure penetration testing and vulnerability management process, tracking findings to closure;

  • leading AI governance operations, including the AI policy and register, AI use-case risk reviews and readiness for ISO 42001;

  • managing the Information Security pre-sales, RFP and contractual process, and keeping trust materials in Conveyor current;

  • managing the business's security education and awareness training programme;

  • reporting information security compliance and risk to ELT and the Board.

Data Protection Officer

  • performing the statutory duties of the DPO under UK and EU GDPR, including acting as the contact point for the ICO and other data protection authorities;

  • maintaining Unmind's privacy framework, including privacy notices and retention;

  • advising on privacy for new products, suppliers and AI use cases, including coordinating DPIAs;

  • managing data subject rights requests and personal data breach assessments;

  • leading privacy review of DPAs and client assurance with Legal and Commercial, and reporting data protection risk to ELT and the Board.

🌟 About You

We know great people come from all sorts of backgrounds, and we want to make sure we’re focusing on what really matters. We welcome applications from people with different experiences and perspectives, while recognising that certain qualifications are essential for this role. You’ll find these outlined below.

ESSENTIAL:

  • Experience of implementing and maintaining ISO 27001 certification within a global technology business;

  • Expert practical knowledge of UK and EU GDPR, including DPIAs, rights requests, personal data breaches, and international transfers;

  • Experience acting as, or working closely alongside, a Data Protection Officer;

  • Confident client-facing presence, able to explain Unmind's data security and privacy approach clearly to prospective and existing clients;

  • Experience advising engineering and product teams on mitigation solutions for application and infrastructure security risks;

  • Sound understanding of AI-related security and privacy risks;

  • Ability to give clear, independent advice and challenge to senior leaders;

  • Commitment and attention to detail;

  • Able to manage multiple competing requests across the business, prioritising by risk and deadline;

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Credible and behaves with the highest levels of integrity.

DESIRED:

  • Experience with health or other special category data, or digital wellbeing products;

  • Experience in a high growth business environment;

  • Familiarity with ISO 27701 and ISO 42001;

  • A recognised security or privacy certification (such as CISSP, CISM, CIPP/E or CIPM), or equivalent practical experience.

Tip for candidates: If you’re unsure whether to apply – do. We know great people don't always tick every box.

Panteia is one of the Netherlands’ leading research and consultancy firms in the fields of transport, mobility and public policy. This is a senior leadership role focused on the co-ordination, execution and quality assurance of complex EU-funded transport and mobility projects (research and consultancy). The role is designed for an experienced EU consultant who excels in structuring delivery, steering teams, managing risk, and ensuring that projects meet the highest professional  standards. A job for a policy-driven expert who wants impact and autonomy.

The Principal Consultant EU transport and mobility holds end-responsibility for delivery performance across a portfolio of EU projects and acts as a senior point of contact for clients and consortium partners.

 

Key responsibilities

Project delivery & leadership

  • Lead and oversee the execution of EU transport and mobility projects, including corridor studies, evaluations, impact assessments and policy research.

Team & quality leadership

  • Steer and coach multidisciplinary project teams (internal consultants and external partners).

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal workflows, delivery standards and quality assurance processes.

The Principal Consultant plays a key strategic role in shaping delivery approaches during tenders and proposals:

jobs.description:
Embedded Staff Engineer - Help us build the Control System that the world can rely on. 

About Priva  

Your Future Ecosystem  

Located between Rotterdam and The Hague, in the heart of the world’s leading greenhouse region, lies Westland, home to Priva’s modern campus in De Lier. This innovative region has been the foundation of our family-owned company since the 1950s.  

 

What started as a hardware business has grown into a global leader in horticulture and building automation. Today, Priva develops advanced hardware, software, and digital services for climate control, energy efficiency, and water optimization. Our solutions support horticulture, indoor and city farming, as well as offices, hotels, hospitals, and retail environments worldwide.  

Our next ambition? Becoming a leading digital service provider with “Climate as a Service” solutions that help customers operate more sustainably.  

 

With over 600 colleagues, 16 international offices, and more than 400 installation partners, we deliver smart, sustainable solutions in over 100 countries. 

 

If you want your work to have impact on sustainability, food security, and the way cities grow, then this is where you belong.   
 

Why this role matters

At Priva, we are building the next generation of IoT-enabled building automation systems: cloud-connected, security-first, and designed for long-term reliability.

As a Staff Embedded Software Engineer (C++ / Linux), you will play a key role in shaping a scalable platform that combines embedded controllers, edge gateways, and cloud services. Your work ensures that buildings operate safely, efficiently, and reliably for 10-15 years with minimal maintenance.

This role goes beyond implementation. You will drive technical direction, influence software architecture, and support complex system design decisions across our platform.

Your role as Staff Engineer

You act as the bridge between software architecture and implementation, guiding teams in building a service-oriented, event-driven IoT platform consisting of 15+ services running on embedded devices.

You bring deep expertise in modern C++ (20+) and embedded Linux, and you help ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability across the system.

Your team

You will join our Alpha team, a group of highly experienced embedded software engineers and test engineers, working on cutting-edge building automation technology.

What you’ll do

  • Design and develop embedded software in modern C++ (C++17 or later) on Linux 

  • Build scalable, modular, and configurable control components 

  • Implement deterministic and real-time control strategies 

  • Develop robust 24/7 runtime systems for real-world environments 

  • Create simulation environments and automated test frameworks 

  • Contribute to software architecture and design decisions 

  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and quality gates 

  • Support application lifecycle management (ALM) 

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (hardware, cloud, QA) 


What you bring

  • 10+ years of experience in Embedded Software Engineering (C++ / Linux) 

  • Strong expertise in modern C++ (C++17 or later) 

  • Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and SOLID principles 

  • Experience with multithreading, concurrency, and performance optimization 

  • Experience with distributed or service-oriented systems 

  • Knowledge of communication protocols such as MQTT, CAN, Serial 

  • Experience working in resource-constrained environments (real-time systems) 

  • Ability to review, challenge, and improve architectural decisions 

  • Strong debugging and system-level problem-solving skills 

  • Experience working in cross-functional and international teams 

Nice to have

  • Experience in IoT, building automation, or industrial systems 

  • Familiarity with Node-RED or control systems 

  • Experience with Yocto, Docker, or containerized environments 

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices 

  • Experience with test strategies, automated testing, and system validation

 

What you get  
In numbers 

  • A competitive salary based on your experience; 

  • We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more; 

  • 8% holiday allowance; 

  • Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers. 

 

For your own sustainability 

  • Be secured with our pension plan; 

  • Feel engaged and join our participation plan; 

  • Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget; 

  • Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football.

Our values 
Priva's mission is to create an optimal environment where people can work, grow and develop. We offer worldwide solutions for horticulture and building automation. Our ambition is to be known as the leading technology and service provider for sustainable urban deltas. We are proud that our solutions result in lower consumption of natural resources and contribute to some of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). 
 
Our culture is built around our core values; sustainable, innovation, make it happen and human. In our latest employment survey, our colleagues mainly described our culture as: open, ambitious, innovative, friendly, committed, informal, flexible and down to earth. We aim to be a dynamic, fast-paced, flat and informal organization, where our colleagues have the space to grow and develop. 
 
We believe that to be successful, it is important to include people with different perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. Every day, we continue to build our open culture with people who are driven to turn our vision into reality, regardless of who they love, where they are from, or what they believe in. We encourage and celebrate people to voice their opinions and be their authentic selves. 
 
Apply 
Does this make you smile, and do you see yourself as our new Embedded Staff Engineer? Apply below or contact us for more information. We’ll get back to you within two weeks, we are keen to get to know you!

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner / Corporate Recruiter
jobs.description:
Talent Acquisition Partner / Corporate Recruiter

Are you an experienced Corporate Recruiter who enjoys building strong relationships with hiring managers, finding the right talent and continuously improving the recruitment process? Join our HR team in De Lier and help us attract the people who will contribute to Priva’s future.

 

For this position, we are looking for a Dutch-speaking Talent Acquisition Partner who lives within commuting distance of our office in De Lier, the Netherlands. Excellent communication skills in both Dutch and English are required.

 

At Priva, our HR team is close-knit, energetic and ambitious. We believe recruitment is about more than filling vacancies. It is about understanding the business, challenging hiring managers when needed, creating an excellent candidate experience and finding people who truly fit our organization and ambitions.

As our new Corporate Recruiter, you will focus primarily on non-technical and commercial vacancies, including roles within account management, customer support, fulfillment and other business functions.

You will have the freedom to take ownership of your recruitment portfolio while working closely with hiring managers, HR colleagues and other stakeholders across the organization.

 

Climate for growth

Priva develops innovative solutions for horticulture and building automation. Our technology helps customers create smarter, healthier and more sustainable environments while reducing the use of valuable resources such as energy and water.

 

Our ambition is to contribute to a world where people can live and work in healthy, comfortable and sustainable environments. We call this creating a climate for growth. We encourage our employees to take ownership, think entrepreneurially and continuously look for ways to improve.

 

How you add value as a Corporate Recruiter

As a Corporate Recruiter, you are a strategic recruitment partner for your hiring managers and responsible for the full recruitment lifecycle of the vacancies within your portfolio. You understand what the business needs, translate those needs into attractive and realistic candidate profiles and know how to reach the right talent. At the same time, you keep a sharp eye on recruitment quality, candidate experience and an efficient hiring process.

You will:

·       Manage full-cycle recruitment for primarily non-technical and commercial positions;

·       Partner with hiring managers and leadership to define profiles, recruitment strategies and selection criteria;

jobs.title: Stage Eventmanagement
jobs.description:
Stage Eventcoördinatie bij Priva

Ben jij georganiseerd, ondernemend en krijg je energie van events? Vind je het leuk om dingen te regelen, overzicht te creëren en ervoor te zorgen dat alles achter de schermen klopt? Dan hebben we bij Priva een stageplek voor jou.

Als Eventcoördinatie Stagiair(e) werk je direct samen met onze Event Manager aan het eventportfolio van Priva. Je bent dus niet alleen bezig met ondersteunende klusjes: je krijgt een actieve rol in de voorbereiding en uitvoering van verschillende events. Van de eerste planning tot de laatste materialen op de stand.

Wat ga je doen?
Samen met de Event Manager zorg je ervoor dat events soepel verlopen. Je houdt overzicht, pakt zelfstandig werkzaamheden op en zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen.

Denk bijvoorbeeld aan:

  • Meewerken aan de voorbereiding en planning van events;

  • Contact onderhouden met leveranciers en andere eventpartners;

  • Ondersteunen bij registraties, uitnodigingen en deelnemerscommunicatie;

  • Organiseren en beheren van eventmaterialen en promotiemiddelen;

  • Planningen en draaiboeken voorbereiden en bijhouden;

  • Offertes en praktische afspraken met leveranciers opvolgen;

  • Helpen bij de logistieke voorbereiding van events;

  • Meedenken over hoe we onze events slimmer en efficiënter kunnen organiseren;

  • Tijdens eventdagen zelf de handen uit de mouwen steken en verantwoordelijkheden oppakken.

Je zit niet alleen achter je laptop, maar ervaart hoe een event daadwerkelijk tot leven komt. Je werkt samen met de Event Manager, leveranciers, collega's en andere betrokkenen en krijgt steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid.

Tijdens je stage werk je toe naar een van de grootste events binnen Priva: GreenTech Amsterdam in juni 2027. Een event waar veel bij komt kijken en waar je vanaf de voorbereiding tot en met de eventdagen bij betrokken bent. Van planning en leverancierscontact tot materialen, logistiek en de uitvoering op locatie: je ziet letterlijk het resultaat van jouw werk terug op de beursvloer.

Na GreenTech 2027 zit jouw stage erop. Een mooie manier om je stageperiode af te sluiten én een event van formaat van dichtbij mee te maken.

Wie zijn wij?

Wij zijn Priva! Priva is een familiebedrijf, gevestigd in het Westland. Het is de missie van Priva om een ​​optimale omgeving te creëren waarin zowel planten als mensen kunnen werken, groeien en zich ontwikkelen. Wij bieden wereldwijde oplossingen voor de tuinbouw, gebouwautomatisering en alles daartussenin. Wij zijn toonaangevend in de ontwikkeling en productie van technologie voor het optimaliseren van omgevingsomstandigheden en processen.

Onze ambitie is om bekend te staan ​​als de toonaangevende technologie- en dienstverlener voor duurzame stedelijke delta's. We zijn er trots op dat onze oplossingen resulteren in een lager verbruik van natuurlijke hulpbronnen, zoals energie en water. Om onze missie en ambitie waar te maken, zijn we op zoek naar toegewijde collega's. We zijn er trots op dat we met ruim 500 collega's, in 16 internationale vestigingen verdeeld over 12 landen samen met meer dan 400 internationale installatiepartners werken aan het leveren van onze duurzame oplossingen en diensten in meer dan 100 landen.


Wat zoeken we in jou?
We zoeken geen student die afwacht tot er een taak wordt gegeven. We zoeken iemand die ziet wat er moet gebeuren en het leuk vindt om het te regelen. Iemand die creatieve ideeen heeft en durft voorstellen te doen.

Je:

  • volgt een mbo-, hbo- of vergelijkbare opleiding richting Eventmanagement, Leisure & Events, Marketing, Communicatie of Hospitality;

  • zoekt een meewerkstage en geen afstudeerstage;

  • bent vanaf februari 2027 beschikbaar;

  • bent georganiseerd en houdt ervan om overzicht te creëren;

  • Beheerst zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

  • vindt het leuk om met verschillende mensen en leveranciers te schakelen;

  • bent praktisch ingesteld en denkt graag in oplossingen;

  • durft vragen te stellen, maar kunt ook zelfstandig aan de slag;

  • vindt het leuk als geen dag precies hetzelfde is;

  • hebt interesse in zakelijke events, beurzen en marketing.

Ervaring met events is mooi meegenomen, maar enthousiasme, initiatief en organisatietalent vinden we belangrijker.

Wat krijg je ervoor terug?
Bij Priva krijg je geen stage waarin je vooral meekijkt. Je wordt onderdeel van het team en krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.

Je krijgt:

  • een afwisselende meewerkstage met echte verantwoordelijkheid;

  • directe begeleiding van een ervaren Event Manager;

  • de kans om meerdere events van dichtbij mee te maken;

  • ervaring met leveranciers, budgetten, planning en eventlogistiek;

  • een kijkje achter de schermen bij zakelijke events en internationale beurzen;

  • een stage waarin je kunt ontdekken waar jouw talenten liggen;

  • én natuurlijk een hele mooie eindstreep: GreenTech 2027.

Klaar om mee te organiseren?
Ben jij de student die liever regelt dan toekijkt? Die energie krijgt van een goede planning, blij wordt als alles op zijn plek valt en het leuk vindt om samen naar een groot event toe te werken?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer – Energy Optimization & Platform
jobs.description:
At Priva Energy, we build software systems that help customers manage and optimize energy in real-world environments, from greenhouses to buildings. You'll join one of our Energy Solutions teams (spanning Building Automation, Horticulture, and Energy Flexibility Trading), landing wherever the need is greatest at the time, and you'll also carry some responsibility for the cloud infrastructure and scalability that benefits teams beyond your own. 

You'll work at the intersection of three things: shipping features end-to-end in Priva Digital Services (touching both backend and, where needed, the front end), integrating optimization and forecasting logic into production services, and strengthening the cloud/DevOps foundation the whole department builds on. You don't need to be equally deep in all three, but you do need to be comfortable moving between them, and you should genuinely enjoy the connective, systems-level work of making things run reliably in production. 

 

Come Shape the Future of Sustainable Energy with Priva 

Priva Energy is working to become the leading global lifecycle partner for high-performing, sustainable buildings, horticultural operations, and energy distribution and management companies. Energy systems are transforming fast: grid congestion, dynamic pricing, decentralized production, and tightening sustainability regulation are reshaping what our customers need from us. Our Digital Twin and optimization technologies exist to meet that shift at scale, delivering measurable results such as lower energy intensity, greater flexibility and reliability, reduced operating costs, and structurally lower emissions. 

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll help turn that ambition into production reality: building the services, integrations, and cloud foundation that put our optimization and forecasting capabilities to work for customers every day. 

 

Your work will directly contribute to: 

  • Reducing and optimizing energy costs and emissions across Europe 

  • Enabling customers to participate in future energy flexibility and trading markets 

  • Optimizing multi-energy systems (heat, cold, electricity, storage, HVAC) 

  • Driving the transition toward autonomous, intelligent buildings and greenhouses 

  • Helping customers stay compliant with increasing regulatory pressure (e.g., CSRD) 

 

What You’ll Do 

Priva Digital Services & product engineering 

  • Design and build backend services that process data and execute optimization logic for products across Neo Heat, Neo Light, Neo Building, and Neo Smart 

  • Contribute to user-facing Priva Digital Services features end-to-end, including front-end work where it's the fastest path to shipping value 

  • Build and maintain APIs for internal and external integration 

Optimization & forecasting integration 

  • Implement and integrate optimization and forecasting logic into scalable, production-ready systems. You bring these models into production; you don't develop new optimization theory 

  • Work on data processing pipelines, scheduling logic, and system orchestration 

Cloud infrastructure & DevOps 

  • Own and improve cloud infrastructure (Azure) that supports scalability across Energy Solutions teams 

  • Strengthen CI/CD, monitoring, and deployment practices so systems are reliable, performant, and maintainable in real-world operation 

  • Collaborate with product, domain experts, and other engineers across teams to deliver end-to-end solutions 

  • Contribute to technical design decisions within your domain, and participate in the full software lifecycle: ideation → design → development → testing → deployment → monitoring 

 

What you will NOT do 

  • This is not a research or modelling role. You implement and integrate optimization and forecasting models rather than developing new theory 

  • You are not expected to be a dedicated front-end specialist or a dedicated DevOps specialist. The role spans these areas by design, so depth in every direction isn't the bar 


  • A bachelor's degree in an IT-related field 

  • Around 5 years of experience in a software engineering role, with demonstrated range across at least two of the following: backend/production systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end, or optimization integration. Versatility across these areas matters more here than deep tenure in a single one 

  • You've taken systems into production and kept them running, and can show or talk us through examples (work projects, open source, side projects) 

  • Experience with one or more of the following is a significant advantage: Python, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes/CI-CD tooling, SQL, KQL, Linux, and front-end frameworks (e.g., React/TypeScript) 

  • You are based in the Netherlands and are available to be in the office two to three days per week  

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to work with complex, unfamiliar systems 

  • A passion for creating customer value through high-quality engineering 

  • Curiosity, ownership, craftsmanship, and the drive to keep learning 

  • Good communication skills, able to explain trade-offs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders 

  • A good vibe: you bring energy to the team and make collaboration genuinely enjoyable, not just effective 

 

What We Offer You 

💶 Excellent remuneration, competitive and aligned with experience 

🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 extra at half price  

🏦 Excellent pension contribution  

🎓 €1,000 education budget per year  

⏰ Flexible working hours, and location.  

🍱 On-site canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2)  

🏋️ Free onsite gym- with personal trainer.  

🎉 A vibrant, open culture where you can be yourself  

🌿 Human- and values-driven work, not corporate bureaucracy  

🍻 Twice-weekly drinks on Thursdays and Fridays

Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters 

At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: 

  1. Physical/embedded device security.

Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. 

As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. 

What you will be doing 

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. 

 As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. 

  • Security standards, policies, and design patterns library 

  • Security architecture review process 

  • Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation 

  • Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register 

  • Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. 

  • Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies) 

  • Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape 

  • Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites. 

Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.  

To succeed in this role:
