jobs.title: Praksisorienterede undervisere til Center for Socialt Arbejde
jobs.description:
Er du socialrådgiver med både overbygning, praksiserfaring og undervisningserfaring, og drømmer du om at anvende din erfaring til at uddanne kommende socialrådgivere? Måske har din samlede erfaring også givet dig mod på at være med til at videreuddanne praksis? Så har du chancen nu, hvor vi i Center for Socialt Arbejde (CSA) søger undervisere. I CSA er vi i gang med at opbygge en ny uddannelse jf. uddannelsesreformens intentioner om praksisnærhed og et tættere samarbejde mellem studerende og undervisere. Da vi samtidig udvikler den samlede uddannelse samt efter- og videreuddannelse, har vi brug for at udvide korpset af fastansatte undervisere. På Professionshøjskolen Absalon er det vores ambition, at de studerende oplever en fagligt og socialt inkluderende studiestart, hvor de med det samme kan mærke deres kommende profession, deres uddannelse og bliver del af et aktivt studieliv. Derfor bliver de studerende blandt andet trænet i at udvikle en professionel tilgang til arbejdet i studiegrupper, så de bliver bedst muligt rustet til deres kommende arbejdsliv. Koblingen mellem teoretisk og praktisk erfaring afgørende. Din profil Uddannelsesreformen forpligter os til at tilbyde de studerende mere undervisning - og samtidig skabe bedre forudsætninger for en styrket relation mellem studerende og undervisere. Derfor har vi udviklet værkstedsdage, vi tilbyder de studerende studenterudviklingssamtaler, og vi arbejder i stigende grad med gennemgående faste undervisere. Derfor er følgende afgørende: Praksiserfaring. Du har solid erfaring fra socialt arbejde, f.eks. fra kommunal myndighed (børn og unge, beskæftigelsesområdet eller det specialiserede voksenområde) - måske som udfører - eller måske helt andre nicher indenfor feltet socialt arbejde. Undervisningserfaring. Det er en forudsætning, at du har undervisningserfaring, da vi har behov for, at du kan træde direkte ind i underviserrollen. Du har dermed også allerede mærket, at du trives med undervisning som hovedarbejdsopgave. Teamsamarbejde og koordinering. Du har erfaret, at det kræver et stærkt og ligeværdigt teamsamarbejde at lykkes med kvalificeret undervisning. Du deler ansvar og opgaver med dine kolleger, når I kobles sammen om opgaverne. Du har måske også oplevet, at det at være en del af et team, gør at arbejdsopgaven er lettere at gå til - at I løfter i flok. Fleksibilitet. I uddannelsesverdenen er meget planlagt i rigtig god tid. Trods dette vilkår er du er indforstået med, at der sker uforudsete ændringer, og du er vant til at håndtere disse konstruktivt og med et ansvarligt og samarbejdende mindset. Det er vores forventning, at du har:
  • grunduddannelse som socialrådgiver
  • overbygning med f.eks.. relevant master- eller kandidatgrad.
Dine arbejdsopgaver Din primære opgave er undervisning af fremtidens socialrådgivere samt efter-videreuddannelse af praktikere indenfor det socialfaglige felt. De konkrete opgaver er: At udvikle, planlægge og undervise på både grunduddannelse samt på efter- og videreuddannelse. Dette sker i tæt samspil med de studerende, dine kolleger og i samarbejde med såvel interne som eksterne samarbejdspartnere. På sigt vil der være mulighed for at indgå i forsknings- og udviklingsopgaver. At bidrage til et aktivt og socialt studiemiljø. Vi lægger vægt på, at studiemiljøerne er præget af et socialt liv samt glade og engagerede studerende, der kan få kompetent sparring og støtte, både i studiegrupper og fra deres vejledere. Dine kolleger CSA udbyder socialrådgiveruddannelsen i Roskilde, Slagelse og Nykøbing
  1. Du bliver primært tilknyttet ét campus, dog med forventning om en vis fleksibilitet ift. at kunne varetage undervisning på flere af vores campusser. Som udgangspunkt får du arbejdssted på vores campus i Roskilde.
I CSA er vi ca. 65 engagerede og ambitiøse kolleger, der værdsætter samarbejde og vidensdeling i en respektfuld og uformel omgangstone. Vi er socialt og fagligt velfunderede, og påskønner faglig sparring og udvikling i fællesskab. Derfor prioriterer vi tilstedeværelse på campus, hvor vi blandt andet forkæles med en fremragende kantine- og frokostordning. Der er mulighed for hjemmearbejde i et vist omfang. Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • For dig der er nyuddannet og ansættes som adjunkt, vil en forventet startløn være 40.900, - kr. inkl. pension. For dig der er en erfaren underviser og ansættes som lektor, vil en forventet startløn være 54.200, - kr. inkl. pension. Alt efter erfaring og baggrund kan der evt. forhandles kvalifikationstillæg.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid, og vi vil gerne have at du begynder senest 1. december 2026.
  • Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte uddannelsesleder Lisette Kaptain på telefon 7248 2963 eller lkap@pha.dk
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 10. november 2026.
  • Vi forventer at holde samtaler den 17. november 2026
Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen. Alt efter dine kvalifikationer bliver du ansat som adjunkt eller lektor På Absalon er adjunkturet en 4-årig uddannelsesstilling. Det understøtter vi gennem Absalons lektorkvalificeringsforløb, som alle nyansatte adjunkter deltager i, og alle får tilknyttet en vejleder. For at blive ansat som lektor forudsætter det en positiv lektorbedømmelse inden for stillingstrukturens anvendelsesområde. Ved ansættelse af lektorer der er lektorbedømt før 2013-stillingsstrukturen, sker ansættelse på hidtidige centralt fastsatte løn- og ansættelsesvilkår. Afhængig af dine kvalifikationer, afvejet med stillingens konkrete indhold, kan fornyet lektorbedømmelse efter den aktuelle stillingsstruktur (fast-track ordningen) eventuelt aftales. Læs mere her i kap. 5. https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2025/413 Du kan læse mere om rammerne for ansættelse som adjunkt eller lektor i vores stillingsstruktur her: https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2025/414 Om Absalon Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for. I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder. Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund. Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.description:
Hvem er jeg?

Jeg er en sosial og blid mann på 37 år med glimt i øyet. Jeg bruker rullestol og disponerer egen bil. To kvelder i uken deltar jeg på fritidsaktiviteter, og hver fredag er jeg i Furumo svømmehall. Utenom dette setter jeg stor pris på tid med venner.

Hvem er du?

Du er en mann over 23 år med førerkort, godt humør, og god nok fysikk til å hjelpe meg inn og ut av bil når vi skal på tur. Du må beherske norsk godt, både skriftlig og muntlig.

Arbeidstiden passer godt for deg som ønsker å jobbe kveldstid og fredag formiddager.

Siden du skal hjelpe meg i garderoben i svømmehallen, må du av praktiske årsaker være mann.

Hva skal du gjøre?

  • Assistere meg på ulike fritidsaktiviteter

  • Bistå med praktiske oppgaver, personlig hygiene, samt av- og påkledning.

Hva kreves av deg?

  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner

  • God fysikk til hjelp i forflytning

  • Være over 23 år

  • Førerkort

  • Pålitelig og ansvarsbevisst

Jeg verdsetter mangfold og oppfordrer alle som kjenner seg igjen i beskrivelsen til å søke.  

Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

Dette er noe av det du får ved å jobbe hos oss:

  • Tarifflønn, ansiennitetsregulert

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Veiledning og opplæring

  • Assistentkurs i regi av Humana Omsorg og Assistanse

  • Egen app for håndbøker og rutiner

  • Rabatter hos bl.a. SATS

  • Attraktive rabatter med fordelsprogrammet Visma LogBuy

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

jobs.description: **Vårdare till en sympatisk svenskspråkig kund**Vi söker en vårdare för deltidsarbete med uppgift att hjälpa vår sympatiska kund i ÖstresundomVill du arbeta deltid som vårdassistent, i lugn takt och utan sjukvårdsuppgifter, tillsammans med trevliga äldre personer? Då kan du vara vår nästa vård helppare!Vi är Hemby, ett företag som modigt förnyar vård tjänster och erbjuder glädje och trygghet i vardagen. Vårt motto är: **Vi hjälper kunden som om de vore vår egen mamma.**Vi växer ständigt och söker fler helppare till vårt team med utbildning inom vård och omsorg. Du hittar vårt korta och lätt ifyllda ansökningsformulär här: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply**Vad gör en vård helppare?**En vård helppare är en person med utbildning inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen som erbjuder vardaglig hjälp och sällskap åt sin egen utsedda senior. Vård helpparen stöder kunden i olika vardagssysslor, såsom promenader och butiksbesök, skötsel av hemmet, stöd vid måltider, ledsagning, samvaro och samtal.Vård helpparen stöder kundens välbefinnande på ett helhetsmässigt sätt. Vård- och omsorgsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat:- hjälp vid dusch - uppföljning av hur senioren mår - stöd för att klara sig hemma - stöd vid förflyttning och rörlighet Du kan också hjälpa kunden med dusch och personlig hygien. Arbetet omfattar dock inte sjukvårdsuppgifter, såsom läkemedelsbehandling.**Vad krävs av en vård helppare?**Framför allt en stark vilja att hjälpa såna som behöver stöd. Dessutom kräver arbetet som vård helppare en utbildning inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen eller som vårdassistent, alternativt gedigen erfarenhet av arbete som vårdassistent.Det viktigaste är att du vill tycker om att spendera tid och sällskapa med andra människor och genom ditt arbete göra deras vardag bättre. Du kan anpassa arbetet efter din egen livssituation och arbetstiderna är mycket flexibla.Vad är det bästa med arbetet som vård helppare?Vi frågade våra vård helppare och fick bland annat följande svar:Att möta människor utan stress och att bli vänner med kunden.Att hjälpa en annan människa och känna att det man gör är meningsfullt.Att hjälpa kunden på ett helhetsmässigt sätt utifrån hens behov.Som vård helppare får du:- **En egen utsedd kund** som du hjälper med vardagliga sysslor och håller sällskap. - **Flexibla arbetstider** som passar utmärkt exempelvis vid sidan av studier eller som extraarbete. Den vanligaste arbetstiden är 2–10 timmar per vecka. - **Konkurrenskraftig lön:** 15,29–17,29 €/h + tillägg enligt kollektivavtal samt semesterersättning. - **Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter:** Med erfarenhet och god kundrespons kan du avancera till pro- eller guru-helpper och få en högre lön! Ansökningar skickas in via det elektroniska ansökningsformuläret. Vi kontaktar alla sökande efter att ansökan har skickats in.**Skicka in din ansökan som vårdare-helpper här.****Läs mer om Hemby genom att klicka här.**Om du har frågor om att bli vårdare-helpper, skicka ett e-postmeddelande till **rekry@hemby.fi**, så berättar vi gärna mer!

jobs.title: Kostansvarlige til Dagtilbudsområde Syd på 30 og 37 timer ugentligt
jobs.description:
Forældrene i 4 af områdets institutioner har valgt madordning til deres børn fra 2027. Ansættelse sker pr. 1. januar 2027, og madordningen starter den 1. februar 2027. Den første måned giver mulighed for at falde godt til i de nyetablerede køkkener, planlægge indkøb, udarbejde menuplaner og være med til at forme de pædagogiske måltider, som skal understøtte børnenes trivsel, udvikling og madmod.

Præsentation af virksomheden:Dagtilbudsområde Syd består af 13 daginstitutioner, hvoraf 7 allerede har en velfungerende madordning.

Vi søger kostansvarlige til følgende institutioner:

Birkehegnet: 30 timer ugentligtBørnehaven Birkehegnet er en lille børnehave med plads til 49 børn fordelt på 3 stuer, hvoraf 2 af stuerne har præmaturbørn. Vi er et lille hus, hvor alle børn og voksne kender hinanden. Vi arbejder tæt sammen på tværs af stuerne om at skabe trivsel og livsglæde blandt børnene, og du vil derfor blive mødt af glade, engagerede, nysgerrige og imødekommende børn og voksne. Som kostansvarlig vil du blive en del af dette fællesskab, hvor vi sammen skal skabe madmodige børn og sammen opleve glæden ved det fælles måltid.Du kan læse mere om institutionen her.

Svalen: 30 timer ugentligtSvalen er en mindre daginstitution beliggende i Åderupkvarteret i den sydlige del af Næstved. Her danner vi rammen om hverdagen for 64 skønne og nysgerrige børn i alderen 0-6 år. Vi er et hus i en spændende udvikling. I øjeblikket har vi 3 børnehavestuer, men i løbet af foråret 2027 omstrukturerer vi den ene stue til en helt ny vuggestuegruppe. I vores pædagogiske arbejde har vi et stærkt fokus på børneperspektivet og børns medbestemmelse, og vores helt nye køkken er placeret i direkte forbindelse med fællesrummet, som fungerer som husets hjerte. Du kan læse mere om institutionen her.

Børnehuset ved Grøften: 37 timer ugentligtBørnehuset ved Grøften er et integreret dagtilbud med 3 vuggestuegrupper, 3 børnehavegrupper og mere end 100 børn. I Grøften møder vi børn med nærvær, nysgerrighed og troen på, at alle børn har ret til at være betydningsfulde deltagere i fællesskabet. Vi er stolte af vores stærke arbejdsfællesskab, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og fælles ansvar skaber de bedste rammer for både børn og voksne. Som kostansvarlig i Grøften har du mulighed for at være med fra begyndelsen, når vi etablerer madordningen. Sammen skal vi udvikle en stærk måltidskultur, hvor sunde og nærende måltider understøtter børnenes trivsel, nysgerrighed og madmod.Du kan læse mere om institutionen her.

Børnehuset ved Volden: 37 timer ugentligtBørnehuset ved Volden er en integreret daginstitution med plads til 108 børn fordelt på 3 vuggestuegrupper og 3 børnehavegrupper. Hos os møder du et hus præget af nærvær, fællesskab og et stærkt børnesyn, hvor alle børn skal føle sig værdifulde, set, hørt og forstået. Vi lægger vægt på trygge relationer, leg, udvikling og deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn. Som kostansvarlig bliver du en vigtig del af hverdagen og bidrager til børnenes trivsel gennem madglæde, sund kost og gode fællesskaber omkring måltidet.Du kan læse mere om institutionen her.

Dagtilbudsområde Syd arbejder ud fra en ambition om at tilbyde børn nærende, varierede og velsmagende måltider af høj kvalitet, samtidig med at måltiderne understøtter fællesskab, læring og gode madvaner.

Hvem kommer du til at arbejde med:Som kostansvarlig bliver du en vigtig del af institutionens hverdag og fællesskab. Du samarbejder tæt med den daglige leder og det pædagogiske personale om at skabe gode måltidsoplevelser for børnene. Du bliver samtidig en del af et fagligt netværk med områdets øvrige køkkenmedarbejdere, hvor der afholdes tre årlige netværksmøder med mulighed for sparring, videndeling og faglig udvikling.

Hvem leder vi efter:Vi søger kostansvarlige, der har kendskab til madordninger og har lyst til at arbejde i daginstitutioner, der emmer af glade og energifyldte børn og voksne, og som ser tilberedelsen af de forskellige måltider som en glæde.

Vi tilbyder

  • et selvstændigt køkken med de faciliteter, der kræves af Fødevarestyrelsen
  • indflydelse på, og ansvar for, køkkenets daglige drift
  • overblik over eget budget
  • mulighed for at præge menuplaner og måltidskultur
  • et godt arbejdsmiljø med engagerede kolleger
  • stærke fællesskaber og et fagligt netværk med områdets øvrige køkkenmedarbejdere

Vi forventer, at du

  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret
  • kan stå for varebestilling, menuplanlægning og egenkontrol
  • kan tilberede velsmagende og ernæringsrigtige måltider, primært lavet fra bunden og i overensstemmelse med Fødevarestyrelsens anbefalinger
  • kan arbejde inden for en fastsat økonomisk ramme
  • kan bevare overblikket og den gode tone i en travl hverdag
  • har viden om allergier, diæter og religiøse hensyn i forbindelse med måltider
  • er kreativ, idérig og tænker i sæsoner, mærkedage og sanseoplevelser for børnene
  • er fleksibel i forhold til institutionens aktiviteter, herunder ture ud af huset og ændrede spisetider
  • er god til at samarbejde med det pædagogiske personale
  • har fokus på bæredygtighed og aktivt arbejder med at forebygge madspild

Du kan se job- og personprofilen her.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst mellem KL og relevant faglig organisation afhængigt af ansøgerens uddannelsesbaggrund.

Oplysninger om startløn og forventet lønintervalVia linket her kan ses oplysninger om relevant løninterval for den konkrete stilling. I oversigten vælges Næstved Kommune, hvilken stillingskategori (overenskomst) du ansøger til og yderligere hvilken stilling du søger. I tabellen derunder kan ses de relevante oplysninger for den konkrete stilling.

Tiltrædelse den 1. januar 2027. 

Arbejdstid pr. uge er henholdsvis 30 og 37 timer.

Vil du vide mere, er du velkommen til at kontakte:Birkehegnet: Daglig leder Dorte Jensen, telefon 2144 6329Svalen: Daglig leder Johanne Aamand Nielsen, telefon 2053 5673Børnehuset ved Grøften: Daglig leder Maiken Rauhe Mouridsen, telefon 2165 6781Børnehuset ved Volden: Daglig leder Cecilie Magnusson, telefon 2476 7505

jobs.title: Helsepersonell
jobs.description:
Solvang har ledig fast helgestilling i årsturnus, perfekt for deg som f.eks er student. Antall helger til sammen er 19., med primært kveldsvakter – en helg har langvakter. Stillingen utgjør ca.25,5 %. Solvang bofellesskap er omsorgsboliger for personer med diverse psykiske ufordringer, lokalisert i Tinn Austbygd.  

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • målrettet miljøarbeid
  • oppfølging og arbeid etter vedtak
  • rapporterings- og informasjonsansvar til avdelingsleder
  • bidra til helhet og sammenheng i tjenestene

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • erfaring fra arbeid med mennesker er en fordel 
  • positiv og løsningsorientert
  • gjerne ha erfaring fra arbeid innenfor psykisk helse
  • gjerne førerkort kl. B
  • innsikt i ulike it verktøy

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Være lojal og ha god vurderingsevne, samt gjennomføringskraft i forhold til det som er besluttet
  • Personlig egnethet vektlegges
  • Gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonevner

Vi tilbyr:

  • Gunstig pensjonsordning, yrkesskade- og gruppelivsforsikring
  • Gode opplæring/utviklingsmuligheter
  • Meningsfylt arbeid
  • Et arbeidsmiljø preget av arbeidsglede, engasjement og organisasjonstilhørighet
  • Lønn etter tariffavtalens bestemmelser

Vi ønsker et arbeidsmiljø preget av mangfold, og at våre ansatte skal gjenspeile befolkningen forøvrig. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, eller minoritetsbakgrunn.

Etter søknadsfristens utløp, vil det bli satt opp en offentlig søkerliste med navn, alder, stilling/yrkestittel og bosted. Det kan gjøres unntak om offentliggjøring av en søker dersom vedkommende selv ber om det. Opplysninger om søker kan offentliggjøres selv om søker har bedt om unntak. Dersom anmodningen ikke blir tatt til følge vil søkeren bli varslet om dette.

For stillinger der det kreves politiattest jf. gjeldende lovverk må politiattest foreligge senest ved tiltredelse.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Tinn kommune har rundt 5500 innbyggere og ligger øverst i Telemark med Hardangervidda som nærmeste nabo og med byen Rjukan som kommunesenter. Kommunen har et variert næringsliv, et godt utdannings tilbud og vi kan by på et allsidig tilbud innenfor kulturliv, idrett og friluftsliv. Reiselivet i kommunen er i sterk utvikling med en rekke enestående attraksjoner. Rjukan er på UNESCO`s verdensarvliste for sin arkitektur og godt bevarte industrihistorie. Tinn skal være en framtidsrettet kommune, og vi prioriterer tiltak som videreutvikler gode tjenester og høy service til innbyggerne. Tinn kommune har et solid og bredt tjenestetilbud som vi ønsker å videreutvikle og styrke i årene som kommer. Kommunen er organisert med fire ledernivåer. Ansvar og myndighet er delegert gjennom hele lederlinjen, og ledere har helhetlig ansvar for personal, økonomi og fag innenfor sine områder. Organiseringen skal sikre tydelig ledelse, gode beslutningsprosesser og nærhet til tjenestene. Arbeidsforholdet reguleres av gjeldende lov- og avtaleverk, samt lokale retningslinjer og reglement. Vi er opptatt av mangfold og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke, uavhengig av kjønn, etnisitet, religion eller livssyn, funksjonsevne eller bakgrunn. Tinn kommune er en IA-virksomhet, og vi arbeider aktivt for et inkluderende og godt arbeidsmiljø.

jobs.title: Supervior Piping
jobs.description:
At VARD, we create innovative and sustainable solutions for the global maritime industry. Combining future-oriented engineering excellence, cutting-edge technology, and strong teamwork, we design and build some of the world’s most advanced vessels for a wide range of market segments, including offshore energy, naval, fisheries, icebreaking and research. At the same time, we believe our people are our greatest strength.  We need people with a wide range of skills, professional backgrounds, and experience. Engineers, designers, skilled workers, project managers, finance professionals, procurement specialists and many others all work together towards a common goal. Different perspectives and areas of expertise are essential to delivering high-quality vessels. To be able to build the ships of tomorrow today, we foster an inclusive and supportive environment where talents can grow, ideas are valued, and individuals are empowered to make an impact. 

 

Vard Interiors is a leading supplier of turnkey interior, insulation, piping, and HVAC-R solutions for the maritime industry. As part of the VARD value chain, we work closely with shipowners, designers, and shipyards to create functional, sustainable, and high-quality onboard environments. With a strong focus on innovation, craftsmanship, and customer value, we help bring some of the industry’s most advanced vessels to life.

We are currently looking for a Supervisor Piping to join our team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your expertise, collaborate with skilled colleagues, and contribute to exciting projects across the VARD value chain.

Ready to make an impact at VARD?

Duties and responsibilities
  • Plan and coordinate piping installation and commissioning activities.
  • Coordinate personnel and subcontractors to meet project milestones.
  • Monitor progress, quality and performance throughout the project.
  • Prepare areas and systems for inspections and follow up remarks and non-conformities.
  • Ensure necessary materials and documentation are available for production.
  • Identify and resolve challenges that may impact progress, quality or cost.
  • Report installation and commissioning progress to relevant stakeholders.
Qualifications
  • Vocational education, or relevant experience that can compensate for formal education.
  • Experience and good technical understanding of piping systems, installation and commissioning.
  • Ability to understand technical, construction and functional drawings.
  • Basic knowledge of classification rules, including DNV and Bureau Veritas.
  • Good computer skills, including Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Ability to work with 3D drawing viewers.
  • Good English skills, both written and spoken.
  • Knowledge of safe working methods and practices.

 

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Good leadership, coordination and communication skills.
  • Self-driven and proactive in solving operational challenges.
  • Structured, reliable and responsible.
  • Able to work effectively as part of a team.
  • Practical and solution-oriented approach.
  • Comfortable coordinating people and activities in a dynamic production environment

You will design pedagogy, including online learning materials, laboratory work and project work, and help develop the curriculum to meet the evolving needs of the food industry and the modern workforce.Your teaching will take place at Metropolias Myyrmäki campus in Vantaa and at the Zhongqiao Helsinki School of Future Engineering in Shanghai, China, where Metropolia delivers two joint programmes, Food Safety and Quality and Food Nutrition and Health. The work in China is carried out in two-week teaching periods on site, at least twice per semester, complemented by online teaching. International travel is therefore an essential part of the role.Your role combines theory and practice in teaching, laboratory instruction, thesis supervision, RDI activities, and project collaboration with companies and other stakeholders in the food, nutrition and bioeconomy sectors.Minimum Requirements- Relevant Masters degree (e.g. in food science, food technology, nutrition science or a related field)- At least three years of relevant work experience in the food industry or a closely related field- Strong understanding of industry needs and an established professional network in the food sector- Ability to work directly with companies and integrate real industrial cases into teaching, research and development- Willingness and ability to travel to and work in Shanghai, China, for regular two-week teaching periods- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work in a diverse, international and intercultural environment- Fluency in English and willingness to learn Finnish (support provided)- Professional Teacher Education qualification. If you do not yet have the required pedagogical studies for teachers, these can be completed alongside your work within three years of being appointed.What We Value- Doctoral degree (PhD, DSc or equivalent)- Experience in food quality management, food safety systems, HSEQ, product safety and risk-based thinking- Expertise in nutrition and nutritional physiology, functional foods, or sensory evaluation- Experience of working in international and multicultural environments- Proven experience of industry collaboration and ability to build and maintain company relationships- Motivation to develop teaching and applied learning environments, and to use pedagogically sound methods- Willingness to develop your own expertise, stay current in your field and bring new ideas into teaching and learningWhat We OfferWe offer you an opportunity to work with enthusiastic colleagues in a supportive, multidisciplinary and international community. You will have the chance to develop your teaching, professional expertise and pedagogical skills while contributing to education, applied research, and collaboration with industry and international partners in Finland and China.The salary and terms of employment are determined in accordance with the Collective Agreement for Universities of Applied Sciences. Metropolias turnover is 135 million euros, of which RDI and business operations represent a growing share.We value the diversity of our working community and work towards achieving equality. jobs.title: Professor of Shared Decision-making and Professional Development (combined position)
jobs.description:
Professor of Shared Decision-making and Professional Development 

A combined position as Professor (50%) and as Research Director (50%) is vacant at the Department of Regional Health Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) and at the Centre for Shared Decision Making, Lillebaelt Hospital, Vejle, respectively.

The position is offered for five years, with the possibility of extension.

The academic positionThe professor will advance research into shared decision-making (SDM) and the involvement of patients and their relatives, as well as the professional development required to integrate these approaches into clinical practice. The professor will be part of the management team at the joint centre at Lillebælt Hospital and will foster coherence between research, education and implementation. The professor will be appointed at the Department of Regional Health Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, SDU. The academic field combines SDM with professional development for healthcare professionals. Interdisciplinary research and collaboration across clinical settings are expected and central to the position.

Research leadership and responsibilitiesAt Lillebaelt Hospital, the professor/appointee will serve as Research Director. Together with the Centre Director, the Research Director forms the joint center leadership. The Research Director has line management responsibility for academic staff and overall scientific and strategic responsibility for research activities associated with the Center for Shared Decision Making (CFFB) and the Center for Involvement of Relatives (CEPI). The two leadership roles work closely together on the development of the centers.

The professor is expected responsible for:

  • Strategic Research Leadership and Centre ManagementThe position as professor includes overall scientific and strategic responsibility for the research units affiliated with both CFFB and CEPI as well as their interdisciplinary research group. This includes line management and academic leadership of researchers, ensuring the stable operation of the centers, and maintaining strategic oversight of the centers’ grant portfolio and funding pipeline.

  • Fundraising and External Research FundingThe professor is expected to secure substantial external research funding from national and international funding bodies to ensure the long-term sustainability and development of the centers’ research activities.

  • Practice-Oriented Empirical ResearchThe professor is expected to develop and lead empirical research SDM projects with a particular focus on the perspectives of patients, relatives, and healthcare professionals within different diseases, specialties and healthcare settings, while contributing to the advancement of qualitative and applied research methodologies such as action research.

  • Development of Educational Resources, Curriculum Design, and Educational TransformationThe position requires designing and developing practical educational tools and implementation resources — e.g., learning materials — that support healthcare professionals’ learning and continuing professional development in clinical practice performing SDM.

  • Teaching, lecturing, supervising and disseminating knowledgeThe professor should teach and mentor postdocs, PhD students, and undergraduate students. Participation in assessment work is part of the position. Additionally, profiling this research area in the public eye will be an important task.

Research activity, network and collaborationThe candidate is expected to demonstrate prior experience with research activities in terms of networks and collaborations. The professor is expected to increase research activity at the research unit and to expand collaboration with other researchers at hospitals in the Region of Southern Denmark, at SDU, the rest of Denmark and internationally.

The position as Research Director at the Centre for Shared Decision Making (CFFB)The Professorship in Shared Decision-making and Professional Development at the Center for Shared Decision Making, Vejle, Denmark, is established to support the continued implementation of Lillebaelt Hospital’s research strategy and the hospital’s overarching commitment to placing the patient at the center of care.

Over the past decade, the Center has conducted research on evidence-based approaches to SDM and has demonstrated that SDM is associated with high patient satisfaction and improved adherence to agreed treatment plans. The professorship will build on this strong research foundation by advancing knowledge on the implementation of SDM and the continuing professional development of healthcare professionals. International research consistently shows that achieving sustained and authentic SDM practice in everyday clinical care remains a significant implementation challenge. Changing professional practices and departmental cultures requires more than time-limited projects or implementation initiatives. Sustainable integration of SDM depends on ongoing and continuous competence development that supports long-term changes in clinical practice.

This professorship is positioned at the intersection of health sciences research, implementation in clinical practice, and professional development through applied educational research. The core purpose of the position is to strengthen and transform the healthcare system’s capacity for meaningful patient and family involvement through SDM.

The professorship requires strategic research leadership from a scholar with extensive expertise in lifelong learning, learning theory, curriculum theory, and action research, and with the ability to translate this knowledge into continuing professional development for healthcare professionals. The professor is expected to lead the national and international research agenda on how SDM can be integrated meaningfully and sustainably into routine clinical practice, to achieve enduring behavioral change among healthcare professionals.

QualificationsThe required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a PhD or equivalent post-graduate research qualification and demonstrate scientific achievements at a level appropriate for appointment as Professor.

  • The position calls for expertise in educational science as applied to the professional development of healthcare staff or other types of welfare staff, together with substantial knowledge of and research contributions to SDM.

  • The applicant should be able to demonstrate experience of teaching and lecturing at university and postgraduate level, as well as experience as principal supervisor on PhD projects and academic assessment work, as evidenced by the teaching portfolio.

  • Danish language skills are not required at the time of appointment, but must be mastered at proficiency level C1, at the Common European Framework of References for Languages within the first 2 years of employment.

The ideal candidate preferably demonstrates:

  • The candidate should demonstrate experience with leadership capacity with the ability to lead research teams, drive cultural change, and contribute strategically to the development of the centers.

  • The candidate holds experience in research management, interdisciplinary collaboration, and attraction of external funding for professional development and/or SDM-oriented activities will be considered an advantage.

  • The candidate preferably demonstrates experience with practice-oriented empirical research. Research that is aimed at both an international research community, and ideally also at the target group of professionals in Denmark; therefore, publications and outputs are welcome to be in Danish – whether in the form of books, leaflets, journal publications or other material designed to ensure that both professionals undertaking continuing professional development in Denmark and students on undergraduate program are best supported and thereby ensuring impact.

  • The candidate has prior experience with developing, implementing, and/or evaluating educational programs, frameworks, and curricula for continuing professional development, preferably in terms of SDM-related competencies. Experience of developing and evaluating continuing professional education in clinical settings is valued.

  • The preferred candidate can motivate and supervise, has proven research management skills, good interpersonal skills in charge of a research group, and has a clear vision for how to further strengthen the research unit at CFFB as strong interpersonal and collaborative skills are essential.

  • The successful applicant will have documented experience of leading research and researchers, obtain external funding and work across disciplines and organizations.

EmployersCFFB is a national knowledge and competence center based at Lillebaelt Hospital. Since 2014, it has researched SDM and since 2019 developed approaches for implementation in clinical practice. CEPI works to strengthen meaningful involvement of relatives. The centers retain their distinct areas of responsibility while collaborating closely on research and practice. Lillebaelt Hospital provides somatic and mental healthcare across sites in Vejle, Kolding and Middelfart. Patient and family involvement is central to their approach to care.

SDU's Department of Regional Health Research links research and education with hospitals and clinical environments across the Region of Southern Denmark. The Department of Regional Health Research supports research in relation to the person as a whole, the good life and the more common diseases, makes out a platform for scientists and educators and builds a bridge between University of Southern Denmark, The Region of Southern Denmark, the hospitals in the region and the patient. The department focuses on the continuity of patient care across sectors, hospitals, and specialist fields.

Reference The professor and research director will refer to the hospital management regarding matters concerning the management of the centres, and to the Head of the Department of Regional Health Research, Mikkel Brabrand, in matters regarding the professorship.

Contact informationFurther information concerning the position can be obtained by contacting:

  • The Research Coordinator at Lillebælt Hospital, Jonna Skov Madsen, Jonna.Skov.Madsen@rsyd.dk, +45 30507825

  • The Director of the Centre, Karina Olling, Karina.Olling@rsyd.dk, +45 51518696

  • The Head of the Department of Regional Health Research, SDU, Mikkel Brabrand, mbrabrand@health.sdu.dk, +45 93534980

Salary and terms of employmentThe successful applicant for the professor position will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Professor is salaried in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and on terms corresponding to salary grade 37 of the Danish state salary system. Additional qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Center for Shared Decision Making (Center for Fælles Beslutningstagning), Beriderbakken 4, 7100 Vejle, Denmark.

ApplicationOnly applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • An application

  • A detailed CV

  • Degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma or equivalent)

  • A complete and numbered list of publications

  • 10 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position (please notice that one pdf file must be attached for each publication)

  • It is permitted to merge the 10 scientific peer-reviewed publications into a single PDF file due to upload constraints.

  • A teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • Track record in obtaining research funding

  • National and international research collaboration and collaborations with researchers in other disciplines and sectors

  • A research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application. Incomplete applications with regards to the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed.

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

The application deadline is 11 November 2026 at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST)

AssessmentShortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves.

jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description:
Who we are

Comand AI is building a global technology leader focused on defense & security. The company was co-founded in 2023 by Loïc Mougeolle, Marie Inuzuka and Quentin Le Pape, drawing from their unique experience at defense industry leaders and world-class tech companies.

The world of defense & security are being entirely renewed by AI and robotisation: new classes of threats, new levels of autonomy and speed demands radically new solutions to protect our societies. Comand AI is at the forefront of the rebuilding of these verticals to serve our countries resilience.

Comand AI core product is a next generation command and control software platform, which allows militaries to operate at machine speed in a communication and GNSS denied context. A few facts to anchor you:

  • €45M raised from seed to Series A, Blossom Capital leading the series A and Saab as a strategic investor

  • Software platform combat proven and deployed in Ukraine

  • A lean team of operators with backgrounds from Palantir, OpenAI and world-class tech experience, alongside unique expertise from the defense sector

  • Live business with governments and defense industry leaders across Europe

  • Paris (HQ), London, Munich and Kyiv subsidiaries

The Role

You'd join the engineering team to own features end to end, with a strong lean toward the interfaces and workflows clients interact with directly. This is a product engineering role. Unlike our Forward Deployed Engineers, you are not embedded with clients or responsible for running deployments in the field. You turn operational needs and field feedback into a durable core product.

What this looks like in practice:

  • Own end-to-end features on Prevail, our operational planning platform, from scoping and interaction choices through backend implementation and production

  • Spend significant time on the front end, building clear, reliable workflows for users working with complex information under pressure

  • Solve real geospatial problems: move data between backend and frontend through tile servers and use PostGIS for demanding spatial queries

jobs.description:
Werkstudent Recruitment (Nederlandstalig) — Den Haag of Berlijn, hybride (v/m/x)

Over Eye

Eye Security maakt cybersecurity van topniveau, met een ingebouwde cyberverzekering, bereikbaar voor elk bedrijf in Europa, niet alleen voor de grote spelers. We zijn met ruim 190 collega's, met ons hoofdkantoor in Den Haag en een kantoor in Berlijn. Ons team komt uit de inlichtingenwereld, defensie, tech en consultancy. We groeien hard, dus er is veel te bouwen en veel te leren.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je helpt onze recruiters kandidaten te vinden voor lastig in te vullen functies

  • Je helpt onze contacten met hogescholen en universiteiten op te bouwen

De functie is nieuw en groeit mee met jou en met wat het team het hardst nodig heeft.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en redt je goed in het Engels

  • Je zit in het derde of vierde jaar van je hbo- of wo-opleiding en kunt 20 uur per week werken, waarvan 2 à 3 dagen op ons kantoor in Den Haag of Berlijn

  • Je hebt minstens een half jaar administratieve of kantoorervaring (een bestuursjaar telt ook mee) en je bent handig met Excel

  • Je wilt een carrière in recruitment opbouwen en bent benieuwd hoe het vak in elkaar zit

  • Je pakt dingen zelf op: je ziet wat er moet gebeuren, zoekt hulp als je die nodig hebt en stelt goede vragen

Mooi meegenomen

  • Je vindt het leuk om met data te werken, of wilt daar beter in worden

  • Je hebt al wat ervaring met recruitment, HR of een ATS

Wat krijg je?

  • Vanaf de eerste week echte verantwoordelijkheid, met een recruiter naast je van wie je het vak leert

  • Een duidelijke kans om door te groeien naar junior recruiter

  • Flexibele uren die passen bij je studie, en hybride werken

  • Een team dat successen samen viert, van maandelijkse teamactiviteiten tot onze jaarlijkse "Eye-cation"

Over Eye Security

Eye Security biedt cybersecurity met een ingebouwde cyberverzekering aan organisaties in heel Europa. Ons hoofdkantoor staat in Nederland en we zijn gegroeid naar ruim 170 medewerkers. We blijven internationaal uitbreiden.

We combineren geavanceerde technologie met praktische expertise om cyberdreigingen in realtime te detecteren, erop te reageren en de schade te herstellen. Ons team bestaat uit professionals met een achtergrond in de inlichtingenwereld, defensie, tech en consultancy. We werken allemaal aan dezelfde missie: cybersecurity van topniveau bereikbaar maken voor elk bedrijf, niet alleen voor de grote spelers.

Bij Eye werk je aan internationale projecten, los je echte vraagstukken op en help je onze klanten aan een veiligere digitale toekomst.

Kleine noot: in de Engelse en Nederlandse vacature in het document staat “ruim 190 collega’s”, wat recentere vacatures van Eye ook noemen. Kijk even welk getal je wilt aanhouden, zodat beide versies hetzelfde zeggen.

jobs.title: Corporate Paralegal
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

Mistral AI's corporate legal team is looking for a Corporate Paralegal to join our growing legal function in Paris. This is a newly created role designed to centralize and streamline the administrative backbone of our corporate legal operations as we scale internationally.

This is a high-autonomy role. You will own several critical workstreams end-to-end — from KYC and entity housekeeping to cap table management and contract administration — and you will be expected to exercise sound judgment, escalate when needed, and drive automation wherever possible.

What you'll do

1. Cap Table & Share Register

Own the cap table across different systems with rigor and precision. Record all share movements — issuances, transfers, ESOP/BSPCE, funding rounds. Maintain the legal share register and reconcile against articles, shareholders' agreements, and board minutes. Produce cap table extracts, shareholder lists, and ownership reports for KYC, audit, board packs, and investors — always under NDA and with judgment on what can be disclosed. Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, reconciliation) are essential.

2. Entity Management, Corporate Formalities & Notarisation

Handle entity creation from incorporation to corporate maintenance across jurisdictions (SAS, Inc, Ltd, Pte, GmbH, etc.) with confidentiality and attention to detail. Manage the annual formalities calendar, board/shareholder minutes, resolutions, powers of attorney, and the entity housekeeping file for each group company. Coordinate notarial formalities — share transfers, capital changes, statutory modifications, pledges. Handle apostilles, legalisation, and certified translations for documents used abroad via the Legal Vision Platform. Maintain up-to-date KYC packs for each entity: Kbis, articles, directors, beneficial ownership, administrative certificates. Respond to inbound KYC requests from banks, clients, and investors. Log every formalité for a complete and auditable record.

3. Insurance & Document Management

Manage insurance policies, certificates (COIs), and the renewal calendar. Handle COI requests by checking them against contractual requirements and following up with brokers. Keep a register of policies and claims. File and archive documents with naming conventions and versioning in our document management tools. Manage e-signatures (DocuSign). Maintain the contract register with expiry dates and notice periods. Provide up-to-date insurance certificates and policy summaries as part of KYC documentation for each entity.

4. Procurement Contracts

First-level review of NDAs, order forms, and simple SOWs against Mistral templates, flagging deviations for escalation. Version comparison and clean redlines. Understand the procurement policy to know when legal review is mandatory. Coordinate with Procurement, business teams, and Finance to move deals to signature. Complete supplier onboarding questionnaires (anti-bribery, sanctions, ESG, security) and supplier portals (Ariba, Coupa) as part of the vendor KYC process. Comfortable with tools like Ironclad, Notion, and Slack; keen to automate and reduce manual work.

What you bring

  • 10+ years of experience in a legal field, with a strong preference for corporate law (M&A, banking, funds, or large corporate groups).

  • Experience in a law firm (corporate/M&A/banking), investment fund, bank, or a large multinational group (e.g., CAC 40).

  • Proven experience with KYC processes, questionnaires, and administrative certificates.

  • Strong understanding of confidentiality, data protection (GDPR), and the judgment to know what can and cannot be shared externally.

  • Hands-on experience with cap table management tools (Ledgy, Axiocap) or share register administration.

  • Familiarity with French corporate law (SAS) and international entity structures (Delaware Inc, UK Ltd, Singapore Pte, German GmbH).

  • Experience with contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools and e-signature platforms.

  • Exposure to procurement contract review and vendor onboarding.

  • Fluent in English and French (both written and spoken). Additional languages are a plus.

What We Offer

Tuoreimman asiakastutkimuksen mukaan **98 % asiakkaistamme suosittelisi Imatran Kylpylää loma- ja matkakohteena.** Se kertoo asiakkaiden luottamuksesta sekä henkilöstömme tekemän työn laadusta.**Meillä et myy pelkkiä hotellihuoneita. Jos olet energinen, asiakaslähtöinen ja nautit uusien mahdollisuuksien löytämisestä, haluamme kuulla sinusta, vaikka et täyttäisi jokaista toivomustamme täydellisesti.

jobs.title: Sales Representative (UK Market)
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Partner Manager (B2B Sales) to help us grow in the UK market! If you’re a native or near-native (C2) English speaker with a passion for sales and the drive to build strong partnerships, keep reading!

 

About Nettbureau

Nettbureau is a Norwegian scale-up that helps consumers across Europe make better decisions through comparison and tender services like eiendomsmegler.no, flytta.se, luz.es, and fotovoltaico.it. Today, we operate 100+ services across 15 countries.

We combine strong growth with profitability and were recently named one of the Financial Times’ Europe’s Long-Term Growth Champions 2025. In Norway, we've been named a “Gaselle” company (one of the country’s fastest-growing businesses) for ten consecutive years, earning us a spot in the Hall of Fame.

We’re a team of 95+ people, with around 50 based in Oslo. You’ll join the UK team while also being part of a larger, international sales team working across multiple markets.

We value a friendly and flexible work environment, with opportunities to connect through both social activities and professional development.

📖 Learn more about us at Nettbureau.com and check out our employee handbook.

 

About the UK team

We launched in the UK in 2025, starting in the green energy space with sites such as solarenergy.co.uk and evchargers.uk. We’re a small, entrepreneurial team.

The team consists today of three people: a Content & Marketing Specialist, a Partner Manager, and a Country Manager. As our team grows, you’ll join as our second Partner Manager, working alongside our existing Partner Manager to grow our partner base.

You will work in a fast-moving environment where new services and verticals are continuously launched, giving you strong exposure and the opportunity to shape how we grow the UK market.

 

About the Role

As our new Partner Manager (B2B Sales), you will play a key role in launching and growing our UK market by acquiring new B2B customers and building long-term commercial partnerships.

While we generate a steady flow of high-quality inbound leads through our services, this is primarily a new business role. Your success will depend on consistently driving outbound prospecting, building your own pipeline, and actively creating new sales opportunities. Alongside winning new business, you’ll manage your own portfolio of signed partners: keeping them active and satisfied, growing their accounts, and making sure invoices are paid.

Our offering gives potential clients access to warm, relevant, GDPR-compliant leads with no upfront commitment. This creates a strong foundation for meaningful sales conversations and long-term client relationships.

You will work with a wide range of clients, from small local businesses to large multinational companies, across multiple industries and product verticals. This variety means high pace, constant learning, and significant ownership of your results.

 

Key responsibilities:

  • Own the full B2B sales cycle from prospecting to closing new business

  • Build and grow a strong pipeline through active outbound prospecting by phone and email, and follow up open prospects until they sign or decline

  • Deliver online presentations and product demos to prospective clients

  • Identify client needs and tailor solutions to match their business goals

  • Grow existing client accounts by finding ways to increase their value, such as more lead volume, new regions or additional services

  • Keep partners active and prevent churn by following up regularly and acting early on signs of dissatisfaction or reduced activity

  • Follow up on overdue invoices and work with our business operations and finance teams on cases that need escalation

  • Track and manage all sales activity in Pipedrive, our CRM system

  • Collaborate with internal teams (content, marketing and business operations) on partner feedback, lead delivery, sales processes and conversion rates

  • Contribute to the launch and scaling of new services in the UK market, by spotting new opportunities and helping ensure continued product-market fit

 

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a driven and proactive sales professional who enjoys building pipeline, winning new business, and taking ownership of their results.

You should be comfortable working in a high-activity environment where consistent prospecting and outreach are key to success.

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you have:

  • Native-level or C2 proficiency in British English, including the tone and conventions of UK business, with strong communication and negotiation skills

  • A proven track record of selling to UK businesses, with a good understanding of the UK business landscape

  • Documented experience in outbound B2B sales, i.e. finding and signing new clients

  • Experience working in a high-activity sales environment with clear targets

  • A proven ability to close sales remotely via phone, video calls, and email (this role is about selling remotely rather than face-to-face)

  • Strong ability to identify client needs and translate them into relevant solutions

  • Commercial understanding: the ability to assess the economics of a deal and prioritise the most valuable clients and profitable agreements

  • A disciplined and structured approach to managing your pipeline and sales process

  • Experience using CRM systems to track performance and prioritise effectively

  • Curiosity, adaptability, and motivation to continuously improve

No formal degree is required. We value proven sales skills and results over academic background.

Extra points if you have:

  • B2B sales experience in one of our verticals, such as renewable energy, real estate or telecommunications

  • Experience with performance-based or lead generation products

  • Familiarity with AI tools, sales automation or CRM automations to improve efficiency

  • A degree in business, marketing, sales or a related field

 

What We Offer

  • NOK 10,000/year for professional development

  • Flexible working hours at our Tøyen office in Oslo

  • Choice of Mac or PC, plus your mobile phone and home broadband paid for

  • Regular workshops with partners like Google, Meta, and Microsoft

  • A supportive and social work environment with ambitious colleagues

  • A subsidised canteen with healthy lunch options

  • Social events throughout the year, including after-work drinks, team activities, and an annual company trip

 

Excited about this role?

We’d love to hear from you. Please apply via our career portal with your CV and cover letter.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

  • Application deadline: 8 November 2026

  • Employment type: Full-time

  • Work location: Oslo, Norway (Hybrid)

  • Start date: As soon as possible

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nettbureau builds online platforms that help people and businesses. For over a decade, we’ve connected users with great deals and suppliers with new customers in over 10 countries through lead generation. Our goal is to give users great deals to compare so they can make informed choices, while helping our suppliers to attract new customers. With recognition by the Financial Times in their list of “Europe’s Long-term Growth Champions” for 2025 and 2026, we’re focusing on sustainability and constantly improving every aspect of our services for our users, businesses and our team. Every year, we connect millions of users with our partners through bespoke technology designed to benefit both parties. Almost everything we do is built in-house, and we invest heavily in technology. We're a technology company, after all.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Resilient Service Continuity Across Mobile Networks
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Are you motivated to pursue a doctoral degree and explore how mobile networks can work together to keep critical services running when facing failures or congestion?

The Department of Information Security and Communication Technology (IIK) at NTNU has a vacancy for a PhD Candidate in Resilient Service Continuity Across Mobile Networks. As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a range of leading positions in business, administration, higher education and research.

The position is fully funded and will run for 4 years (100 % employment), including teaching duties. Your immediate leader will be the Head of Discipline, and the workplace will be in Trondheim.

About the project

Mobile networks increasingly support critical services in emergency response, industry, transport, and maritime operations. Access to several networks can improve resilience, but sustaining a service requires more than restoring connectivity. Independently operated networks must coordinate resources and priorities while managing dependencies and commitments to existing users. They may also depend on shared infrastructure or capacity leased from one another, limiting the resilience gained from access to multiple operators. Norway’s plans for a new emergency network (Nødnett) over commercial mobile infrastructure illustrate the relevance of these broader challenges.

As a PhD candidate, you will investigate how mobile networks can cooperate to maintain critical services during failures, congestion, and recovery. Your research will address networks that retain their own operational policies and exchange limited information about capacity and internal state, developing insights applicable across public and private networks. A specific focus will be on the networked systems mechanisms, data paths, and open interfaces needed to support resilient service continuity in multi-operator mobile network systems, addressing research questions such as:

  • What information must networks exchange to make effective admission and resource-allocation decisions without requiring full visibility into each other’s infrastructure?
  • How can service priorities and resource policies be coordinated across heterogeneous networks, including during congestion and large bursts of registration requests?
  • How can network selection, traffic steering, and recovery mechanisms maintain application continuity while avoiding repeated switching and overload cascades?
  • How do shared infrastructure, leased capacity, and dependencies between operators affect failure propagation and the resilience gained from alternative network access?

With the Beyond 5G lab at the department, the project will emphasize experimental systems research: you will have the opportunity to conduct your research in both commercial and open-source mobile network deployments and test your ideas under realistic conditions. To explore conditions beyond the scale of the physical deployments, methods including simulation and analytical modeling can be a complementary building block.

Duties of the position
  • Complete doctoral education and obtain a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the Networking research group
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Teaching in courses related to networking
  • Other career-enhancing work

Some changes to your work duties may occur after employment.

Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme in Information Security and Communication Technology, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
    • You must have a relevant master's degree in communication networks, wireless and mobile communications, information security and distributed systems, or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
    • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position and preferably within August 2027.
    • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
    • If you are in your master’s program, integrated PhD could be an option. Your MSc grades after your fourth year need to be completed with a grade B or better, in addition the IE-faculty require that your bachelor degree is completed with a grade C or better. Integrated PhD - Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering - NTNU.
  • Excellent oral and written presentation skills in English.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred selection criteria
  • Practical experience with 5G radio access and core deployments.
  • Hands-on experience with communication networks including multi-vendor and softwarized environments.
  • Exposure to resilience and dependability topics in the context of communication networks as part of the master’s curriculum.
  • Teaching experience, preferably at master’s level.
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language.
Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are

  • Highly motivated by fundamental scientific research with practical relevance.
  • Able to work independently.
  • Able to work in a structured way, set goals, and make plans to achieve them.
  • Eager to disseminate research results both locally as well as through publications and presentations at international conferences.

In the evaluation of which candidate is best qualified, emphasis will be placed on education, experience and personal suitability, as well as motivation, in terms of the qualifications specified in the advertisement.

We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK) 
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse, and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability, and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work in addition to one year of career promotion work.

The successful candidate will be granted conditional admission to the relevant doctoral programme when employed in the PhD position. It is a prerequisite for continued employment that the requirements for full admission are met within three months, and that you continue to participate in the organized doctoral programme for the remainder of the employment period. For more information about the requirements for full admission, please see Section 6 of the PhD regulations. 

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The application and all required attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no before the deadline. The documents must be in Norwegian, another Scandinavian language or English. 

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. If you are invited for an interview, you must present certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for bachelor's and master's degrees, including diploma supplement
  • CV filled out in Jobbnorge
  • Copy of master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • A scientific proposal (max. 1000 words / 3 pages, written in English) including a brief problem formulation, research questions, methodological approach, and an initial progress plan for the project.
  • Short letter of motivation (max. 400 words / 1 page)
  • Any publications or other relevant research work
  • Any relevant certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees

If all, or parts of, your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both bachelor's and master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution does not offer “diploma supplement”, you must attach information about the grading scale from the education institution. 

We further recommend that you enclose a statement about your education abroad from the Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir). Follow the link to their web site for more information about how to obtain such a statement: Apply for recognition of foreign higher education. See also NTNU’s web site for documentation requirements for education obtained outside Norway. 

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Stanislav Lange, e-mail: stanislav.lange@ntnu.no. 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact Senior Executive Officer HR Julie Lindland e-mail: julie.lindland@ntnu.no. 

Application deadline: 30.11.2026.

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage.

Le département :

L’équipe d’endoscopie digestive est une équipe dynamique qui se compose de médecins, d’infirmier.e.s, auxiliaire de stérilisation et d’agents d’accueil. La collaboration pluridisciplinaire est primordiale pour le bon déroulement des examens. 

Le patient est placé au centre des préoccupations, et l’accent mis sur la qualité des soins et l’expertise de l’équipe. Le médecin chef de service et l’infirmière responsable ont à cœur de développer une atmosphère de travail bienveillante, et de permettre à chacun de développer son expertise dans le domaine de l’endoscopie. 

Les examens suivants y sont réalisés¿:

  • Endoscopies diagnostics¿:
  • Gastroscopies

  • Echoendoscopies
  • Endoscopies interventionnelles¿: 
  • Cholangiographies rétrogrades
  • Echoendoscopies thérapeutiques
  • Dilatations de sténose du tube digestif
  • Mise en place de prothèses

  • Examens fonctionnels :

  • PH métrie et impédance métrie
  • Fibroscan
  • Autres¿:
  • Ponction-biopsie de foie transcutanée et transjugulaire
  • Proctologie simple et interventionnelle

L'infirmier.ère en endoscopie digestive y réalise les tâches suivantes :

  • Préparation des salles d’examens 
  • Préparation physique et psychologique du patient
  • Information et soutien du patient et de ses proches
  • Assistance des médecins et des anesthésistes (le cas échéant, pour les examens sous narcose) 
  • Surveillance du patient après l’examen
  • Entretien des endoscopes
  • Gestion des programmes d'endoscopie 
  • Gestion des stocks et commandes de matériel.

Profil recherché :

  • Être titulaire d’un bachelier en soins infirmier
  • Une expérience en plateau technique d'endoscopie est un réel atout
  • Disposer d’une expérience en milieu hospitalier est un réel atout
  • Satisfaire aux conditions légales de bilinguisme : vous avez de bonnes connaissances de la seconde langue nationale ou vous êtes disposé à les acquérir (cours de langues organisés en interne sur le temps de travail, possibilité d’obtenir une prime de bilinguisme SELOR de 150€ bruts sous réserve de la remise du Selor Art. 10)
  • Satisfaire à l’examen de promotion ou à l’examen de sélection.

Qualités requises :

  • Vous êtes ponctuel, rigoureux.se et organisé dans votre travail
  • Vous faites preuve de responsabilité et d’autonomie
  • Vous appréciez le travail en équipe
  • Vous êtes résistant au stress
  • Vous savez rassurer et apporter du soutien aux patients et à leurs proches.
  • Vous êtes flexible et vous pouvez vous adapter aux besoins du travail
  • Vous disposez de bonnes connaissances organisationnelles
  • Vous appréciez travailler au sein d’une équipe interdisciplinaire et collaborer avec tous les partenaires impliqués dans les prises en charge.

Le CHU Saint-Pierre est un hôpital public et universitaire de référence, offrant des soins de grande qualité accessibles à tous.

Dans ce cadre, il relève quotidiennement les défis de la santé publique tout en déclinant son caractère universitaire via une implication active dans l’enseignement et la recherche.

Les chiffres clés qui caractérisent l’hôpital sont les suivants :

  • 450.000 consultations/an
  • 45.000 admissions/an
  • 23.000 opérations chirurgicales/an
  • 85.000 passages aux urgences/an
  • 2900 accouchements/an
  • 3200 collaborateurs dont 400 médecins

Le respect, l’innovation, l’engagement, la qualité et la solidarité sont les valeurs clés de l’hôpital. Toutes et tous s’attèlent à placer le patient au centre de leur action. Les réponses aux réalités sociales, la tolérance, le libre-examen et la capacité à se mobiliser au quotidien pour les patients, bruxellois et non-bruxellois, sont les moteurs de ses actions.

La quête de l’excellence en médecine de pointe et l’approche multidisciplinaire, font de l’hôpital une référence sur le plan national.

Le CHU St Pierre travaille également en étroite collaboration avec de nombreux partenaires comme les médecins généralistes, médecins spécialistes référents, les CPAS et les autres institutions d’aides et de soins en Région bruxelloise.

Travailler au CHU Saint-Pierre, c’est à la fois faire partie d’un hôpital ancré dans la Ville depuis plusieurs siècles et d’un réseau hospitalier moderne en développement rapide, CHORUS, plus grand réseau hospitalier en Belgique. Travailler au CHU Saint-Pierre, c’est faire partie d’un groupe soudé, soutenant, au sein duquel chaque personne a sa place, afin d’offrir un service optimal. La satisfaction de nos patients et notre bien-être au travail sont nos priorités.
