jobs.title: DIRECTEUR D'HÔTEL - H/F
jobs.description: Description :Au sein de la franchise Best Western Plus, nous recherchons un(e) Directeur / Directrice pour notre hôtel 4 étoiles de 48 chambres, situé dans le 12e arrondissement de Paris.L'établissement fait partie du portefeuille hôtelier de Square Groupe, société d'investissement indépendante spécialisée dans le développement et la gestion d'actifs hôteliers.L'hôtel s'apprête à connaître une rénovation complète, offrant une belle opportunité de participer à la transformation de l'établissement et de contribuer à une expérience client renouvelée.En lien avec la Responsable des opérations du siège, vous assurez la gestion globale de l'hôtel, le management des équipes et le suivi de sa performance opérationnelle, commerciale et financière. VOS MISSIONS : 1. GESTION OPÉRATIONNELLE ET MANAGEMENT * Assurer le bon fonctionnement quotidien de l'établissement et coordonner les différents services : réception, étages et petit-déjeuner. * Encadrer, accompagner et fédérer les équipes au quotidien. * Participer au recrutement, à l'intégration et à la formation des collaborateurs. * Organiser les plannings et veiller à l'adéquation des ressources avec l'activité. * Assurer le lien avec le siège, les propriétaires et les divers interlocuteurs. * Veiller à l'application des procédures et à la conformité aux standards de la marque, notamment dans le cadre des audits qualité. 2. QUALITÉ ET EXPÉRIENCE CLIENT * Garantir une qualité de service conforme aux standards d'un établissement 4 étoiles. * Assurer le suivi des réclamations et la mise en œuvre des actions correctives. * Superviser le traitement des avis clients et les réponses sur les différentes plateformes. * Suivre les indicateurs de satisfaction et déployer des actions d'amélioration continue. 3. HÉBERGEMENT ET HOUSEKEEPING * Superviser l'entretien et la propreté des chambres et des parties communes. * Organiser et contrôler les plans de nettoyage et les procédures qualité. * Coordonner les prestations de la gouvernante, des équipes d'étage et des prestataires. * Assurer le suivi des inventaires de linge, des produits d'accueil et des consommables. 4. PETIT-DÉJEUNER * Garantir la qualité de l'offre et le respect des standards Best Western Plus. * Superviser les commandes, les stocks et les inventaires. * Veiller à l'application des règles d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire, notamment HACCP. * Contribuer à l'amélioration de l'expérience client et à la maîtrise des coûts. 5. MAINTENANCE ET SUIVI TECHNIQUE * Veiller au bon état général de l'établissement et au confort des clients. * Coordonner les interventions techniques et assurer le suivi des prestataires. * Suivre le calendrier des contrats de maintenance et les opérations préventives. * Participer, en lien avec le siège, au suivi du projet de rénovation et à la préparation de la mise en service des espaces rénovés. 6. GESTION COMMERCIALE ET FINANCIÈREEn lien avec la Responsable des opérations du siège : * Participer à l'élaboration et au suivi du budget de l'établissement. * Analyser les indicateurs de performance : chiffre d'affaires, taux d'occupation, prix moyen, RevPAR et rentabilité. * Suivre la stratégie tarifaire et les actions de revenue management. * Optimiser la distribution et la commercialisation de l'hôtel sur les différents canaux de vente. * Développer la notoriété de l'établissement et les partenariats locaux. * Suivre les notes et commentaires sur les OTA et les plateformes de la marque. * Proposer et mettre en œuvre des plans d'action pour améliorer les résultats. 7. GESTION ADMINISTRATIVE * Veiller au respect des obligations réglementaires, des normes de sécurité et des procédures internes. * Superviser les achats, les commandes et le suivi des stocks. * Contrôler les bons de livraison et les factures. * Transmettre les éléments nécessaires aux services comptabilité et paie. * Assurer un reporting régulier auprès du siège.VOTRE PROFIL : * Vous justifiez idéalement d'au moins deux ans d'expérience en direction d'hôtel ou disposez d'une expérience significative en direction adjointe avec une forte autonomie opérationnelle. * Vous possédez une bonne connaissance de l'exploitation hôtelière et des standards de qualité d'un établissement 3 ou 4 étoiles. * Vous maîtrisez les fondamentaux du management, de la gestion budgétaire et du revenue management. * Vous êtes à l'aise avec les PMS, channel managers et outils de réservation. * Vous faites preuve de leadership, de rigueur, d'autonomie et d'un bon sens des priorités. * Vous avez le goût du terrain, le sens du service client et une réelle capacité à fédérer les équipes. * Vous maitrisez le français et l'angalis (oral et écrit)POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE? * Prendre la direction d'un établissement à taille humaine, avec une vision globale de son exploitation. * Participer à la transformation d'un hôtel grâce à un projet de rénovation complète. * Bénéfi...

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Product Support Manager will be responsible for leading a team of Product Support Specialists in Hyderabad. You will collaborate closely with the Hyderabad Site Lead, regional Heads of Support, and User Operations leadership to ensure cohesive product support operations across the global team. This role will surface customer and product usage trends, drive resolution for executive-level product escalations, and continuously improve global support and escalation processes. The successful candidate should bring deep expertise in product support and escalation management, including experience driving process improvements and collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams.

They will also have strong experience managing a high-performing team of product support specialists across multiple levels, ensuring timely issue resolution, operational excellence, and a seamless customer experience.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Collaborate closely with the Hyderabad Site Lead, regional Heads of Support, and User Operations leadership to ensure cohesive Product Support operations across the global organization.

 - This role will support the growth and maturity of product support programs by identifying areas of improvement, partnering with Product and Engineering teams to refine support processes, policies, and tooling, and serving as one of the drivers of product support excellence within Customer Experience (CX).

 - Manage executive-level product escalations end-to-end, including stakeholder communication, customer updates, and coordination with global product and engineering teams to drive timely and effective resolution.

 - The successful candidate should have deep product support expertise, strong experience driving process improvements, and a proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally, along with experience managing and developing high-performing teams of product support specialists across multiple levels.

 - Analyze data regularly and drive continuous improvement.

 - Maintain and report on KPIs and provide ad hoc reporting as necessary.

 - Proactively identify areas for improvement and own the implementation of necessary changes to CX support processes. Own, coordinate and ship process improvements in collaboration with the User Ops, and influence on behalf of CX for cross-functionally owned processes and tools.

 - Participate in the global on-call rotation to cover incidents.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 8+ years of work experience in Product support team of a software company.

 - 3+ years of work experience in leading and managing a Product support team.

 - You have deep understanding of the nuance of managing product support and executive escalations, and can apply that to improve the customer experience.

 - You are extremely user-focused, with a passion for solving problems that increase the user quality of life for customers.

 - You are deeply passionate about developing others, finding energy and purpose in mentoring team members to reach their full potential, and taking pride in seeing them thrive under your leadership.

 - Strong technical support foundations, including log reading and basic debugging, core API concepts, webhook fundamentals, and SSO basics (OAuth and SAML).

 - Proficiency in incorporating AI into day-to-day work (e.g., drafting and refining customer responses, summarizing context, analyzing trends, and accelerating troubleshooting) while applying strong judgment, privacy, and quality standards.

 - Proven ability to triage, troubleshoot, and handle support tickets end-to-end, including prioritization/severity judgment, clear written communication, and timely stakeholder updates.

 - You have strong data reporting and data analytics skills.

 - Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

 - Experience handling business intelligence tools and systems such as Salesforce, Zendesk, Hex, Looker.

 - Experience building robust and scalable processes spanning across go-to-market and technical teams.

 - Ability to deep dive and own projects individually while also delegating and empowering team members to deliver.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience working in a fast-paced start-up environment

 - You are familiar with and/or a user of Notion

jobs.description: Les soins continus et palliatifs s'adressent aux personnes atteintes d'une maladie sévère, évolutive et pour laquelle les traitements curatifs ont atteint leurs limites, quel que soit l'âge ou la pathologie. Leur objectif est d'améliorer la qualité de vie en soulageant les symptômes et en apportant un soutien global, médical, psychologique, social et spirituel. Ils privilégient le confort et le mieux-être, sans exclure les ressources de la médecine moderne lorsque celles-ci contribuent à cet objectif. Les soins palliatifs reposent sur une approche respectueuse de la personne, considérée dans sa globalité, en l'associant aux décisions qui la concernent et en tenant compte de son rythme, de ses valeurs et de ses projets. Ils ne sont pas réservés à la fin de vie et peuvent être proposés plus tôt dans l'évolution de la maladie, parfois en complément de traitements visant à en ralentir la progression.En nous rejoignant, vous participez à la démarche d'amélioration continue de notre hôpital au travers de vos missions d'infirmier :- Vous établissez un diagnostic infirmier et le validez en collaboration avec le patient et ses proches- Vous élaborez la programmation des soins pour chaque patient en adéquation avec le projet de soins et procédez à son évaluation- Vous appliquez toutes les mesures de préventions requises envers les patients afin d'éviter l'apparition d'évènements sentinelles- Vous faites preuve de créativité, de réflexion et êtes acteur de changement au sein de votre équipe- Vous établissez et maintenez des relations conviviales avec le patient, ses proches, les membres de l'équipe pluridisciplinaire et les autres services de l'hôpital  Qualifications - Diplôme d'infirmier-ère bachelier-ère ou breveté-e- Maîtrise du français (niveau B2 minimum)- Aisance avec les outils informatiques de base Compétences clés- Esprit d'équipe et capacité à travailler en collaboration- Excellentes capacités d'observation et de raisonnement clinique- Rigueur, sens de l'organisation et priorisation des soins- Capacité à accompagner les patient-e-s dans leur projet- Intérêt pour la formation et l'encadrement des étudiant-e-sUne spécialisation en oncologie et/ou du certificat en soins palliatifs est un réel atout- Maîtrise d'une autre langue (néerlandais, anglais.)

jobs.title: Critical Operations Technician - Switzerland
jobs.description:
The Role

As part of the local Critical Operations Team, Critical Operations Technicians (COT) ensure the data center is operating smoothly and efficiently 24/7/365, with no downtime of critical services. Critical Operations Technicians are responsible for the inspection, operation and maintenance of all equipment associated with the data center. They are expected to be technically strong with great troubleshooting abilities and a desire to learn and work in a demanding yet rewarding team environment. The Critical Operations Team's on-site presence is organized in a 24/7 shift schedule, ensuring coverage at all hours of the day, year-round.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform operational, preventive, and corrective maintenance on all mechanical and electrical equipment as assigned.

  • Conduct daily and weekly routine inspections on critical equipment, rooms, and systems, ensuring compliance with quality and efficiency standards.

  • Monitor, respond to, and act on alarms from Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Management Systems (EPMS), and other monitoring tools.

  • Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical systems, interpreting diagrams and schematics to detect, repair, and report faulty equipment or unusual conditions.

  • Carry out isolation and reinstatement of electrical, cooling, fire alarm, and gas suppression systems when required and authorized.

  • Manage and react to emergency situations involving critical equipment, escalating incidents according to established processes and procedures.

  • Ensure all plant equipment operates at maximum efficiency and in compliance with industry best practices and regulations.

  • Escort personnel when required for security or operational reasons (e.g. clients and vendors).

  • Ensure compliance with housekeeping rules, facility manuals, and service agreements, managing vendor reports and follow-ups.

  • Maintain accurate logs of completed and pending work in the Facility Management System.

  • Support the preparation of technical work quotations and execution of assigned projects and programs.

  • Maintain proper storage of documentation related to building infrastructure, systems, and tools.

  • Participate in ongoing training, development, and drills to stay updated in relevant disciplines.

  • Ensure a proper handover of relevant information within the team as needed.

 

Job Practicalities / Skills, Knowledge, Experience and Qualifications

  • Preferably in possession of trade certificate and/or vocational education degree within Electrical or Mechanical discipline or equivalent.

  • Preferably experienced with electrical or mechanical systems in a critical environment and/or within a data center.

  • In-depth knowledge of various maintenance fundamentals to deal with service and repairs.

  • Ability to perform a range of complex work activities with some degree of personal responsibility and autonomy.

  • Ability to work alone or collaboratively in a team.

  • Attention to detail while maintaining a broad perspective

  • Desire and ability to learn new skills and systems.

  • Effective interpersonal skills for collaboration with vendors and clients.

  • IT and computer skills (MS Office suite) with ability to work in and learn various operating software tools and systems.

  • Good written and verbal skills in English and local language (German/Scandinavian/French/Italian languages are a plus).

  • Service-oriented mindset with a focus on client satisfaction.

 

Preferred start date: November 2026. However, an earlier start date may be discussed and arranged depending on the candidate's availability.

 

All applications will be treated confidentially.

jobs.title: Capacitaire / Référent du projet animalier (H/F)
jobs.description: Le Parc Animalier de Sainte-Croix entre dans une nouvelle étape de son histoire. Après 45 ans d'engagement pour le vivant, le parc a souhaité restructurer en profondeur son pôle animalier afin d'en faire un modèle de transmission, de conservation et de bien-être animal, fruit d'une nouvelle d'organisation. Depuis 2 ans nous restructurons le service avec un nouveau cadre managérial de proximité engagé et compétent, des équipes stables et un projet en construction.   Notre ambition est claire : Reconnecter toutes les générations au vivant, dans le respect des animaux et des écosystèmes, pour transformer le regard de nos visiteurs sur la nature. Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un capacitaire capable d'accompagner cette transformation, non pas uniquement comme garant réglementaire, mais comme référent structurant d'un projet animalier ambitieux. Le projet :Le pôle animalier de Sainte-Croix a engagé un travail de restructuration autour de plusieurs priorités : - Clarifier les rôles et responsabilités de chacun - Renforcer l'autonomie des responsables de secteur et des équipes - Structurer les procédures, les circuits de décision et les validations - Faire monter les équipes en compétence - Développer une culture forte du bien-être animal - Mieux intégrer les projets d'élevage, de conservation et de réintroduction ; - Accompagner l'évolution des infrastructures et des enclos ; - Donner davantage de sens, de cadre et de fluidité au quotidien animalier. Ce travail s'inscrit dans la continuité de l'accompagnement mené avec Brice Lefaux, qui a permis de poser un diagnostic, d'identifier les axes de progrès et d'engager une nouvelle dynamique collective.  La mission :- être le garant du cadre réglementaire, sécuritaire et animalier du parc. - veiller à ce que les décisions prises soient conformes aux obligations liées à la détention et à la présentation au public d'animaux sauvages, tout en permettant à l'organisation de gagner en maturité et en autonomie.    Sous la responsabilité directe de la Direction du parc, vous rejoindrez le pôle animalier, une équipe pluridisciplinaire d'une trentaine de collaborateurs composée de vétérinaires, d'un chef de service, de managers de proximité et de soigneurs animaliers. Le poste ne comporte pas de missions de gestion administrative ni d'encadrement d'équipe.  Votre rôle est de poser le cadre, sécuriser les décisions importantes, transmettre votre expertise dans des réflexions collectives et accompagner la montée en compétence et responsabilité des équipes. Et notamment : - Faire partie du comité de direction avec votre expertise et un bon niveau d'autonomie. - Participer à la conception du Master Plan. Nous recherchons une personne capable de conjuguer exigence réglementaire, expertise zoologique et intelligence collective. Vous devrez accompagner Sainte-Croix dans la nouvelle étape du pôle animalier : être une équipe exemplaire, structurée, responsable et pleinement alignée avec la raison d'être du parc. Vous devrez également :- être titulaire du Certificat de capacité adapté aux espèces concernées. - justifier d'une solide expérience en parc zoologique. - posséder un bon niveau d'autonomie. - Très bonne connaissance du bien-être animal, de la sécurité et des obligations réglementaires. - Capacité à travailler de manière transverse avec une direction, une responsable zoologique, des responsables de secteur et des équipes terrain. - Goût pour la transmission, la structuration et l'accompagnement du changement. - Capacité à déléguer et à faire grandir les équipes. - Sensibilité forte aux enjeux de conservation, d'éducation et de reconnexion au vivant. Vous ne serez pas seulement le garant d'un cadre, vous serez l'un des artisans d'une nouvelle organisation au service des animaux, des équipes et de la mission du parc.

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Joensuun seudulle
jobs.description: **Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Joensuun seudulle.**Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.**Tarjoamme sinulle**- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A - Joustavan työajan - Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan - Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan - Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen - Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin **Toivomme sinulta**- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan - Positiivista ja iloista asennetta - Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi - Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain **48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa** sekä **55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä**. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteensosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi**Rekrytoinnin eteneminen**Panostamme siihen, että rekrytointi on reilua ja että juuri sinun osaamisesi pääsee esiin. Tässä rekrytoinnissa hyödynnämme **Hubert.ai -tekoälyhaastattelua.**Hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen sinut kutsutaan chat-pohjaiseen haastatteluun virtuaalisen rekrytointiassistenttimme Hubertin kanssa. Haastattelu kestää noin 15-20 minuuttia, ja voit tehdä sen sinulle sopivana aikana. Suosittelemme kuitenkin aloittamaan sen pian, jotta rekrytointi etenee sujuvasti. Tekoälypohjainen haastattelu toimii vain tukityökaluna, kaikki lopulliset arviot ja päätökset tekee ihminen.

jobs.title: Verpleegkundige mobiel pediatrisch team: hospit, spoed, neonatologie & consult – FT/PT  2026-050
jobs.description:
Afdeling :

Het mobiele team van de pediatrische pool telt 5,5 VTE. De verpleegkundige van het mobiele team binnen de pediatrische pool heeft als opdracht de continuïteit van de zorg te verzekeren in de afdelingen waar er tekorten in het kader zijn of waar de werkbelasting aanzienlijk is, en om de seizoensgebondenheid van deze specialiteit op te vangen.

Hiervoor wordt een opleidingsprogramma aangeboden dat wordt aangepast aan de noden. U blijft onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de hoofdverpleegkundige van de hospitalisatieafdeling 509-609, die tijdens de herfst- en winterperiode de belangrijkste doelafdeling zal zijn. Tijdens de rest van het jaar valt u onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de hoofdverpleegkundige van de afdeling waar u wordt ingezet voor middellange, lange of kortere vervangingen.

Functie :

  • U gebruikt een klinische benadering gebaseerd op vraagstelling, onderzoek en analyse.
  • U grijpt nauwkeurig, snel en doordacht in, zowel in acute als niet-acute situaties.
  • U voert soms complexe technische handelingen uit — autonoom, op voorschrift of toevertrouwd — met respect voor de procedures, zowel bij kinderen met een levensbedreigend risico als bij stabielere patiënten.
  • U gebruikt gespecialiseerde, al dan niet gesofisticeerde apparatuur specifiek voor de pediatrie, bedoeld om vitale functies te ondersteunen of om een ziek kind te behandelen.
  • U bent in staat prioriteiten te bepalen en zo nodig dringende maatregelen te nemen.
  • U zorgt voor communicatie naar de patiënt en zijn/haar ouders via informatie en educatie.
  • U onderhoudt een nauwe samenwerking met uw collega's om continuïteit en kwaliteit te garanderen.
  • U investeert in uw opleiding en in uw professionele ontwikkeling.

Gezocht profiel

  • In het bezit zijn van een Bachelor in de verpleegkunde én van een specialisatie in de pediatrie
  • Relevante ervaring binnen een afdeling van de pediatrische pool is een troef
  • Voldoen aan de wettelijke voorwaarden van tweetaligheid (geslaagde Selor-proef) : u hebt een goede kennis van de tweede landstaal of u bent bereid die te verwerven (intern georganiseerde taalcursussen tijdens de werkuren, mogelijkheid om een Selorpremie voor tweetaligheid van € 150 bruto te krijgen mits u het taalcertificaat van Selor artikel 10 kunt voorleggen).
  • Slagen voor het selectie- of bevorderingsexamen
  • Voldoen aan de gevraagde kwaliteiten voor de functie

Vereiste kwaliteiten:

  • U bent flexibel en beschikt over een groot aanpassingsvermogen
  • U kan goed in team werken
  • U bent nauwkeurig en georganiseerd
  • U kan onverwachte situaties beheersen
  • U werkt autonoom
  • U investeert in uw opleiding en in uw professionele ontwikkeling
  • U beschikt over sociale vaardigheden en kan vlot communiceren met patiënten en hun naasten, en hen informeren over hun gezondheidstoestand.

Het UMC Sint-Pieter is een openbaar en universitair referentieziekenhuis waar iedereen voor kwalitatief hoogstaande zorg terechtkan.

Dagelijks gaan wij uitdagingen aan betreffende volksgezondheid en blijven we trouw aan ons universitaire karakter door actief te investeren in onderzoek en onderwijs.

Het ziekenhuis kan de volgende sleutelcijfers voorleggen:

  • 450.000 raadplegingen per jaar
  • 45.000 opnames per jaar,
  • 23.000 chirurgische ingrepen/jaar
  • 85.000 bezoeken aan de spoeddienst/jaar
  • 2900 bevallingen/jaar
  • 3200 medewerkers inbegrepen 400 artsen

Respect, innovatie, inzet, kwaliteit en solidariteit zijn de kernwaarden van het ziekenhuis. Voor iedereen staat de patiënt centraal. De antwoorden op sociale realiteiten, tolerantie, vrije meningen en het vermogen om zich dagelijks in te zetten voor de, Brusselse en niet-Brusselse, patiënten zijn de drijfveren van iedere medewerker.

Het streven naar medische uitmuntendheid en multidisciplinaire benadering maken van het ziekenhuis een nationale referentie.

Het UMC Sint-Pieter werkt ook nauw samen met diverse partners, zoals huisartsen, referentiespecialisten, OCMW's en andere hulp- en zorginstellingen in het Brussels Gewest.

Werken in het UMC Sint-Pieter betekent deel uitmaken van een ziekenhuis dat al enkele eeuwen in de stad verankerd is en tegelijk ook van een modern ziekenhuisnetwerk in volle ontwikkeling, CHORUS, het grootste ziekenhuisnetwerk in België.

Binnen het UMC Sint-Pieter heerst er een hechte, ondersteunende sfeer waarin iedereen zijn plaats heeft om een optimale service te bieden. De tevredenheid van onze patiënten en het welzijn op het werk van onze medewerkers zijn onze prioriteiten.

Offre:

Aanbod

We bieden je een salaris in overeenstemming met je opleidingsniveau en ervaring, maaltijdcheques en een grote bijdrage in de kosten voor openbaar vervoer. Bovendien genieten jij en de mensen die met je samenwonen van voorkeurstarieven voor medische zorg in ziekenhuizen van het IRIS-netwerk.

Vergoedingsschaal

  • IFIC-functie: Verpleegkundige mobiel team pediatrie (6169)
  • IFIC-categorie: 15 – geactiveerd
  • Barema (sociale charter): BH’1/2/3 of BHSP’1/2/3

• Extralegale voordelen:

  • maaltijdcheques ter waarde van € 7,30;
  • voorkeurstarieven voor medische zorg in alle ziekenhuizen van het Irisnet (voor u, uw partner, uw familieleden ten laste in opgaande of neergaande lijn); 
  • gratis MIVB-abonnement of/en een tussenkomst (80 %) in de kosten voor het overige openbaar vervoer en/of een fietsvergoeding en een jaarlijkse aanmoedigingspremie; 
  • een jaarlijkse aanmoedigingspremie; 
  • een eindejaarspremie;
  • een maandelijkse tweetaligheidspremie van € 150 bruto (op voorwaarde dat u het taalcertificaat van Selor artikel 10 kunt voorleggen);
  • 24 wettelijke vakantiedagen en 5 extralegale vakantiedagen (+ verschillende dagen omstandigheidsverlof);
  • Kortingen bij tal van leveranciers via het Benefits@work-systeem.
  • talrijke carrièremogelijkheden binnen een groot netwerk (Irisnet);
  • een integratietraject op maat om u te ondersteunen in uw nieuwe functie;
  • een opleidingsprogramma dat u de kans biedt om te groeien in uw loopbaan.
  • Een pensioenverzekering (1 tot 3% ten laste van de werkgever)

jobs.title: CHAUFFEUR CAMION-GRUE EXPÉRIMENTÉ
jobs.description:
Vous êtes chauffeur poids lourds, expérimenté dans la manipulation d'un camion-grue, et vous appréciez les missions qui allient conduite, manutention et contact clientèle ?

Vous recherchez une opportunité professionnelle stable au sein d'une entreprise dynamique ?

PROMAN Jobs Charleroi recrute un Chauffeur camion-grue expérimenté (H/F/X) pour l'un de ses clients, une entreprise active dans la distribution de matériaux destinés aux professionnels de la construction.

VOTRE MISSION

En tant que chauffeur camion-grue, vous assurez le transport et la livraison de marchandises sur différents chantiers, tout en garantissant la sécurité des opérations et la satisfaction des clients.

Vos principales responsabilités :

  • Assurer le chargement et le déchargement des camions dans le respect des règles de sécurité, d'arrimage et de répartition des charges.

  • Effectuer les livraisons de matériaux directement sur les chantiers et auprès des clients professionnels.

  • Manipuler la grue auxiliaire du camion pour assurer le déchargement des marchandises.

  • Contrôler les marchandises lors des opérations de chargement et de déchargement.

  • Vérifier l'état général du véhicule avant chaque départ.

  • Veiller au bon entretien et à la propreté du camion et de ses équipements.

  • Compléter les documents administratifs liés aux transports et aux livraisons.

  • Respecter les règles de circulation, de sécurité et les procédures internes.

  • Assurer un contact professionnel et courtois avec les clients lors des livraisons.

VOTRE PROFIL

Vous êtes un chauffeur expérimenté, autonome et particulièrement attentif à la sécurité.

  • Vous possédez une expérience concluante dans la conduite et la manipulation d'un camion-grue.

  • Vous maîtrisez l'utilisation d'une grue auxiliaire de type Palfinger, Fassi, HMF ou équivalent.

  • Vous disposez du permis C ; le permis CE constitue un atout important.

  • Vous êtes en ordre de CAP (Code 95), de sélection médicale et de carte tachygraphe.

  • Vous possédez idéalement un brevet de cariste frontal et/ou retrack.

  • Vous maîtrisez les techniques de chargement, de déchargement et d'arrimage des marchandises.

  • Vous êtes attentif aux règles de sécurité et privilégiez une conduite préventive et responsable.

  • Vous êtes autonome, organisé, rigoureux et flexible.

  • Vous appréciez le contact avec la clientèle et possédez un véritable sens du service.

  • Vous êtes respectueux du matériel et des équipements mis à votre disposition.

Une connaissance des matériaux de construction constitue un avantage.

NOTRE OFFRE

  • Une mission intérimaire avec perspective d'engagement fixe, si la collaboration est concluante.

  • Une fonction polyvalente combinant conduite, manipulation de grue et contact clientèle.

  • Un environnement professionnel dynamique au sein d'une entreprise active dans un secteur porteur.

  • Une fonction offrant autonomie et responsabilités.

  • Une rémunération et des avantages à préciser selon les conditions applicables et votre expérience.

  • Une opportunité de collaboration à long terme.

INTÉRESSÉ(E) ?

Vous êtes chauffeur poids lourds et possédez une solide expérience dans la manipulation d'un camion-grue ?

jobs.title: Hepatologist
jobs.description: At Sahlgrenska University Hospital, we work together to provide the highest quality of care with the patient at the center. Our great commitment and continuous learning make us one of the country's leading university hospitals. We provide everything from county healthcare to national highly specialized care. We focus on the future of healthcare through exciting research. We care about digital skills and everyone's contribution to the digital development. Our work is about using our collected knowledge and experiences together with you – to create value for our patients.We are transforming healthcare with the ambition of becoming Europe’s leading university hospital by 2032. In partnership with our patients, we work to ensure quality, accessibility, patient safety, research, education, and innovation within an integrated healthcare system across the Västra Götaland Region in Sweden.Sahlgrenska University Hospital is one of Northern Europe's largest hospitals with over 17,000 colleagues who have different experience and backgrounds.About usThe Department of Gastroenterology and Hepatology at Sahlgrenska University Hospital (SU) is one of the largest in the Nordic region. We provide emergency and scheduled outpatient care, and have close collaboration with other departments including upper and lower GI surgery, and transplantation surgery.The department is organized into teams focusing on hepatologic outpatient care, gastroenterologic outpatient care, endoscopy, intestinal failure unit, and an inpatient ward. The department is actively involved in ongoing research across several fields and has a strong emphasis on education, continuing professional development, and the ongoing advancement of clinical services.What can we offer? As a Specialist Physician/Senior Consultant at the Department of Gastroenterology and Hepatolgy at Sahlgrenska university Hospital, you will have excellent opportunities for professional development and research. You will work within our subspecialty teams alongside ambitious and friendly colleagues, with close collaboration with the transplantation unit.The department has a high patient volume, providing extensive opportunities for both clinical practice and research.Our goal is to provide the highest possible standard of care for our patients. We place great importance on supporting each individual's professional development according to their interests, strengths, and career goals, while also enabling them to influence their working environment.About the RoleYou will work with the assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of patients requiring specialized care in hepatology in both emergency and elective settings. Your duties will include working in the outpatient clinic, inpatient ward, and at the liver transplant unit, as well as participation during office hours and on-call duties.Teaching and supervising less experienced colleagues, medical students, and healthcare professionals is an integral part of the role. You will also be expected to take an active part in the department’s quality improvement, development, and change initiatives, as well as in research activities.About YouWe are looking for a board-certified senior consultant in Gastroenterology and Hepatology with a high level of expertise in hepatology. You should be interested in both your own professional development and contributing to the advancement of care at one of the largest university hospitals in the Nordic region. You work well within a team and have a strong interest in liver disease.We value strong communication and collaboration skills. You are able to apply newly acquired knowledge in your clinical practice, make sound clinical judgments, and thrive in a fast-paced work environment. We are seeking a motivated and independent individual with the ability and interest to take overall responsibility and place the patient's needs at the center of care.Ongoing research activities and/or a doctoral degree (PhD) are considered meritorious.Great emphasis will be placed on personal suitability.Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis throughout the recruitment period.We warmly welcome your application!Together for the patient - Sahlgrenska UniversitetssjukhusetIn the event of recruiting a physician or nurse with a foreign medical license and/or specialist certification, the appointment will be preceded by the necessary process to fulfill the requirements for Swedish licensure and/or specialist recognition.About Region Västra GötalandRegion Västra Götaland is there for the people of Västra Götaland. We ensure good quality healthcare for everyone. jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
jobs.description: Priority deadline: October 27. Complete the short form at https://forms.office.com/e/AaqXdKeeWn, then email your CV to kimberly@stillart.com with the subject line "EA application, FULL NAME." STILLART · FULL TIME · SOUTHERN FINLAND, WITH WEEKLY TIME IN PERSONFor two decades, StillArt has helped orchestras and arts organizations fill their halls. The company works. What it needs now is someone to protect the mind behind it.A COMPANY ON SOLID GROUND StillArt (Finland) and its associated companies are established and profitable, with about €2 million in annual turnover, a team of four, and two dozen suppliers in a dozen countries. Unique products and clear plans for international growth mean this role grows as the companies do.THE ROLE As Executive Assistant, you guard the CEO's energy, momentum and focus, so his hours go where they are worth the most: winning clients, solving the problems only the CEO can solve, building the brand and starting what comes next. Everything that pulls him out of that zone, you take, and you take it so well he never has to look back. This is not a role for someone who waits for instructions. It is a partnership. You lead the daily rhythm, you arrive with the agenda, and within three months you are anticipating the next move.WHAT YOU WILL OWN This is a role with real ownership. From your first weeks, these are yours: The inbox. You triage, decide and reply, so only what truly needs the CEO reaches him. The calendar. You manage scheduling across the companies in the group, guard focus time and prepare the week ahead. Follow-through. Loose ends close because you close them, with the team, leads and clients. Momentum. You keep notes, actions and the project list moving, so the best ideas actually get implemented. Travel and events. Conferences, flights and hotels arranged to a high standard. Purchases and payments. Handled correctly, within limits the CEO sets. Voice and visibility. Social posts and copy coordinated with the right people. The daily rhythm. A short morning check-in and an end-of-day hand-off that previews tomorrow's one big thing. Planning together. You plan and prioritize alongside the CEO, with more independence as trust grows, and you serve as a sounding board when it is time to decide which ideas earn traction now.WHY THIS ROLE IS SOUGHT AFTER A seat beside the founder. You work directly with the CEO, close enough to shape the company's next chapter. A role built with you. The scope is designed around the person who takes it, and you carry the responsibility to build it. A 90-day path. A structured training program, in three stages, so you are never left guessing how to be impactful.WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR Calm in motion. Steady when plans change fast. Proactive by instinct. You see what needs doing before you are asked. Curious and always learning. New tools, new products, new markets, new ways of working, including AI. The CEO has a voracious appetite for learning. Entrepreneurial at heart. At home in a founder-led company where change moves quickly, and energized by growth. Experienced and discerning. You have run a busy executive's day before, as an executive assistant or in a similar supporting role, and senior team members take you seriously. Strong with people. A real listener who makes a room feel safe. You guide as much as you assist. Trusted with what matters. Discreet with sensitive information, trusted with visibility of company and personal money, and comfortable with finance basics. Careful with detail. You would rather get it right than get it fast. To show us, add the word intern to the last field on the application form. Fluent in Microsoft tools. StillArt runs on Microsoft 365, including Planner, OneDrive, Outlook and Copilot. You work in it with ease and, ideally, help the team get more out of it by showing how our processes can be set up. Warm, with boundaries. Helpful and friendly, and honest about what is sustainable. Culture oriented. You care about the arts and about being of service to arts organizations. Experience in the arts is a plus. At home across languages and cultures. English is a must. German is a strong advantage, as this is StillArt's long term target market. Swedish (the CEO's mother tongue) and Finnish (the dominant language of the home country) are valued, and other languages are welcome as the company grows globally.WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT This role guards the CEO's time. It does not carry the sales pipeline, own bookkeeping or financial modeling, or run operations or manage the team. Those sit in other seats at StillArt.THE DETAILS Employer: StillArt Limited Ab Employment: Employee, full time, Monday to Friday, working roughly 9:00 to 17:00 Helsinki time Target start: Mid-November 2026 Location: Ideally based in Finland, able to meet in person once a week in Porvoo. Candidates living elsewhere in the EU, EEA or Switzerland are encouraged to apply. Working style: Mostly remote, with regular time in person, ideally weekly Salary range: €3,500 to €4,500 gross per month, depending on experience and languages. Open to more for a candidate who clearly shows the added value they bring.HOW TO APPLY Apply through the short form here: https://forms.office.com/e/AaqXdKeeWn. It takes about 10 minutes. After you submit it, please email your CV to kimberly@stillart.com with the role and your full name in the subject line. Example: EA application, FULL NAME. We review applications once both arrive, so early applications are strongly encouraged. Priority deadline: Oct 27. Applications received after that date may still be considered while the role remains open. StillArt is a founder-led firm in Porvoo, Finland that helps orchestras and performing arts organizations grow their audiences and revenue, with clients around the world. Learn more at stillart.com.

jobs.title: Technology Strategy and Transform Lead
jobs.description: Company description:Ericsson ABJob description:   Join our Team       About this opportunityEnterprise IT is looking for a Director, Strategy and Transformation to turn its most urgent, complex and enterprise-wide priorities into results. The role combines strategic advice, special-project leadership, executive problem-solving and hands-on delivery, and is suited to assignments that are ambiguous, cross-organisational, time-critical or without a clear organisational home.Reporting to the Head of PA Technology Foundation, you will clarify complex issues, bring the right stakeholders together and drive assignments through to resolution, recovery, acceleration or measurable business outcomes.   What you will do•    Act as a rapid-response advisor for complex, ambiguous or urgent enterprise situations.•    Structure issues, clarify root causes and turn strategic intent into executable actions.•    Lead CIO-sponsored initiatives, special projects and cross-organisational transformations from mobilisation to delivery.•    Engage senior stakeholders across business areas, Enterprise IT, architecture, sourcing, finance, risk, legal and the wider technology ecosystem.•    Recover or accelerate critical programmes through fact-based plans, clear ownership and executive follow-through.•    Help resolve executive deadlocks and build coalitions where escalation alone is not enough.•    Lead enterprise responses to audit findings, control gaps and other governance matters.•    Address critical supplier and partner challenges across sourcing, commercial, delivery and relationships.•    Act as a strategic interface between Enterprise IT and Ericsson's business and technology ecosystem.•    Provide concise executive briefings that make decisions, risks, trade-offs and next steps clear.   You will bring•    Extensive experience in enterprise technology strategy, digital transformation or large-scale business transformation.•    A proven ability to advise CIOs and senior executives and turn strategic priorities into practical execution.•    Strong executive problem-solving skills, including issue structuring, analysis and decision facilitation.•    Experience leading complex, cross-organisational initiatives with limited formal authority.•    Experience in programme recovery, transformation acceleration, strategic sourcing or major commercial engagements.•    A sound understanding of enterprise technology domains such as cloud, AI, cybersecurity, data and enterprise platforms.•    The ability to navigate governance, audit, risk and compliance while maintaining delivery momentum.•    Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation and coalition-building skills.•    Clear, influential executive communication that distils complexity into decisions and measurable outcomes.•    High personal ownership, discretion, integrity and resilience in high-pressure situations.•    A relevant university degree is required; an advanced degree or recognised strategy, transformation or programme leadership qualification is an advantage.

jobs.title: Communication Strategist
jobs.description: Company description:Who are we?Volvo Cars is a company on a mission; to bring traditional car manufacturing into a connected, sustainable and smart future.Since 1927, we have been a brand known for our commitment to safety, creating innovative cars that make life less complicated for our consumers. In 2010, we decided to transform our business, resulting in a totally new generation of cars and technologies, as well as steady growth and record sales. Today, we’re expanding our global footprint in Europe, China and the US, and we’re on the lookout for new talent. We are constantly pushing our own skills and abilities to drive change in the automobile industry like never before. We are looking for innovative, committed people to join us in this endeavour and create safe, sustainable and connected cars. We believe in the power of people and will challenge and support you to reach your full potential. Join us and be part of Volvo Cars’ journey into the future.Job description:   Let's introduce ourselves   You’ll join the Leader and Employee Communication team, part of the broader Communication and Public Affairs organisation. Together, we help leaders communicate with clarity and purpose, while ensuring employees feel informed, engaged and connected to Volvo Cars’ strategic direction.   Working closely with communication colleagues and stakeholders across the organisation, we translate business priorities into clear, relevant and engaging communication, delivered through the right messages and channels.   We are a collaborative and creative team that values fresh thinking, strong relationships and communication that makes a meaningful difference. We encourage curiosity, bold ideas and new ways of working, and foster an international culture where people are united by a shared purpose.     What you'll do   You will create communications content and execute communication strategies in line with established communication policies. You will follow communication plans and share company information through a combination of channels.    People who make a difference are the driving force that has built one of the most recognisable brands in the world. We are looking for change makers who think about communication opportunities in exciting and different ways, creative and critical thinkers who want to make a difference with us at Volvo Cars. In this role, you will:      Shape the news and information flow within Volvo Cars, driving employee engagement and strategic alignment and encouraging employees to become proactive brand ambassadors.     Develop multi-channel communication strategies around news-based stories and see them through to execution.     Develop thought-leadership positions that strengthen employee engagement and the Volvo Cars brand.     Drive the development and consistent implementation of stories and messages that support our corporate strategy and core values across communication channels globally.     Collaborate with business area communication teams to identify and develop relevant news-based stories from across the company.     Co-create the editorial calendar across communication channels.     Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and provide high-level communication guidance.     Contribute to developing our employee communication capabilities by keeping up with trends and best practices from other industries and implementing working methods and tools that strengthen employee engagement.      What you'll bring   We are looking for a social, passionate and creative communications professional with experience in developing and delivering engaging and motivating communication strategies. You have deep experience in earned communication and/or journalism and the ability to utilise different channels to support desired business outcomes. You thrive in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment and are comfortable adapting to changing business priorities. You combine your natural interest in creating innovative communication with an ability to identify the right channel for different stories.         BA / BSc in communication, journalism or equivalent experience     A strategic and creative approach to communication planning, with an ability to manage a range of projects, balancing quality and speed     Exceptional communication skills and fluency in English and Chinese, both verbal and written      Experience working across different communication channels and formats.     Strong ability to build good working relationships with stakeholders and internal colleagues.     Experience in journalism, earned communication or corporate communication.     Experience from the automotive industry and/or financial communication is considered an advantage.

jobs.title: Psychologist
jobs.description: Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions.Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.Role SummaryScania Occupational Health Services Sweden is looking for an experienced licensed psychologist who would like to provide qualified support to Scania’s operations in Södertälje. In this role, you will work with issues relating to individuals’ health and circumstances, group interaction and development, and organizational ways of working and change. You will support employees, managers, HR and management teams, adapting your interventions to their needs—from clinical support for individuals to consultative work with groups and organizations.You will contribute psychological expertise and a holistic perspective to issues relating to work-related ill health, rehabilitation, collaboration, conflict and change. The aim is to promote health and create sustainable conditions for both people and the business.You will be part of a cross-professional team in a global and dynamic organization. Your experience and ability to translate knowledge into practical support will be important to our work to promote health, safety and sustainable productivity.  Job ResponsibilitiesYou will be part of a cross-functional team that includes occupational health physicians, occupational health nurses and other psychologists. In your customer team, you will also work with ergonomists and work environment engineers. You will work in a consultative capacity, supporting individuals, groups, managers, HR and management teams.The work includes both preventive and remedial interventions at individual, group and organizational levels. You will move between these levels according to the needs of each assignment and consider how individuals’ situations, group interactions and organizational conditions affect one another.Your main responsibilities will be to:    Conduct clinical assessments and provide time-limited psychological treatment for individuals, both individually and in groups, as well as support in cases of work-related ill health and rehabilitation.    Support individuals and groups with issues relating to health, work capacity, collaboration and return to work.    Support groups with group development, collaboration and conflict issues, for example through facilitation and consultative support.    Support managers, HR and management teams with issues relating to employee health, group interactions and organizational conditions.    Contribute psychological expertise to organizational changes and change management, focusing on how changes affect individuals, groups, leadership and the work environment.    Analyze organizational conditions and provide recommendations for sustainable ways of working and a good organizational and social work environment.    Develop and deliver training in areas such as mental health, change, work environment and leadership.The position is based at Occupational Health Services in Södertälje. When the customer assignment allows, the work can be carried out remotely.Who You Are    Licensed Psychologist with experience providing psychological support to individuals and groups.    Strong consultative background, partnering with managers, teams, and organizations to address workplace challenges and promote wellbeing.    Experience supporting organizational change, including reorganizations, new ways of working, and business transformations.    Knowledge of group dynamics, organizational psychology, and evidence-based interventions that support healthy and effective workplaces.    Experience working with work-related ill health, rehabilitation processes, and employee support.    Skilled in supporting managers and teams through collaboration, communication, and conflict-resolution challenges.    Able to build trust, provide constructive challenge, and translate psychological expertise into practical recommendations and actions.    Structured, empathetic, and adaptable, with excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.    Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken; experience within Occupational Health Services is considered an advantage.This Is UsOccupational Health Services Sweden is part of Global SHE, which supports Scania in the areas of safety, health and work environment. We are based in Södertälje, Oskarshamn and Luleå in Sweden, as well as at other locations around the world. Our role as an independent expert resource is to guide Scania in its work to ensure and promote health, safety and sustainable productivity. Our work is based on legislation, science and proven experience. We also have a preventive and methods-development remit, aimed at supporting Scania in complying with legislation. As an integrated part of the business, we have a good understanding of the workplaces and the opportunity to follow operations over time.Scania OffersWe offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.ApplicationWe look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-11-10. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

jobs.title: International Advocacy Advisor
jobs.description: RFSL is seeking an International Advocacy Advisor to support Ukrainian LGBTQI organisations and activists in advancing their advocacy priorities and influencing policy at national, regional and international levels. The role combines international advocacy, partnership development and capacity strengthening, with practical programme and administrative support that enables locally led movements to thrive.About RFSL and our international workRFSL (the Swedish Federation for Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer, and Intersex Rights), founded in 1950, is one of the world’s oldest non-profit organisations working to advance LGBTQI rights.RFSL’s international work supports LGBTQI movements in Eastern Europe, Asia and Africa through regranting, partnerships, knowledge exchange, organisational support and advocacy. We work closely with local partners to support locally led movements, strengthen their agency and influence, and contribute to enabling environments for LGBTQI rights at national, regional and global levels.Your role with usYou will work closely with Ukrainian LGBTQI organisations and activists to strengthen their ability to lead and influence advocacy processes. Together with partners, you will identify priorities, develop strategies and messaging, map stakeholders, and find opportunities to engage decision-makers and relevant international platforms, including the EU, UN, OSCE and Council of Europe.A central part of the role is helping partners access the knowledge, networks, resources and practical support they need to pursue their priorities. This includes organising capacity-strengthening activities, managing scholarships and providing hands-on programme and administrative support. You will also contribute to advocacy efforts in Sweden related to Ukraine and work with RFSL colleagues to align policy, advocacy and communications.You will collaborate with the Head of Program, International Program Managers, other Advocacy Advisors and colleagues across RFSL’s international work. The position is based in Stockholm and involves international travel several times per year.For full description of  key responsibilities and desirable qualifications, please see our job ad on RFSL’s careers pageWho are you?You are a structured, collaborative and solution-oriented professional committed to LGBTQI rights, international advocacy and locally led movement strengthening. You understand Ukraine’s political and social context, the regional human rights and civil society landscape, and the challenges facing LGBTQI organisations working in politically sensitive or resource-constrained environments.You build trusted partnerships and adapt your approach to different organisations, particularly grassroots groups that may need substantial practical support alongside strategic guidance. You respect local leadership and autonomy, understand power dynamics in international partnerships, and approach your work with awareness of security, safeguarding and the importance of accountable support.You enjoy combining strategic advocacy and capacity strengthening with practical operational and administrative tasks. You are comfortable moving between developing advocacy strategies and organising activities, coordinating travel, booking accommodation, handling receipts and ensuring that payments and documentation are in order. You recognise that this hands-on support is an important part of enabling partners to advance their own priorities.You bring strong analytical, communication and organisational skills, can represent RFSL professionally with civil society, public authorities and international institutions, and work effectively across teams and cultures. You are proactive, flexible and accountable, and share RFSL’s values of anti-racism, feminism, accessibility and intersectionality.To succeed in this role, you need:    A strong commitment to LGBTQI rights and experience or demonstrated competence in advocacy, policy influence, civil society support or related human rights work, particularly in relation to Ukraine.    Strong knowledge of the human rights situation and civil society landscape in Ukraine or the wider region, including experience working in partnership with LGBTQI movements or organisations.    At least three years of relevant professional experience in advocacy, civil society support, development cooperation or a related field.    Experience engaging with international or regional advocacy processes and human rights mechanisms, such as those of the EU, UN, OSCE or Council of Europe.    An understanding of security and safeguarding considerations when working with LGBTQI activists and civil society in challenging contexts.    Strong analytical, organisational and administrative skills, including experience with organisational capacity assessment, budgets, programme documentation and risk management.    Excellent written and spoken English.    Some understanding of Ukrainian or a closely related language, together with a willingness to develop Ukrainian-language skills as needed.    The ability to work from Stockholm, Sweden, and undertake international travel several times per year.Employment terms    Employment type: This is a permanent position, starting with a six-month probationary period.     Location: RFSL office in Stockholm.    Start date: As agreed    Contract terms: Covered by the Collective Agreement for Nonprofit OrganizationsOur offerRFSL offers an inclusive, values-driven workplace where you can contribute to meaningful change alongside committed colleagues and partners. We provide competitive employment conditions, including occupational pension and parental benefits.How to applyApply by November 15th, 2026. The recruitment process is conducted in English and includes anonymous, competency-based assessment, a work-related assignment and a background check.For questions about the position or recruitment process, contact HR Partner Tobias Jensen at tobias.jensen@rfsl.se.RFSL strives to be an inclusive, feminist and anti-racist workplace. We welcome applicants regardless of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, sex characteristics, religion, race, ethnicity, country of origin, disability, age or other grounds of discrimination. We strongly encourage candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences to apply.

jobs.title: Chauffeur-livreur de colis / Permis B - Charleroi
jobs.description:
• Chargement & Organisation de la tournée :

    • Trier et charger physiquement les colis dans la camionnette (utilitaire léger permis B) en fonction du plan de tournée et des priorités horaires.

    • Scannage systématique de l'ensemble des colis au départ du dépôt à l'aide de l'outil informatique portable.

    • Réaliser le contrôle de sécurité d'usage du véhicule avant le départ (niveaux, pression des pneus, état carrosserie).

  • Distribution & Service client :

    • Effectuer les livraisons et les enlèvements de colis en respectant scrupuleusement les cadences soutenues et les créneaux horaires imposés.

    • Utilisation obligatoire et quotidienne du pistolet scanner / PDA de livraison pour l'encodage en temps réel des signatures, statuts de livraison, codes-barres et preuves de dépôt.

    • Assurer un contact client professionnel, courtois et orienté qualité lors des remises en main propre.

  • Gestion administrative & Retour de tournée :

    • Gérer les éventuels refus, absences de clients ou anomalies d'adresse selon les procédures strictes du réseau messagerie.

    • Restituer les colis non livrés et le pistolet scanner en fin de journée lors du retour au dépôt de Charleroi.

    • Maintenir l'utilitaire professionnel dans un état de propreté irréprochable.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

  • Permis : Permis B valide (depuis au moins 2 ans, avec sélection médicale à jour si requise).

  • Expérience :

    • Expérience probante et récente exigée en tant que chauffeur livreur de colis (messagerie express type DHL, DPD, GLS, UPS ou Bpost).

    • Expérience pratique et réussie dans l'utilisation d'un scanner à colis (PDA / pistolet scanner) obligatoire.

  • Condition physique : Excellente condition physique indispensable (port répété de charges, cadence de chargement/déchargement soutenue, montées/descentes fréquentes du véhicule).

  • Compétences techniques :

    • Excellente connaissance géographique de la région de Charleroi et du réseau routier wallon.

    • Grande aisance avec les outils numériques de traçabilité logistique et GPS.

  • Qualités personnelles :

    • Dynamisme, rapidité d'exécution, ponctualité et grande rigueur.

    • Sens de la relation client, présentation soignée et autonomie sur la route.

jobs.title: Senior Control Systems Engineer
jobs.description: What we do at BlykallaBlykalla is a Swedish deep-tech company at the forefront of the nuclear industry, pioneering the development of small modular reactors that provide clean, safe, and reliable energy. Thanks to lead-cooling, we achieve high safety in a very compact format, allowing for a simple and cost-effective design that can be mass-produced. Our unique reactor design will provide safe and green baseload energy that perfectly complements solar and wind power.What you’ll get to doWe are seeking a Senior Control Systems Engineer with deep expertise in ABB 800xA DCS to lead the development of Blykalla's plant control system architecture and implementation strategy.This is a unique opportunity to help define the control philosophy of a first-of-a-kind advanced nuclear reactor. You will play a key role in ensuring that Blykalla develops and retains ownership of critical control system intellectual property while working closely with ABB and other suppliers.Key ResponsibilitiesDCS Architecture & Ownership    Lead the design and development of Blykalla's plant-wide automation and control system architecture.    Define the ABB 800xA system architecture for reactor, balance-of-plant, auxiliary, and test facility applications.    Develop internal engineering standards, libraries, templates, and control strategies to maximize in-house ownership of intellectual property.    Establish long-term governance for control system design, lifecycle management, cybersecurity, and configuration control.Control System Engineering    Develop functional specifications, control narratives, cause-and-effect matrices, and automation philosophies.    Design and implement control logic, sequences, interlocks, alarms, and operator interfaces.    Configure ABB 800xA applications, controllers, engineering environments, and HMI systems.    Define communication architectures including OPC UA, IEC 61850, Modbus, Profibus/Profinet, Ethernet/IP, and other industrial protocols.    Develop and maintain simulation and testing environments for control system validation.Nuclear Plant Integration    Support the integration of reactor systems, safety systems, and balance-of-plant equipment into the overall control architecture.    Work closely with reactor, thermal-hydraulic, electrical, mechanical, and safety engineers to define system requirements.    Contribute to licensing and regulatory documentation related to instrumentation and control systems.    Support development of digital I&C architectures aligned with nuclear industry expectations and international standards.Vendor & Stakeholder Management    Act as the primary technical interface with ABB regarding 800xA architecture, licensing, engineering tools, and implementation support.    Ensure that Blykalla retains ownership of application software, engineering databases, configuration standards, and control strategies.    Manage external engineering partners and system integrators where required.    Participate in factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), commissioning, and startup activities.Verification & Validation    Develop testing methodologies for control logic verification and system validation.    Lead integration testing and commissioning activities.    Support development of digital twins and operator training simulators.    Ensure traceability from requirements through implementation and testing.Who you’ll get to work withThe Senior Control Systems Engineer sits in the Plant engineering Team within Blykalla. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and Blykalla. Who you areYou will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personnel chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help in order for you to succeed in this role, these are:    MSc or BSc in Control Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Nuclear Engineering, or related discipline.    Minimum 10 years of experience in industrial automation and control systems engineering.    Extensive hands-on experience with ABB 800xA DCS engineering, configuration, commissioning, and lifecycle management.    Proven experience designing and implementing large-scale DCS architectures.    Experience developing control strategies for complex industrial facilities.    Strong understanding of industrial networks, field instrumentation, and process control.    Fluent in English, spoken and written    Fluency in Swedish is a plusTechnical Skills    Expert-level knowledge of ABB 800xA:    AC 800M controllers    Control Builder    Aspect Objects    System 800xA Engineering    Operator Workplace    Alarm Management    Batch and Advanced Process Control (desirable)    Strong understanding of:    ISA-88    ISA-95    IEC 61511    IEC 61508    Industrial cybersecurity principles    Configuration management and software lifecycle practices    Experience with simulation and testing environments.Location This position is for our office in Stockholm.Reference & Background ChecksAs part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on all candidates. We may also conduct reference checks to gain a well-rounded understanding of your professional experience, performance, and ways of working. This includes both references provided by you and, where relevant, conversations with other professional contacts who have worked closely with you. We strive to be transparent about our reference-checking process and handle all personal data in accordance with applicable data protection regulations. Any additional references will be sought with professional judgment and only when considered relevant to the role.We offer competitive compensation aligned with our internal salary framework and growth potential in the role.We do not accept applications via email. We are not open to external help from recruitment agencies. Note on AI Use: Blykalla may use AI technology to assist with certain administrative aspects of the hiring process, such as note-taking, interview documentation, and reporting. However, every resume and application is reviewed directly by our recruiting team. AI tools are used solely for operational support and do not influence candidate evaluation or hiring decisions.
