jobs.title: Comissioning & Warranty Lead
jobs.description: The final phase of a delivery is where our technology truly proves itself. Installation at the shipyard, commissioning, HAT and SAT, final acceptance, and the warranty period are critical stages in ensuring that the vessel performs as promised. They are also the moments that shape the customer’s lasting impression of our delivery.To strengthen our focus on this critical phase, we are now establishing a new Commissioning & Warranty function and are looking for two individuals to join the team who want to help shape it from the start. In this role, you will take operational responsibility for the delivery through its most decisive stage, where engineering is transformed into real-world performance and customer value.What you will be doingAs Responsible for Commissioning & Warranty, you are operationally responsible for a delivery from formal project handover, after FAT and delivery of the equipment, until the customer is transferred to standard Aftermarket support. You will plan, coordinate, and drive the delivery forward through arrival inspection, installation support, commissioning, HAT and SAT, customer acceptance, the warranty period, and ultimately formal warranty closure. Your mission is clear: keep everything moving until we leave behind vessels that perform as promised and customers who trust us to deliver again.Throughout this journey, you will be the customer’s primary operational point of contact, providing continuity, direction, and clear ownership from one phase to the next. Internally, you will be the connecting force between our technical, operational, and supporting functions, bringing the right people together, aligning priorities, and ensuring that the delivery continues to move forward.In practice, you will:    Take over the delivery from the Project Manager and make sure nothing falls between the two of you: scope, open points, documentation and warranty terms.    Coordinate field service resources and spare parts, and collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), technical support and suppliers to secure competence and availability against plan;    Ensure arrival inspection at site is completed and drive transport damage and shortages to resolution.    Support installation towards the shipyard, then plan and run commissioning, HAT and SAT until acceptance is obtained.    Act as operational owner of warranty cases, from registration and technical assessment to liability determination and resolution, including claim handling and supplier recovery.    Handle customer disputes and negotiate practical, commercially sound settlements within your mandate.    Keep scope boundaries, documentation, cost exposure and status visible and feed lessons learned back into engineering, production and service.You work within a clear mandate. Decisions on prioritization, technical resolution paths, resourcing, warranty assessment and settlements within your delegated authority are yours to make. The Project Manager remains accountable for the overall project, and the genuinely large questions are escalated but you are expected to solve, not to forward.We think you should haveYou have led projects before and know what it takes to keep stakeholders aligned when schedules are under pressure. You are comfortable being the main point of contact for customers and enjoy balancing technical, commercial and operational perspectives to move a project forward.We believe you have several years of experience in project management, commissioning management, or aftermarket/service management, preferably within the marine, offshore, energy, or other capital equipment industries. You hold a technical degree or have gained equivalent knowledge through practical experience. You have worked closely with shipyards, customers and suppliers, handling deviations, claims and commercial discussions, and you possess a solid technical understanding that allows you to actively participate in discussions with engineers and service technicians, form your own view of technical challenges, and contribute to finding solutions.You are comfortable working across multiple IT systems simultaneously, such as ERP platforms, case and claim management systems, documentation tools and reporting solutions. You also have a good understanding of contracts, warranty terms and the commercial impact of technical decisions. Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is required, while Swedish is considered an advantage. The role also involves occasional travel to shipyards, vessels and customer sites as needed, although travel is not the primary focus of the position.Just as important as your experience is the way you work. You are structured and proactive, with a natural ability to bring tasks to completion rather than letting them drift. You remain calm and professional in challenging situations, focusing on finding solutions and building strong relationships. You communicate clearly with people from different cultures, backgrounds and levels of an organization, and you take ownership of your responsibilities without waiting to be directed.Why join us    A role with real influence. Commissioning and warranty is where our promises to the customer are tested. We are building a clearer, more structured and more customer-focused way of working around it and you will help us shape it. Your work strengthens the transition between New Sales, Project Management and the Aftermarket organization, with better quality, stronger documentation, reduced cost leakage and stronger customer relationships as the result.    A global and technologically advanced environment. World-leading products for vessel propulsion, experienced colleagues and international customers. You will work closely with Project Management, Technical Support, Field Service, Engineering, our Product Centers and the regional Global Customer Support organizations, and build a cross-functional network across the business that few other roles give you.    Breadth, and room to grow. Few positions combine technology, coordination, customer dialogue, business understanding and continuous improvement the way this one does. It sits in a stable global organization with a strong culture of innovation, and offers good development opportunities in whichever direction you want to take next.    We offer flexible working hours and the option to work remote or from home office.Security Clearance is required for this position.Kongsberg Maritime - a global leader in maritime technology.

jobs.title: Upper School Counsellor - Starting Academic Year 2027
jobs.description:
The International School of Bergen is seeking an experienced, compassionate, and highly skilled School Counsellor to join our vibrant IB World School in Norway.

Hva vi ser etter

Application

We welcome applications from suitably qualified and experienced counsellors who are genuinely committed to relocating to Norway and becoming part of our school community.

Please submit the following documents by email with the subject line "US School Counsellor Application" to laura.mcguffie@isbergen.no:

  • A current CV.

  • A covering letter explaining your relevant counseling experience, qualifications, experience working with children and young people, and motivation for working at the International School of Bergen.

  • Contact details for two professional referees, including your current or most recent employer.

Important - Relocation to Norway

Please only apply if you are seriously considering relocating to Bergen, Norway.

Candidates who are currently living outside Norway should be prepared to relocate and meet the relevant Norwegian immigration, visa and work permit requirements, where applicable.

As part of the application process, candidates may be asked to provide information regarding their nationality/passport country and current country of residence so that the school can establish the appropriate immigration and work permit requirements.

This is an on-site based position in Bergen, Norway.

Safeguarding

The International School of Bergen is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people.

All appointments must provide a police background check from your home country and any country you have resided in for 6+ months in the last 10 years. Police background checks must be no more than 3 months old and can be presented prior to appointment.

All staff are expected to uphold the school's safeguarding policies and Code of Conduct.

Previous applicants should reapply if you are still seriously interested in the position.

If you have any questions in regards to this position, please contact Peter Ledger, Director peter.ledger@isbergen.no or Laura McGuffie, HR and Finance Manager laura.mcguffie@isbergen.no

Applications will be reviewed as they are received. We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if a suitable candidate is identified, so early applications are encouraged.

Closing Date for applications is 27th November 2026

Arbeidsoppgaver

About the Role

The School Counsellor will provide proactive and responsive counselling services to students across the school while supporting the implementation of a whole-school wellbeing programme consistent with the philosophy of the International Baccalaureate.

The role includes:

  • Providing confidential individual and small-group counselling.

  • Supporting students with social, emotional, behavioural and mental health needs.

  • Delivering preventative wellbeing programmes and age-appropriate classroom guidance.

  • Promoting resilience, self-management, positive relationships and emotional wellbeing.

  • Working collaboratively with teachers to identify and support students requiring additional care.

  • Advising school leadership on student wellbeing, safeguarding and pastoral care.

  • Liaising effectively with parents and guardians to support student success.

  • Coordinating referrals to external professionals and Norwegian support services where appropriate.

  • Supporting crisis response and student reintegration following significant life events.

  • Maintaining accurate, confidential records in accordance with GDPR and Norwegian legislation.

  • Contributing to safeguarding procedures and child protection practices.

  • Supporting transitions between PYP and MYP where applicable), ensuring continuity of care.

  • Promoting inclusion, diversity, intercultural understanding and student voice.

The Successful Candidate Will Have

Essential

  • A recognised qualification in Counselling, School Psychology, Educational Psychology, Social Work or a related field.

  • Professional registration or eligibility for registration where applicable.

  • Experience working with children and adolescents in a school setting.

  • Strong understanding of child and adolescent development.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to build trusting relationships with students, families and staff.

  • Commitment to safeguarding and child protection.

  • High levels of professionalism, integrity and confidentiality.

  • Excellent spoken and written English.

  • A genuine willingness and ability to relocate to Bergen, Norway.

Desirable

  • Previous experience within an IB World School.

  • Knowledge of the IB Learner Profile and IB Approaches to Learning (ATL).

  • Experience supporting internationally mobile or multilingual students.

  • Experience working within multicultural communities.

  • Knowledge of trauma-informed and restorative practices.

Personal Attributes

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Compassionate and approachable.

  • Calm and solution-focused.

  • Collaborative and reflective.

  • Culturally responsive and internationally minded.

  • An excellent listener with sound professional judgement.

  • Passionate about student wellbeing and inclusion.

  • Committed to continuous professional learning.

  • Open to embracing life and work within an international school community in Norway.

Vi tilbyr

Why Join Us?

Our school offers:

  • A welcoming and diverse international community.

  • Students representing many nationalities and cultures.

  • A collaborative and supportive staff culture.

  • Commitment to ongoing professional development.

  • Competitive salary and pension.

  • The opportunity to live and work in one of the world's most beautiful and family-friendly countries.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

About Our School

ISB is a co-educational private day school which is authorised to deliver the International Baccalaureate PYP and MYP programmes. The school currently has approximately 250 students enrolled from more than 30 nations and is experiencing expanding enrolment. Classes are small with a maximum of 20 students in each instructional group.

Our school is committed to developing internationally minded young people who embody the attributes of the IB Learner Profile. We believe that student wellbeing is fundamental to learning, and we are looking for a counsellor who shares our commitment to nurturing the academic, social, emotional and personal development of every learner.

Working collaboratively with students, families, teachers and school leaders, the successful candidate will play a central role in promoting wellbeing, inclusion, safeguarding and positive mental health across the school community.

jobs.title: PhD stipend in thermal modeling and advanced solutions for high-power modules and magnetic components
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a PhD stipend is available within the general study programme in Electrical and Electronic Engineering. The stipend is open for appointment from 1 December 2026 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years and the position is full-time.

Your work tasksThe position is offered in relation to the GreenMag project, and you will be positioned in the Section of Power Electronics Systems and Materials within the research programme Sustainable Power Electronics and Electrification (SPELL) at AAU Energy, Aalborg University. You will be based at the Aalborg campus in a highly international research environment with close collaboration with academic and industrial partners in the field of power electronics and energy systems.

The increasing electrification of transport, industry and renewable energy systems is driving the development of high-power-density power converters operating at megawatt levels. Advanced planar magnetic components are emerging as a key technology for achieving higher power density, manufacturability and integration in such converters. However, thermal management remains one of the major challenges that limit the performance, reliability and scalability of planar magnetic solutions, especially at high power and high frequency.

In this PhD project, you will work on the development of innovative thermal management technologies for megawatt planar magnetics used in future electrification systems. Your research will combine advanced modelling, experimental validation and prototype development to improve heat dissipation and thermal reliability while maintaining the required electrical and magnetic performance. You will analyse thermal behaviour and heat transfer mechanisms in high-power planar magnetic components, design and evaluate cooling concepts and contribute to the integration of these solutions in realistic converter systems.

You will conduct cutting-edge research on thermal behaviour and heat transfer mechanisms in megawatt-class planar magnetic components and use this knowledge to propose and evaluate new design strategies. You will develop multiphysics simulation models using finite element modelling tools to investigate the thermal performance of planar magnetics and to study alternative cooling concepts and material choices. You will design, manufacture and experimentally validate novel thermal management solutions for planar magnetic structures, and you will explore advanced materials and cooling technologies that can be applied in megawatt-class magnetic components. As part of the GreenMag project, you will collaborate with academic and industrial partners, disseminate your research results through publications in international journals and conferences, and contribute to teaching and supervision activities within the department as part of the PhD education programme.

Your competencies You have a relevant educational background within Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, Energy Engineering or a closely related field, and you hold a Master’s degree that qualifies you for enrolment in the PhD programme. You are motivated to work at the interface between thermal science, electromagnetics and power electronics, and you are interested in both theoretical and experimental research.

You bring strong analytical skills and a structured approach to modelling and problem solving, and you are comfortable working with numerical tools for thermal and multiphysics analysis. Experience with thermal analysis, power electronics or magnetic component design will be considered an advantage, as will experience with finite element analysis tools such as COMSOL Multiphysics or ANSYS. It is beneficial if you have worked with experimental testing, prototype development or laboratory work in previous projects and if you are prepared to work with both simulation and hands-on experiments in this PhD.

As a person, you are curious and creative, and you are motivated by addressing challenging research questions in collaboration with others. You are able to work independently, take responsibility for your project and contribute actively to collaborative research activities across groups and institutions. Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken, are required, as you will present your results in scientific publications, at international conferences and in meetings with project partners.

Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges. Aalborg University is recognised internationally for excellence in power electronics and energy systems research, and AAU has been ranked among the leading universities in Europe within energy research. At AAU Energy, you will be part of a highly international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges associated with electrification and the green transition.

The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs approximately 300 staff members from a broad range of nationalities and disciplinary backgrounds, creating a vibrant international research environment with extensive opportunities for collaboration and professional growth. The department offers world-class laboratory and workshop facilities, and maintains close collaboration with industrial partners. As a PhD student, you will have access to advanced facilities for the design, manufacturing and testing of high-power magnetic components and power electronic systems, and you will be part of an active research community in Sustainable Power Electronics and Electrification.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dkHow to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. Do you have any questions?     If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employmentThe employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.title: Vær med til at gøre frokostpausen lidt bedre – vi søger en køkkenmedhjælper til Haderslev Katedralskole
jobs.description:
Kan du lide at have hænderne i maden, et smil på læben og mange bolde i luften? Trives du med en hverdag, hvor du både laver lækker mad, møder gæsterne ved disken og giver en hånd med, hvor der er brug for det? Så er det måske dig, vi mangler på holdet hos DinnerdeLuxe på Haderslev Katedralskole.

Vi søger en serviceminded køkkenmedhjælper til et sygevikariat på 30 timer om ugen. Du har gerne mindst 3 års erfaring med kantinedrift, er vant til at tage fat og ved, hvad der skal til for at få en travl kantinehverdag til at glide.

Det er stillingen krydret med:

  • Et sygevikariat på 30 timer om ugen med arbejdstid i tidsrummet mellem kl. 8.00 og 14.30

  • En afvekslende hverdag med både madproduktion, gæsteservice og praktiske opgaver

  • Et moderne kantinekoncept med fokus på god mad og gode råvarer

  • Mulighed for at tage ansvar og være med til at skabe gode frokostoplevelser

God mad, glade gæster og en hverdag med fart på

I kantinen på Haderslev Katedralskole er du med til at give elever og medarbejdere en god pause i hverdagen. Her handler det ikke kun om at få maden på bordet, men også om at skabe en hyggelig og imødekommende oplevelse for dem, der besøger kantinen.

Du bliver en del af den daglige drift, hvor opgaverne spænder bredt. Den ene stund er du i gang med at tilberede mad, og den næste står du ved kassen og møder gæsterne med et smil. Du er ikke bange for at tage fat, og du ved, at de små detaljer gør en stor forskel.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Tilberede og klargøre velsmagende mad til kantinens gæster

  • Betjene kassen og give gæsterne en god og venlig service

  • Anrette, fylde op og sørge for, at kantinen altid fremstår indbydende

  • Hjælpe med opvask, rengøring og de praktiske opgaver i køkkenet

  • Bidrage til, at den daglige kantinedrift fungerer godt

Du har styr på kantinehverdagen – og smil på læben

Du behøver ikke være uddannet kok eller cater. Det vigtigste er, at du har erfaring fra en kantine, kan lide at arbejde med mad og trives med både de praktiske opgaver og kontakten til gæsterne.

Vi ser gerne, at du har mindst 3 års erfaring med kantinedrift og derfor hurtigt kan finde dig til rette i en hverdag, hvor der nogle gange er fart på.

Vi glæder os til en kollega, der:

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for sine opgaver

  • Har erfaring med madproduktion og den daglige drift af en kantine

  • Er serviceminded og møder gæsterne med et smil

  • Er fleksibel, har overblik og gerne giver en ekstra hånd

  • Bidrager med godt humør og en positiv indstilling

Skal du være vores nye kollega?

Vi vil gerne have dig med på holdet hurtigst muligt. Der er tale om et sygevikariat på 30 timer om ugen.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat – så send gerne din ansøgning allerede i dag.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV, meget gerne med referencer, til job.kenneth@dinnerdeluxe.dk, og skriv "Køkkenmedhjælper Haderslev" i emnefeltet.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Drifts- og Kundechef Kenneth Kirkedal Thomsen på telefon 25 28 28 88 eller ovenstående mailadresse.

Hvis du oplyser referencer, betragter vi det som samtykke til, at vi må kontakte dem. Af hensyn til GDPR skal du sende din ansøgning til ovenstående mailadresse. Oplys kun de nødvendige personoplysninger, såsom navn, telefonnummer og mailadresse.

jobs.title: Autolakerer til Aalborg - bliv en del af vores team
jobs.description:
Har du styr på forarbejdet og sans for en flot lakering? Hos Byens bilpleje.com i Aalborg søger vi en autolakerer, der vil bruge sin faglighed i en varieret hverdag med gode kollegaer. Vi går op i at levere kvalitet og i at have et værksted, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og har det godt sammen.

Byens bilpleje.com er Danmarks førende virksomhed inden for kosmetisk klargøring af biler; herunder autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse samt udskiftning af autoglas - vi er bilbranchens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Byens bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og beskæftiger i dag over 400 medarbejdere. Herudover håndterer virksomheden mere end 200.000 biler om året.

En hverdag med biler og godt håndværk

Sammen med afdelingens øvrige lakspecialister arbejder du med:

  • Klargøring af biler til lakering gennem spartling, slibning og afdækning.
  • Reparation af mindre buler og ridser.
  • Sprøjtelakering og sikring af en flot, ensartet overflade.
  • Kvalitetskontrol, inden bilen går videre.
  • Koordinering af dagens opgaver med resten af teamet.
  • Andre opgaver i afdelingen, når der er brug for en ekstra hånd.

Hvem er du?

Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • Har en uddannelse som autolakerer eller erfaring med autolakering.
  • Går omhyggeligt til opgaverne og følger dem helt til dørs.
  • Kan organisere dit arbejde og holde overblikket i en travl hverdag.
  • Trives med både selvstændige opgaver og samarbejde.
  • Møder dine kollegaer med en positiv indstilling og godt humør.
  • Har kørekort (B).

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • Løn, der matcher dine kvalifikationer, pension og overenskomst.
  • Gode redskaber og kvalitetsprodukter til det daglige arbejde.
  • Mulighed for at bygge videre på din erfaring og udvikle dig i faget.
  • Et godt kollegialt fællesskab med plads til faglig sparring og en god snak i pauserne.

Klar til at blive en del af holdet?

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og søger en kollega, der passer godt ind både fagligt og personligt. Vi ønsker opstart hurtigst muligt, men venter gerne på den rette. Lyder det som en arbejdsplads for dig? Så glæder vi os til at modtage din ansøgning.

Grundet GDPR-forordningen modtager vi ikke ansøgninger på mail, hvorfor disse ikke tages i betragtning. Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com.

jobs.title: Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
jobs.description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing Department of Food Science Faculty of Science University of Copenhagen The Department of Food Science (FOOD), Faculty of Science (SCIENCE), University of Copenhagen (UCPH) invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor in Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. The research areas of FOOD have a shared mission to contribute to new pathways for society and industry to support the development of solutions based in biology to improve sustainable food production, food security and food safety. FOOD is recognized for excellence in food research, education and industrial collaboration. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. FOOD has the ambition to reinforce our teaching and research in designing and optimizing biology-based solutions as future sustainable food and ingredient technologies. UCPH is strengthening this area by offering the new MSc Biosolutions program in Kalundborg, Denmark, the largest bio-based manufacturing hub in Scandinavia, home to large fermentation-based manufacturers, and a vibrant innovation environment. The candidate for this position is expected to significantly contribute to this new Biosolutions initiative. The aim of the position is to explore the production and use of new solutions based on both biology and engineering addressing sustainability challenges inherent in food systems today. Although we welcome a diverse range of applicants, the focus of the position will be processing in relation to biochemically based solutions and could include the following disciplines:
  • Food process technology, ideally with an emphasis on fermentation & downstream processing
  • Food process system engineering
  • Use of sensor technologies such as in-line or at line spectroscopic tools
  • Large-data, modelling and prediction of food and ingredient processes.
  • Understanding of biological production systems and their use, and with an emphasis on downstream processing
A central part of the activities anchored to this position will be taking place in Campus Kalundborg, and it is crucial that the candidate is able to leverage the local ecosystem to foster strong collaboration with industry. Qualifications are expected in the following areas:
  • A collaborative and innovative mindset
  • Documented scientific impact and outreach in past research work
  • A proven track record in attracting external funding at both national and international level
  • Experience with international collaborations
  • Ability to establish industrial collaboration
  • Excellent interpersonal and communicative skills
Tenure-track assistant professor The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations regarding publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Ingredient Biochemical Processing. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties. The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact. Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered. Associate professor Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required. The candidate must be an inspiring teacher with a vision on teaching development, especially in connection with the new MSc Biosolutions program. A new campus with research and teaching facilities is currently being built in Kalundborg and the candidate is expected to contribute to setting up the facilities Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department. Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered. University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement. Please read more here For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here The tenure-track assistant programme The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures. Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields. After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen. Salary and employment conditions The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff. Employment is as either tenure track assistant professor or associate professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish). The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background. The Professor will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing. Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk). Filing of application The position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level or associate professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below). The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below. Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include
  • Curriculum vitae including:
    • Please describe and document international network and relations
    • Please describe and document internationally based activities
    • Positions held at universities/research institutions outside Denmark
    • Outreach activities, i.e. popular lectures or other activities in the media
    • Grants held, personal or in part. Career development grants.
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan - description of current and future research plans
  • If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document:
    • Experience with supervision of BSc and MSc students
    • Teaching experience
    • Formal pedagogical training
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers
Applying for the associate professorship please include
  • Curriculum vitae including information about external funding
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans
  • Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers
The deadline for applications is 1 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1. After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/. Interviews will be held on 8 March 2027. Please refer to the following no. in future communication in this case: 211-0263/26-2N, Tenure-track Assistant Professor Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. 211-0760/26-2E, Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing.

jobs.title: Autolakerer til Hillerød - Er du autolakerer med stolthed i dit håndværk?
jobs.description:
Godt håndværk kan ses i det færdige resultat. Hos Byens bilpleje.com i Hillerød søger vi en autolakerer, der arbejder grundigt, har sans for detaljerne og sætter en ære i at give bilerne en flot finish. Er det dig, kan du blive en del af et team, hvor faglighed og godt samarbejde går hånd i hånd.

Byens bilpleje.com er Danmarks førende virksomhed inden for kosmetisk klargøring af biler; herunder autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse samt udskiftning af autoglas - vi er bilbranchens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Byens bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og beskæftiger i dag over 400 medarbejdere. Herudover håndterer virksomheden mere end 200.000 biler om året.

Fra klargøring til flot finish

Du bliver en del af vores team af lakspecialister, hvor dine opgaver blandt andet omfatter:

  • Spartling, slibning og afdækning inden lakering.
  • Udbedring af mindre buler og ridser.
  • Sprøjtelakering med fokus på kvalitet og finish.
  • Kontrol af det udførte arbejde.
  • Planlægning af egne opgaver i samarbejde med kollegaerne.
  • Øvrige opgaver i afdelingen, hvor vi hjælper hinanden.

Du er grundig og tager ansvar

Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • Er uddannet autolakerer eller har erfaring fra faget.
  • Har øje for detaljerne og sætter en ære i at levere et godt resultat.
  • Arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret.
  • Bevarer overblikket, også når der er travlt på værkstedet.
  • Er en hjælpsom kollega, der bidrager til en god arbejdsdag.
  • Har kørekort (B).

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer, overenskomst og pension.
  • Gode redskaber og kvalitetsprodukter, så du har de rette rammer for dit arbejde.
  • Mulighed for at udvikle dine faglige kompetencer.
  • Dygtige kollegaer og en uformel arbejdsplads med humor og godt humør.

Er du vores nye kollega?

Vi holder samtaler løbende og vil gerne have vores nye autolakerer med på holdet hurtigst muligt. Vi venter dog gerne på den rette. Kan du se dig selv hos os? Så send din ansøgning allerede i dag.

Grundet GDPR-forordningen modtager vi ikke ansøgninger på mail, hvorfor disse ikke tages i betragtning. Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com.

jobs.title: Master Thesis in Adaptive Architecture for Human-AI Annotation Systems
jobs.description: Company description:.Job description:    Thesis Scope & Problem Statement   This thesis project is intended for two Master's students working together. The central focus of this Master's thesis is to design, implement, and evaluate a confidence-aware adaptiverification architecture within the existing annotation tool. Instead of applying the same review process every detection or scene, the system will use confidence signals to select an appropriate depth of humverification. This is a software engineering thesis focused on how to structure, integrate, test, and evaluathat adaptive behavior, with particular attention to maintainability, traceability, fallback behavior, andeffective human oversight. Existing AI models provide the application context; developing new perceptimodels is not the primary objective. Research Objectives & Tasks   The work may include:      Design and integrate a modular architecture with explicit interfaces for confidence providerverification policies, decision logging, and annotator feedbac     Implement confidence-provider components that expose calibrated or normalized signals, such model confidence, model agreement, source model, and object class frequency, through a comminterface.     Implement and compare interchangeable threshold-based and learned decision policies for routingcases to light review, full review, or a second review. Automatic acceptance will be considered onlywhere permitted by safety policy, with low-confidence, out-of-distribution, and safety-critical casrouted to human review.     Integrate attention cues into the annotation interface and record the signals, policy version, selectedreview mode, and human outcome for each routing decision.     Develop automated tests for routing decisions, component interfaces, and fallback behavior.     Benchmark the adaptive architecture against existing manual, sequential, and parallel workflousing annotation correctness, recall on safety-critical classes, error catch rates, task completion time,routing overhead, and human intervention.     Evaluate maintainability and testability through change scenarios, such as adding a confidenprovider or replacing a decision policy.     Conduct a counterbalanced user study to investigate verification behavior, cognitive workload, trucalibration, and susceptibility to automation bias.  Depending on feasibility and measurable added value, the work may also explore out-of-distributiondetection or vision-language-model-derived scene complexity as additional confidence signals. The coevaluation will use fixed policies during controlled experiments; online adaptation is an optional extension.     Who Are We?   You will join the Verification & Validation (V&V) Virtual Driver team at V.A.S., focused on ensuring tintegrity of the software stack for autonomous decision-making and control. The team brings togetherdevelopers with varied backgrounds and seniority, all centered around robust V&V practices. Theenvironment is friendly and helpful, with both in-office development and in-vehicle testing.     Who Are You?   You are a final-year Master's student in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, withstrong interest in software architecture, software quality, and building maintainable systems. You arecomfortable programming in Python and interested in extending and evaluating an existing softwareplatform in an industrial setting. You should have a foundation in modular software design, interface design, automated testing, and versioncontrol, together with an interest in empirical software engineering. You should be motivated to comparedesign alternatives and connect architectural decisions with measurable effects on correctnesperformance, maintainability, and testability. Familiarity with AI-assisted systems, machine learning, computer vision, or human-computer interaction isadvantageous, but prior specialization in machine learning or object detection is not required. An interest inlearning enough about model confidence and human verification to make sound software design decisis important.     Why Join Us?   This thesis offers an opportunity to apply software engineering methods to a concrete industrial challengdesigning an adaptive human-AI workflow that is maintainable, testable, and auditable. You will build on existing annotation platform and prior thesis results, taking the work from architectural design throughimplementation and empirical evaluation. You will:      Gain hands-on experience in architectural design, component integration, automated testing, andevaluation of an industrial software system.     Investigate how confidence signals can guide human attention while preserving traceability ahuman oversight.     Measure architectural trade-offs across annotation correctness, performance, maintainabilittestability, and human effort.     Collaborate with engineers working on the validation of autonomous transport solutions.    You will gain practical experience in designing and evaluating human-AI systems in a safety-critical context.We look forward to receiving your application letter, academic transcript, and CV in English.           Preferred start date:  January 2027Application deadline: 15 November 2026   We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. jobs.title: Tenure Track assistant professor, associate professor or professor of Food Processing & Technology
jobs.description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor, Associate Professor or Full Professor of Food Processing & Technology Department of Food Science Faculty of Science University of Copenhagen The Department of Food Science, Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor, Associate Professor or Full Professor in Food Processing and Technology. Applicants must be capable of, and interested in, conducting and developing basic and applied interdisciplinary research of high international standard in the field of food processing and technology. The position will involve extensive collaborations within the department and with national and international academic groups and industrial partners. Research within the Department has a mission to unearth new solutions for society and industry to support sustainable food production, food security and safety as well as production of high-quality food promoting human health and wellbeing. The Department of Food Science is recognized for excellence in food research, education, and industrial collaborations. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. We encourage applications from a range of disciplines within the food science and technology area, ideally covering the understanding of food macromolecular interactions on a mechanistic level, how processing and formulation affect or determine these interactions, and how this influences final product quality with focus on functional properties. We are seeking a candidate who will establish an internationally leading research program, and we encourage a diverse range of applicants whose work may center on one or more of the following disciplines:
  • Developing a mechanistic understanding of interactions of food macromolecules in complex matrices during processing or formulation spanning dairy, plant, and single-cell protein sources.
  • How this knowledge can be used in the rational design of functional ingredients and healthy foods using established and emerging processing technologies
  • Development and utilization of high throughput methods for characterizing and quantifying the physicochemical behavior of food macromolecules in complex matrices.
  • Modelling and the use of machine learning/AI for simulation and prediction of the outcome of process unit operations on food and ingredient functionality.
  • Formulation and fluid dynamics of complex emulsions and the mechanisms governing this.
In addition, it is expected that this position will be involved in a significant amount of collaboration with industry, and therefore it is expected that the successful candidate has a documented successful track record in industry collaboration and working with innovation-oriented research. Furthermore, we expect that the successful candidate has a genuine interest in leadership and the wellbeing and development of their group. Tenure-track assistant professor The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations with regards to publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within the Tenure Track Assistant Professorship. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties. The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact. Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered. Associate professor and full professor Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required. In particular, the candidate must actively contribute with research-based teaching on the BSc in Food Science and Nutrition, and the MSc in Food Science and Technology programs, with an emphasis on the specialization in Dairy Science and Technology. Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department. Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship and full professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered. University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor / professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement. Please read more here: For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf For professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5c_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-professors.pdf Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here The tenure-track assistant programme The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures. Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields. After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen. Salary and employment conditions The position is open from 1 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff. Employment is either as tenure track assistant professor, associate professor or professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish). This position comes with an opportunity to negotiate a start package that will help leverage the candidate’s scientific deliverables in the initial years of employment. The negotiation for the start package takes place as part of the recruitment process. Please read about the contents of the programme and conditions, as well as UCPH’s extensive support for international researchers, here Start package programme – University of Copenhagen . The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background. The successful candidate will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing. The section has extensive collaborations on research projects with major food industries in both Denmark and abroad. Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk). Filing of application The position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level, associate professor level or full professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below). The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below. Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include
  • Curriculum vitae including:
    • Please describe and document international network and relations
    • Please describe and document internationally based activities
    • Positions held at universities/research institutions outside Denmark
    • Outreach activities, i.e. popular lectures or other activities in the media
    • Grants held, personal or in part. Career development grants.
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan - description of current and future research plans
  • If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document:
    • Experience with supervision of BSc and MSc students
    • Teaching experience
    • Formal pedagogical training
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers
Applying for the associate professorship or full professorship please include
  • Curriculum vitae including information about external funding
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans
  • Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers
The deadline for applications is 1 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1. After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/ Interviews will be held on 25 February 2027. Please refer to the following no. in future communication in this case: 211-0262/26-2N, Tenure-track Assistant Professor of Food Processing & Technology. 211-0759/26-2E, Associate Professor of Food Processing & Technology. 211-0366/26-2K, Professor of Food Processing & Technology.

jobs.title: Industrial Cleaners and Cleaning Supervisors Wanted – 6 Positions
jobs.description:
Manora Vikar ApS is looking for six reliable and responsible employees for temporary assignments with our clients in Copenhagen and Greater Copenhagen. We are recruiting both industrial cleaners and cleaning supervisors.

Industrial Cleaners – Your Responsibilities

  • Cleaning industrial facilities, production areas, warehouses, and associated staff facilities

  • Cleaning floors, surfaces, and equipment in accordance with the client’s instructions

  • Using appropriate cleaning products and equipment

  • Handling waste and maintaining hygiene standards

  • Following workplace safety procedures and using the required protective equipment

  • Reporting deficiencies, damage, and cleaning-related issues

Cleaning Supervisors – Your Responsibilities

  • Planning and coordinating daily cleaning tasks

  • Allocating tasks and providing instructions to cleaning staff

  • Training employees in cleaning methods, hygiene, and safe working procedures

  • Inspecting completed work and ensuring compliance with agreed cleaning standards

  • Following up on deficiencies and arranging corrective cleaning

  • Monitoring supplies and coordinating orders for cleaning products and equipment

  • Maintaining cleaning records and communicating with clients and employees

Who Are We Looking For?

For both roles, we value candidates who:

  • Are reliable, responsible, and attentive to detail

  • Can work independently and cooperate with colleagues

  • Are flexible regarding workplaces and working hours

  • Follow hygiene and safety instructions

  • Can communicate effectively with colleagues and clients

For industrial cleaner positions, previous experience in industrial or commercial cleaning is an advantage.

For cleaning supervisor positions, we expect relevant cleaning experience and the ability to plan tasks, guide employees, and carry out quality inspections. Previous supervisory experience is an advantage.

We Offer

  • Full-time work

  • Assignments with different clients

  • A flexible working environment

  • Opportunities for long-term collaboration and potentially permanent employment with the client

Location: Copenhagen / Greater CopenhagenWorking hours: Vary depending on the client and assignment; early morning, evening, night, and weekend work may be requiredStart date: As soon as possible / By agreementSalary: Based on qualifications

Apply Now

Send your CV and a short application to info@manora.dk, stating whether you are applying as an industrial cleaner or a cleaning supervisor.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.

We look forward to hearing from you.

PLEASE NOTE: WE ONLY ACCEPT WRITTEN INQUIRIES.

There are 6 positions available in total across the two roles.

jobs.description:

L'équipe mobile des hospitalisations compte 13 ETP.   • Vous réalisez des prestations techniques autonomes, prescrites ou confiées dans le respect des procédures
  • Vous assurez une communication vers le patient par une information et une éducation
  • Vous maintenez une collaboration étroite avec vos collègues afin d’assurer la continuité et la qualité

Le CHU Saint-Pierre est un hôpital public et universitaire de référence, offrant des soins de grande qualité accessibles à tous.

Dans ce cadre, il relève quotidiennement les défis de la santé publique tout en déclinant son caractère universitaire via une implication active dans l’enseignement et la recherche.

Les chiffres clés qui caractérisent l’hôpital sont les suivants :

  • 450.000 consultations/an
  • 45.000 admissions/an
  • 23.000 opérations chirurgicales/an
  • 85.000 passages aux urgences/an
  • 2900 accouchements/an
  • 3200 collaborateurs dont 400 médecins

Le respect, l’innovation, l’engagement, la qualité et la solidarité sont les valeurs clés de l’hôpital. Toutes et tous s’attèlent à placer le patient au centre de leur action. Les réponses aux réalités sociales, la tolérance, le libre-examen et la capacité à se mobiliser au quotidien pour les patients, bruxellois et non-bruxellois, sont les moteurs de ses actions.

La quête de l’excellence en médecine de pointe et l’approche multidisciplinaire, font de l’hôpital une référence sur le plan national.

Le CHU St Pierre travaille également en étroite collaboration avec de nombreux partenaires comme les médecins généralistes, médecins spécialistes référents, les CPAS et les autres institutions d’aides et de soins en Région bruxelloise.

Travailler au CHU Saint-Pierre, c’est à la fois faire partie d’un hôpital ancré dans la Ville depuis plusieurs siècles et d’un réseau hospitalier moderne en développement rapide, CHORUS, plus grand réseau hospitalier en Belgique. Travailler au CHU Saint-Pierre, c’est faire partie d’un groupe soudé, soutenant, au sein duquel chaque personne a sa place, afin d’offrir un service optimal. La satisfaction de nos patients et notre bien-être au travail sont nos priorités.

Offre:

Nous vous offrons un salaire en rapport avec votre niveau de formation et d’expérience.

Barème de rémunération:

  • Fonction IFIC : Infirmier en équipe mobile soins généraux - 6170
  • Fonction interne : Infirmier en hôpital
  • Catégorie IFIC : 14 – 14B Activé
  • Barème charte sociale : BH 1/2/3

Des avantages extra-légaux:

o Des chèques repas d’une valeur de 7,30€

o Des tarifs préférentiels en matière de soins médicaux dans tous les hôpitaux du réseau IRIS (pour vous, votre conjoint, vos ascendants ou descendants à charge)

o La gratuité des transports via la STIB et un remboursement de 80% dans les frais de transport en commun et/ou des indemnités vélo

o Une prime annuelle d’attractivité

o Une assurance Plan Pension (3% à charge de l’employeur)

o Une allocation mensuelle de bilinguisme de 150€ bruts (sous réserve de la remise du brevet Selor Art. 10)

o 24 jours de congés légaux et 5 jours de congés extra-légaux (+ les différents congés de circonstance)

o des réductions chez de nombreux fournisseurs via le système Benefits@work

o De multiples opportunités de carrières au sein d’un grand réseau (IRIS)

o Un parcours d’intégration personnalisé pour vous accompagner dans votre prise de poste

o Un programme de formations qui vous permettra d’évoluer tout au long de votre carrière.

jobs.title: Orthoptiste - CDD 6 MOIS - 38H - 2026-107
jobs.description:
Le service d’orthoptie en milieu hospitalier accueille des patients présentant des troubles visuels ou oculomoteurs nécessitant un bilan spécialisé ou une rééducation. L’équipe travaille en étroite collaboration avec les ophtalmologues et les autres professionnels du service pour assurer un diagnostic précis et une prise en charge coordonnée. Les orthoptistes y réalisent des examens fonctionnels de la vision, assurent la rééducation ou la réadaptation visuelle, et participent au suivi de diverses pathologies oculaires. Le service joue également un rôle important dans le dépistage, l’éducation du patient et parfois dans la formation et la recherche clinique.

En tant qu'orthoptiste, votre mission est d'évaluer et rééduquer les troubles de la vision et de la motricité oculaire, en collaboration étroite avec les ophtalmologues. Il réalise des bilans visuels, participe au dépistage et au suivi de pathologies oculaires, assure des séances de rééducation ou de réadaptation, et contribue à la prise en charge globale des patients, du nouveau-né à la personne âgée. Il intervient également dans l’éducation thérapeutique et peut participer à des activités de recherche ou de formation au sein du service hospitalier.

Vos responsabilités au quotidien sont :

  • Établir l’anamnèse du patient
  • Déterminer l’acuité visuelle, la réfraction et la tension oculaire
  • Dépister les anomalies de la vision des couleurs
  • Réaliser des examens tels que la biométrie, l’échographie et l’angiofluorographie, la tomographie par cohérence optique
  • Explorer le champ visuel
  • Participer à l’élaboration des dossiers d’études cliniques.

Profil recherché :

  • Posséder Bachelier en orthoptie ou posséder la dérogation à la nécessité d’un agrément sur la base des droits acquis en tant qu’orthoptiste-optométriste
  • Disposer d'une expérience en milieu hospitalier est un réel atout
  • Satisfaire aux conditions légales de bilinguisme : vous avez de bonnes connaissances de la seconde langue nationale ou vous êtes disposé à les acquérir (cours de langues organisés en interne sur le temps de travail, possibilité d’obtenir une prime de bilinguisme SELOR de 150€ bruts sous réserve de la remise du Selor Art. 10)
  • Satisfaire à l'examen de promotion ou à l'examen de sélection.

Qualités requises :

  • Connaissance basique des maladies ophtalmologiques
  • Disposition favorable à de nouveaux apprentissages
  • Esprit de rigueur et d’analyse
  • Bonne capacité d’expression et de rédaction en français, en néerlandais et en anglais
  • Résistance au stress
  • Sens de la collaboration
  • Une expérience des techniques de terrain constitue un atout.

jobs.title: Autolakerer søges til en hverdag med variation i Vamdrup
jobs.description:
Har du sans for detaljen og erfaring med afdækning, slibning og lakering? Er du stolt, når en bil forlader kabinen med en flot, ensartet og spejlblank finish? Hos Byens bilpleje.com i Vamdrup søger vi en autolakerer, som arbejder selvstændigt, holder overblikket og har lyst til at indgå i et godt fællesskab.

Om Byens Bilpleje

Byens Bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og er i dag en af Danmarks største aktører inden for kosmetisk klargøring, autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse og udskiftning af autoglas. Hos Byensbilpleje.com håndterer vi mere end 200.000 biler om året og har mere end 400 medarbejdere.

Det kommer du til at arbejde med

Din arbejdsdag byder på klargøring og lakering af biler. Du spartler, sliber og afdækker, udbedrer mindre buler og ridser og udfører sprøjtelakering. Undervejs sikrer du, at kvaliteten er i orden, og at hver opgave bliver afsluttet ordentligt. Du planlægger dine opgaver i samspil med resten af teamet og hjælper med afdelingens øvrige arbejde efter behov.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Ordne buler, spartle, slibe og afdækker (sprøjtelakerer), så bilerne står som nye.
  • Bidrage til at kvaliteten altid er i top.
  • Tage ansvar for egne arbejdsopgaver, og hjælpe resten af teamet, når der er brug for det.
  • Håndtere de øvrige opgaver, der naturligt følger med jobbet som autolakerer.

Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • Har uddannelse eller erfaring som autolakerer.
  • Kan strukturere dine opgaver og tilpasse dig dagens arbejdsflow.
  • Arbejder omhyggeligt og har øje for finish.
  • Tager ansvar og hjælper dine kollegaer.
  • Har kørekort til personbil.
  • Du må også gerne have humor og sætte pris på, at der er plads til en god bemærkning i løbet af dagen.

Hos os får du

Vi tilbyder løn efter kvalifikationer, overenskomst og pension. Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor kvalitet og godt håndværk bliver værdsat. Hos os får du adgang til gode redskaber og kvalitetsprodukter samt mulighed for at udvikle dig både personligt og fagligt. Hverdagen byder på dygtige kollegaer, godt humør og en uformel omgangstone.

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning via www.byensbilpleje.com. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler, og ansætter når vi har fundet den rigtige kollega - dog venter vi selvfølgelig gerne på det rette match.

Grundet GDPR-forordningen modtager vi ikke ansøgninger på mail, hvorfor disse ikke tages i betragtning. Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com.

jobs.description: Relove on kotimainen perheyritys, second hand -alan pioneeri ja rakastettu lifestyle-brändi, joka yhdistää laadukkaan second hand -myymälän ja tunnelmallisen kahvilan saman katon alle. Reloven maailmassa vastuullisuus, yhteisöllisyys ja ensiluokkainen asiakaskokemus kulkevat käsi kädessä. Liikkeissämme asiakkaat voivat tehdä upeita löytöjä, nauttia herkullisesta ruoasta ja kahvista sekä viettää aikaa inspiroivassa ympäristössä.Etsimme Relove Cafén tiimiin kokenutta, energistä ja innostavaa kahvilapäällikköä vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Helsinki-Vantaan lentoasemalle.Kahvilapäällikkönä johdat noin 15-20 hengen tiimiä ja huolehdit siitä, että kahvilan arki toimii sujuvasti, laadukkaasti ja tehokkaasti. Tärkein tehtäväsi on saada ihmiset onnistumaan yhdessä: rakennat hyvää yhteishenkeä, motivoit tiimiä ja varmistat selkeän ja tasapuolisen johtamisen. Tiimiisi kuuluu kahvilatyöntekijöiden lisäksi vuoropäälliköitä ja apulaiskahvilapäälliköitä, joiden työtä ohjaat ja tuet.Roolisi on käytännönläheinen ja operatiivinen. Olet mukana kahvilan päivittäisessä tekemisessä ja vastaat muun muassa toiminnan organisoinnista, resursoinnista, tuotteiden laadusta ja saatavuudesta, tilauksista, varaston ja hävikin hallinnasta sekä erinomaisen asiakaskokemuksen toteutumisesta.Tarjoamme sinulle- Vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työsuhteen- Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen esihenkilöroolin kansainvälisessä lentoasemaympäristössä- Mahdollisuuden johtaa ja kehittää sekä kahvilan toimintaa että sen työntekijöitä- Kiinteän kuukausipalkan (2 800-3 500 €/kk) kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi huomioiden- Vaihtelevat työajat maanantaista sunnuntaihin kahvilan aukioloaikojen mukaisesti klo 04-22 välillä- Hyvät työsuhde-edut (muun muassa työterveyshuolto, ePassi flex,jopa -50 % alennus Relovessa ja -20 % Rue Madamessa ruoka- ja juomatuotteistaitselle ja pöytäseurueelle)Odotamme sinulta- Vahvaa käytännön kokemusta kahvilaliiketoiminnasta sekä aikaisempaa kokemusta tiimin johtamisesta. Tunnet kiireisen kahvilaympäristön arjen ja osaat organisoida tekemistä, priorisoida sekä ratkaista eteen tulevia tilanteita. Arvostamme erityisesti kokemusta vilkkaista, suuren asiakasvolyymin toimintaympäristöistä sekä muiden esihenkilöiden johtamisesta.- Positiivista, ihmisläheistä ja innostavaa, mutta samalla jämäkkää ja johdonmukaista johtamista. Olet läsnä tiimisi arjessa, annat palautetta ja uskallat tarttua myös haastaviin tilanteisiin rakentavasti. Sinulle on luontevaa johtaa omalla esimerkilläsi ja luoda ympärillesi hyvää tekemisen meininkiä.Tehtävä edellyttää lisäksi- Vahvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa työn luonteen vuoksi, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi- Hygienia- ja anniskelupassia- Valmiutta työskennellä vaihtelevasti aikaisin aamulla, iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin- Nuhteetonta taustaa, sillä lentoasemalla työskenteleville teetetään turvallisuusselvitysKuulostaako tämä sinun seuraavalta askeleeltasi? jobs.title: Autolakerer til Odense - har du øje for den gode finish?
jobs.description:
Et flot resultat begynder med grundigt forarbejde. Hos Byens bilpleje.com i Odense søger vi autolakerer, der sætter en ære i sit håndværk og har blik for detaljerne - fra den første slibning til den sidste kvalitetskontrol. 

Byens bilpleje.com er Danmarks førende virksomhed inden for kosmetisk klargøring af biler; herunder autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse samt udskiftning af autoglas - vi er bilbranchens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Byens bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og beskæftiger i dag over 400 medarbejdere. Herudover håndterer virksomheden mere end 200.000 biler om året.

Fra forarbejde til færdigt resultat

Du bliver en del af vores team af lakspecialister, hvor du arbejder med:

  • Klargøring til lakering, herunder spartling, slibning og afdækning.
  • Udbedring af mindre buler og ridser.
  • Sprøjtelakering og kontrol af det færdige resultat.
  • Planlægning af egne opgaver og koordinering med kollegaerne.
  • Øvrige opgaver i afdelingen, hvor vi hjælper hinanden i mål.

Du kender dit håndværk

Vi leder efter dig der:

  • Er uddannet autolakerer eller har erfaring fra faget. 
  • Går op i kvalitet og finish.
  • Arbejder omhyggeligt og struktureret og kan bevare overblikket, når der er flere biler på vej gennem værkstedet.
  • Bidrager til samarbejdet og den gode stemning.
  • Trives i en hverdag, hvor ingen hverdage er ens.
  • Har kørekort (B).

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer.
  • Gode redskaber og kvalitetsprodukter til rådighed samt mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer. 
  • Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads med dygtige kollegaer, humor og plads til en god snak i pauserne.

Skal du med på holdet?

Vi holder samtaler løbende, da vi ønsker den helt rigtige til vores team, men vi venter selvfølgelig gerne på den rette. Tænker du at jobbet lyder som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning afsted med det samme.

jobs.title: Vik. socialhandledare, Tallbacken
jobs.description: Hos oss möter du barn, ungdomar och vuxna i olika livssituationer. Du blir en viktig del av arbetet med att skapa trygghet, skydd och en fungerande vardag för dem som bor hos oss.Tallbacken är ett kombinerat barn- och ungdomshem enligt barnskyddslagen och ett skyddshem för våldsutsatta personer och deras barn. Vi tar emot klienter från hela Åland och erbjuder stöd och omsorg utifrån deras behov och situation.Vi söker dig som är intresserad av ett omväxlande arbete där du möter människor i olika skeden av livet och med olika behov av stöd. Du har lätt för att skapa kontakt, är trygg i mötet med människor i utsatta situationer och kan ta egna initiativ. Du trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och som en del av arbetsgruppen.Tillsammans skapar vi en trygg och hemlik miljö med struktur och omsorg för barn, ungdomar och vuxna i utsatta livssituationer.Som person ser vi att du är ansvarstagande, flexibel, utåtriktad, gillar utmaningar samt har god förmåga att uttrycka dig i både tal och skrift. Du behöver ha lätt för att ta initiativ i kontakten med både klienter, anhöriga samt aktivt samverka med interna och externa samarbetspartner. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.Behörighetskravet är för uppgiften är lämplig högskoleexamen inom det sociala området i enlighet med 1 § landskapsförordning (2015:118) om skyddshemspersonal.
