jobs.title: PhD scholarship in Development of High Temperature Heat Pumps with Thermal Energy Storage - DTU Construct
jobs.description:
Do you want to start your research career by making industrial heat clean, flexible and affordable? At DTU Construct you will work at the forefront of technologies key to decarbonizing industries: high-temperature heat pumps and high-temperature thermal energy storage.We invite applications for a fully funded PhD position in the Thermal Energy Section of the Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at the Technical University of Denmark. The position is part of HeatMinds, a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Network funded by Horizon Europe. HeatMinds brings together 6 universities and research institutes and 12 industrial and research partners across Europe to develop industrial high-temperature heat pumps and thermal energy storage. Your project will develop new Carnot Battery technologies: systems that combine heat pumps based on high temperature thermodynamic cycles together with high-temperature thermal energy storage, such as molten salts and dual-media packed beds. These systems will deliver clean process heat while also giving industry flexibility on the electricity market.Supervision: Prof. Adriano Sciacovelli and Prof. Anders Christiansen Erlandsson with industrial secondments. Responsibilities and qualificationsYour overall goal will be to find out how industrial high temperature heat pumps can benefit from integrated thermal energy storage by developing new cost-effective, high-performance hybrid configurations. You will work with fellow doctoral candidates across the network and with industrial partners in Denmark and abroad.Your main tasks will be:
  • Develop and Design new architectures comprising cycles using natural working fluids and thermal energy storage, optimised for efficiency, cost, and fast response to electricity price signals
  • Carry out multi-objective optimisation and dynamic system analysis of alternative layouts
  • Validate results by carrying out experiments and data comparison during industrial secondments, turning the results into innovations with real-world impact (e.g. patents, future commercial solutions)
  • Publish in international journals, present at conferences and take part in HeatMinds network training, summer schools and outreach.
You have:
  • A solid background in engineering thermodynamics, heat transfer and energy technologies, e.g. conversion or storage systems
  • Familiarity with modelling and numerical simulations, for example for MSc thesis or student projects
  • Programming skills, preferably in Python, Matlab, Modelica or similar
  • Excellent written and spoken English, and the motivation to work in an international, goal-oriented environment.
MSCA eligibility: at the time of recruitment, you must not already hold a doctoral degree. You must also not have resided or carried out your main activities (work, studies, etc) in Denmark for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before your recruitment date.You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.Approval and Enrolment The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. We offerDTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.Salary and appointment termsThe appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures. The PhD salary will be based on the Marie S. Curie compensation scheme conditions and according to the grant agreement. Based on seniority the candidate will receive a minimum of DKK 30.264,08 (base salary) and DKK 1580,90 (PhD supplement). In addition, DTU will also pay pension consisting of 18,07%. Finally, it is possible to apply for family allowance. The period of employment is 3 years. The position is a full-time position. Starting date is anticipated as 1 April 2027, or according to mutual agreement. You can read more about career paths at DTU here.Further informationFurther information may be obtained from Prof. Adriano Sciacovelli, adrsc@dtu.dk and Prof. Anders Christiansen Erlandsson, acerl@dtu.dk. You can read more about Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at www.construct.dtu.dk. If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. Application procedure Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 24 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:
  • A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
  • Curriculum vitae
  • Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
  • A copy of thesis (if available) or other publications (if available)
  • A short critical literature review (max. 3 pages) on high-temperature heat pumps combined with thermal energy storage (e.g. Carnot Batteries): select up to 5 relevant publications and explain your choice, compare their methods & findings, identify possible open research questions, explaining how your background would help you address them. Include at least one figure or table of your own making.
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.DTU Civil and Mechanical Engineering develops and utilises science and technical knowledge for the benefit of society and the sustainable development. We undertake research, education, innovation, and scientific advice of the highest quality within building design and processes, building construction and safety, building energy and technical services, solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, coastal and maritime engineering, materials technology, manufacturing engineering, engineering systems design, design for sustainability, and thermal energy.DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.title: MHPSS Advisor
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) professional with a passion for advancing evidence-based MHPSS practice in humanitarian settings? Danish Red Cross (DRC) is looking for a MHPSS Advisor to provide technical expertise, capacity development, and quality assurance to the Red Cross Red Crescent National Societies (RCRC) National Societies delivering community-based MHPSS interventions in humanitarian settings.

About the position and the assignments  

You will be based at the Danish Red Cross HQ in Copenhagen and will be part of the Health Team in the Technical Quality and Impact Unit of the International Department. The Health Team comprises technical advisors within health and mental health and psychosocial support. It ensures the availability of the necessary technical capacities to provide timely and relevant assistance and advice to DRC-supported operations, with a primary focus on the Africa, while also supporting MHPSS interventions in MENA, Europe and Asia regions as needed.

As a member of the Health Team, you will be working under the line management of the Health Team Lead and will also work closely with other colleagues at the DRC HQ and Regional and Country Offices (COs), as well as with NSs staff and volunteers. You will also collaborate with the colleagues from the International Federation of the Red Cross Red Crescent (IFRC) and the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). The position does not have programme management responsibilities but supports programmes through technical accompaniment, mentoring, and quality assurance.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

  • Strategic planning and direction: Contribute to defining and rollout of DRC’s strategic directions within MHPSS in humanitarian settings. Support development and rollout of strategies, policies, and technical frameworks for MHPSS in humanitarian settings.
  • Technical support and guidance: Provide evidence-based guidance and advice to DRC COs and National Societies on MHPSS priorities, approaches and activities, remotely or through country visits and missions to ensure that MHPSS interventions follow industry standards and good practice. Support development or adaptation and rollout of relevant technical tools and guidelines to meet operational needs.
  • Strengthening of capacities: Support National Societies in assessing technical capacity needs, and in designing and implementing capacity-strengthening plans, including trainings, coaching, mentoring, and technical supervision. 
  • Program monitoring and evaluation:  Support planning and undertaking of assessments, baselines, endlines, reviews and evaluations, and monitoring of MHPSS interventions.
  • Advocacy: In close collaboration with relevant humanitarian diplomacy (HD) colleagues, contribute to DRC’s policy influencing, advocacy and HD efforts on MHPSS in humanitarian settings.
  • Resource mobilisation: Support proposal development by contributing to the design and quality assurance of MHPSS components in the project proposals that align with donor requirements and organisational goals and priorities.
  • Partnerships and collaboration: Foster thematic partnerships and joint MHPSS initiatives within the RCRC Movement and with external stakeholders. 
  • Surge deployments: Undertake MHPSS surge/deployments in support of DRC bi-lateral operations and wider RCRC Movement responses, including multilateral deployments with the ICRC and the IFRC.  

 

Your profile

We are looking for an experienced MHPSS professional with at least five years of experience working on community-based MNHPSS with humanitarian and development organisations, including at least three years in international postings in Africa and MENA regions. You hold a master's degree, or equivalent experience, in MHPSS, social sciences, or another relevant field. You have sound technical, strategy and advisory skills within community-based MHPSS in humanitarian settings and migration. You have proven experience developing and adapting technical guidance, tools and training materials, as well as designing and facilitating capacity-development initiatives for staff and volunteers of partner organisations. 

You have experience supporting assessments, technical reviews, evaluations, and the development of quality assurance processes for community-based MHPSS interventions. You are an excellent facilitator and communicator with strong interpersonal and cross-cultural skills. You work collaboratively, are well organised, and are able to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines. You are willing and able to undertake field missions, including emergency deployments, with travel of up to four months per year. Professional working proficiency in both English and French is required. Experience of working for the International RCRC Movement is considered an asset. 

We offer

A job with an opportunity to improve the lives of the most vulnerable people around the world. We further offer a unique opportunity to influence the strategic development and mainstreaming of MHPSS in humanitarian settings.

The position is a full-time position - 37 working hours per week. The position is 12 months with possibility for extension.

Salary and employment conditions are in accordance with Danish Red Cross’s collective bargaining agreement with HK and AC, depending on experience and qualifications. The position is based at the Danish Red Cross headquarters in Copenhagen and requires on-site presence. As this is a national position based in Denmark, the salary package does not include relocation assistance to Denmark and housing or family-related allowances.

Your future workplace

The International Red Cross and Red Crescent network is the largest humanitarian network in the world, with a presence and activities in almost every country. All Red Cross and Red Crescent activities have one central purpose: to help those who suffer, without discrimination, whether during conflict, in response to natural or man-made disasters, or due to conditions of chronic poverty. Our work is guided by seven fundamental principles: humanity, impartiality, independence, voluntary service, unity, and universality. 

DRC’s international department’s approx. 300 staff supporting RCRC NSs with planning and implementing humanitarian and development interventions in some of the most challenging contexts in 20 countries across Africa, MENA, Asia, and Europe.

We offer a meaningful work at a purpose-driven workplace with truly engaged colleagues. We focus on professional challenges, well-being and a flexible organising of your work life. All of us contribute to a great work environment and colleagueship. 

 

Application and further information

For any specific questions about the position, please contact us at zesd@rodekors.dk subject “MHPSS Advisor 2026”.

Interviews will take place in the second part of November with an expected start date as soon as possible and no later than 01 January 2027. 

We look forward to receiving your application and CV no later than 18 November 2026. Application and CV in English are accepted only through our online recruitment system. Applications made by email will not be reviewed.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist within Applied Nuclear Technology
jobs.description:
The Institute of Energy Technology (IFE) is an independent research foundation in Norway, with locations in Kjeller and Halden. We are an internationally leading research environment that actively develops innovative solutions through people and technology. We operate under the mission 'Research for a better future'. IFE is a broad interdisciplinary research organization with top-level international expertise in digital technologies, material and process technology, flow and analysis technology, environmental technology, critical raw materials, radiopharmaceutical technology, and nuclear technology and safety.

The Tracer Technology Department at IFE is an internationally recognized research department with a strong and growing focus on applied nuclear technology. For more than 40 years, the department has pioneered tracer technologies and tracing methods used globally to study fluid flow, mass transport, and complex industrial and environmental processes. Today, we have extended our R&D competence and know-how on: tracers for Oil & Gas Industry, tracers for geothermal applications, environmental monitoring, critical raw materials and applied nuclear technology. We conduct research and innovation spanning within radiochemistry, medical radionuclides, neutron technologies, radiation-based industrial services, environmental radioactivity, advanced radioanalytical methods and process analytical chemistry. We are a core member of the Norwegian Nuclear Research Centre (NNRC), and we are hosting a national infrastructure project on neutron generators (HUNT).

A major strategic investment is IFE's future laboratory building, which is planned to house a whole floor of dedicated radioactivity laboratories designed to support advanced research, technology development, testing, and commercial services involving radionuclides, radioactive materials and irradiation. The department has responsibility for the on-going development, and use of IFE’s future radioactivity laboratories when these will be completed. They will comprise of state-of-the-art B-laboratories, neutron generator laboratories, irradiation facilities, a laboratory for processing of radioactive industrial sources, calibration of radiation measuring instruments and has access to extensive radioanalytical laboratories. By combining expertise in nuclear science, radiochemistry, analytical chemistry, and engineering disciplines, the department develops innovative research-based solutions and commercial services that contribute to technological advancement, industrial competitiveness, and the green transition. These facilities will provide a unique national capability for applied nuclear technology research and innovation, enabling us to translate scientific advances into practical solutions for the industry, the public authorities and international partners and customers.

Main responsibilities and work tasksWe are looking for a motivated and business-oriented senior researcher with expertise in Applied Nuclear Technology, with emphasis on irradiation technologies, neutron-based systems, radiation effects, and industrial applications of ionizing radiation.The successful candidate will generate and lead new research initiatives, secure funding from national, international, and industrial sources, and develop commercially relevant services based on irradiation technologies and radiation science. The role includes working with neutron generators, irradiation facilities, and other advanced radiation-based technologies, while collaborating closely with industrial customers to transform scientific advances into practical and valuable applications. You are strongly expected to develop and further expand the capabilities of the new radioactivity laboratories, and maximize the commercial and R&D potential of these facilities on national and international level.Educational Background

PhD (or equivalent experience) in Nuclear Engineering, Applied Nuclear Physics, Radiation Science, Experimental Nuclear Physics or a related field with preferably 5-10 years relevant experience after the completion of the Ph.D.Technical qualificationsDemonstrated experience in neutron generators and accelerator-based neutron sources is desired and in addition in one or more of the following areas:

  •  Gamma irradiation facilities
  •  Radiation effects testing of materials and electronic
  •  Radiation detection and measurement systems
  •  Nuclear instrumentation
  •  Neutron imaging and non-destructive testing
  •  Industrial applications of ionizing radiation
  •  Radioisotope production or radiochemical applications

Project generation qualifications

  •  Demonstrated track record of generating externally funded R&D projects from national, European, or industrial funding sources.
  •  Experience developing commercial research-based services and engaging with industrial partners.

Further experience

  •  Project leading experience is necessary.
  •  Experimentalist, with hands-on laboratory work experience.
  •  Contribution to development of regulatory documents for internal use or for the authorities regarding the instruments or the facility is expected.
  •  Strong awareness towards Health Safety Environment and Radiation Protection regulations compliance. The latter is highly important.
  •  Knowledge of nuclear instrumentation is an advantage but not required.
  •  Excellent communication in oral/written English. Norwegian language skills both oral and written or the genuine interest to learn within two years.
Personality

We are looking for a person who is a genuine team player, who creates safe and trust-based relationships both within our organization and with our customers.

  • Motivated and engaging person within the professional area and towards the colleagues.
  •  Proactive with high degree of initiative and creativity.
  •  Safe, clear and transparent communicator.
  •  You can lead project teams while also be a team-member.
  •  You should be solution-oriented.
  •  Structured.
  •  You take responsibility.
  •  You take decisions in line with the department and the organization.
  •  You enjoy cooperating with both academic and industrial partners.
We offer
  •  Competitive salary, pension- and insurance schemes.
  •  Exciting and challenging tasks in a team that works in the forefront of research.
  •  Participation in a leading international research team.
  • Collaboration with other departments.
  •  Competent and easy to collaborate colleagues in a professional environment that values mutual growth.
  •  A growing and healthy organization that is focused on individual and group development.
  •  Flexible working hours.

 

How to ApplyThe following application materials must be submitted through the IFE job application portal:

  • Cover Letter
  •  Curriculum Vitae
  •  Diplomas
We place great emphasis on your personal suitability for the position. IFE is subject to the Security Act, which includes requirements for the organisation’s management of critical national information, as well as other relevant legislation concerning the management of sensitive information. The successful applicant for the position advertised will have access to classified information and critical national objects and infrastructure. In order to meet the qualification criteria, the applicant must therefore meet the security clearance and/or authorisation requirements. Note that relevant applicants will be asked questions that are necessary to ascertain this. This includes questions about any ties to countries that the PST has classified as a ‘high-risk country’ in its open threat assessment. Background checks are performed as part of our recruitment process.ContactsGeorgios Kalantzopoulos, Department Head Christian Dye, Research Director, 415 11 823 LocationInstituttveien 18 2007 Kjeller Key information:Employer: Institutt for energiteknikk (IFE) Reference number: 5188929381 Percentage of full-time: 100% Permanent position Application deadline: 07/11/2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Research for a better future IFE conducts research for a better future. Since 1948, we have been a frontrunner in international energy research. We contribute to new solutions in renewable energy, petroleum and industry. We develop zero-emission transport solutions, digital systems and ground-breaking cancer medicine. IFE develops new solutions for the industry and public sector in over 30 countries. IFE is host to the international OECD NEA Halden Projects. We are about 550 employees and the annual turnover is about NOK 1,2 billion. Read more about IFE at www.ife.no/en

jobs.title: Aktiviteettipäällikkö Holiday Club Saimaan Rauhaan
jobs.description: Tykkäätkö keksiä uutta, innostaa ihmisiä ja saada asioita tapahtumaan? Haluaisitko olla mukana luomassa elämyksiä, jotka tekevät asiakkaidemme lomasta ja vapaa-ajasta entistäkin ikimuistoisemman?Etsimme nyt joukkoomme idearikasta, innostavaa ja toimeen tarttuvaa aktiviteettipäällikköä vastaamaan Holiday Club Saimaan Rauhan aktiviteettien suunnittelusta, kehittämisestä ja toteutuksesta. Tehtävässä johdat omaa tiimiäsi, kehität palvelutarjontaa sekä vastaat aktiviteettien vetovoimasta ja kannattavuudesta. Osallistut myös käytännön tekemiseen arjen toiminnassa. Tarjoamme vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen tehtävän.TehtävästäAktiviteettipäällikkönä vastaat Saimaan Rauhan aktiviteettikokonaisuudesta sekä aktiviteettitiimin esihenkilötyöstä. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä Resort Managerin kanssa ja raportoit tehtävässäsi hänelle. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät liikunta- ja elämyspalveluiden kehittäminen, ihmisten johtaminen, käytännön tekeminen sekä liiketoiminnallinen vastuu.Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on kokemusta palveluliiketoiminnan kehittämisestä ja esihenkilötyöstä. Sinulla on liikunta-alan osaamista ja ymmärrystä hyvinvointiin, liikuntaan ja aktiiviseen vapaa-aikaan liittyvien palveluiden suunnittelusta ja ohjaamisesta. Innostut uusien ideoiden kehittämisestä, osaat motivoida ihmisiä ja luoda mieleenpainuvia kokemuksia erilaisille ja eri-ikäisille asiakasryhmille.Liikunta ja hyvinvointi ovat tärkeä osa työnkuvaasi, mutta meillä aktiviteetit tarkoittavat paljon muutakin. Liikunnan rinnalla ne voivat olla tapahtumia, teemallisia ohjelmia, yhdessä tekemistä tai täysin uusia konsepteja. Arvostamme rohkeutta kokeilla uutta, kykyä tunnistaa mahdollisuuksia sekä taitoa viedä ideat käytäntöön. Osallistut myös itse aktiviteettien ohjaamiseen ja toteuttamiseen.Esihenkilönä johdat ja innostat aktiviteettitiimiä, huolehdit arjen sujuvuudesta ja luot edellytyksiä sille, että tiimi onnistuu työssään. Kehität toimintaa asiakaslähtöisesti ja huolehdit samalla siitä, että aktiviteettitarjonta tukee myös resortin liiketoimintaa.Tehtävä on lähityötä Holiday Club Saimaan Rauhassa, sillä aktiviteettien kehittäminen, toteuttaminen ja tiimin johtaminen edellyttävät vahvaa läsnäoloa paikan päällä.KohteestaHoliday Club Saimaan Rauha on Saimaan rannalla sijaitseva monipuolinen lomakeskus, jossa yhdistyvät majoitus, ravintolat, kokous- ja tapahtumapalvelut sekä laaja aktiviteettitarjonta. jobs.title: Brøndby PPR søger psykologer til en fast stilling og et barselsvikariat
jobs.description:
Brøndby PPR søger psykologer til en fast stilling og et barselsvikariat

I PPR Brøndby søger vi to psykologer – en til en fast stilling og en til et barselsvikariat. Vi har bl.a. fået flere ressourcer til samarbejdet med Heldagstilbuddet Nørregård, som er Brøndby kommunes vidtgående specialiseret skole- og fritidstilbud for børn med autismespektrumsforstyrrelser og betydelige funktionsnedsættelser.

I PPR Brøndby er vi optagede af at bidrage til at skabe afgørende positive forandringer for børn og unge i deres udviklingsmiljøer og fællesskaber. Det gør vi både via vores arbejde med de ”traditionelle” PPR-opgaver og vores nye indsatser, der for psykologgruppens del bl.a. omfatter NUSSA, supervision i dagtilbud/skole og Diamantforløb. Udover dette er det psykologerne i PPR, der varetager en stor del af opgaverne inden for vores lettilgængelige behandlingstilbud. I tillæg til dette er vi vilde med prøvehandlinger, som vi løbende sætter i gang i og på tværs af faggrupperne. I PPR Brøndby er kulturen præget af nysgerrighed, faglige drøftelser og engagement. Hvis du kan se dig selv ind i det, så vil vi elske at byde dig velkommen fra d. 1. januar 2027

Lidt om, hvad du træder ind i

Det er vigtigt for os at være relevante samarbejdspartnere for såvel børn, unge og deres familier som for fagprofessionelle på området. Vi har derfor fokus på at gøre en reel forskel tæt på hverdagen og i praksis. Det gør vi med afsæt i høj faglighed, gode samarbejdsvaner, kreative løsninger samt blik og omsorg for den situation og kompleksitet, som både børn, unge, familier og eksterne kolleger står i.

For at understøtte et højt fagligt niveau har vi bl.a. regelmæssig ekstern supervision for alle psykologer og specialpædagogiske vejledere samt særligt tilrettelagte supervisionsforløb for psykologer under autorisation. Derudover er der løbende muligheder for at deltager på konferencer og kurser. 

Som ny medarbejder kan du forvente et godt introduktionsforløb, så du føler dig klædt på til at træde ud i opgaverne der venter – uanset, om du kommer med meget eller lidt erfaring. Derudover får du også tilknyttet en mentor ifm. din opstart. Derudover er både psykologfaglig koordinator, teamleder og PPR-leder alle psykologer med flere års erfaring fra PPR. 

Hvad ligger der i jobbet?

Du kommer til at indgå i tværfaglige såvel som selvstændige opgaver. Vi har opgaver både på almen- og specialområdet og samarbejder om alle børn dækkende gruppen 0-18-årige i kommunen og der er bl.a. også mulighed for at understøtte samarbejdet omkring meget funktionsnedsatte børn. I alle disse opgaver indgår sparring og rådgivning til pædagoger, lærere og ledelse, inddragelse af forældre, psykologiske undersøgelser (herunder test og observationer), og hvad du ellers fagligt vurderer vil kunne understøtte børn og unges udvikling, læring og trivsel. Der arbejdes i vid udstrækning med at understøtte de voksne i netværket omkring barnet/den unge, ligesom vi har et skærpet fokus på ikke at se barnet/den unge isoleret fra dets kontekst, men rette indsatser mod barnet/den unges undervisnings- og læringsmiljø. 

Brøndby kommunes lettilgængelige behandling varetages primært af psykologer i PPR og psykologerne i PPR også varetager kommunens krisestøtte til børn og unge, hvorfor dette også kan være en af dine opgaver. Det er væsentligt for os at sammensætte en opgaveportefølje, der giver mening både for den enkelte men også for den samlede opgaveløsning. 

Din profil

Vi håber at se din ansøgning, hvis du kan genkende dig selv i profilen:

  • Er uddannet psykolog og gerne autoriseret/med praksisuddannelse.
  • Er nyuddannet psykolog med mod på PPR-området.
  • Har erfaring med PPR eller andre aspekter af børne-/ungeområdet. 
  • Står godt i din psykologfaglighed og forstår at anvende den til at formidle, inspirere og inddrage andre i deres arbejde omkring børn, unge og fællesskaber – til tider med afsæt i psykologiske vurderinger, men langt overvejende i din psykologfaglige sparring og inspiration.
  • Arbejder og samarbejder både fleksibelt og målrettet med afsæt såvel det at være PPR-medarbejder og det at være psykolog. 
  • Forstår at navigere i den kompleksitet, som ofte præger opgaver i PPR. Du holder modet oppe og pulsen nede. 
  • Har gode erfaringer med mødeledelse og blik for positioneringer i kommunikationen – både for dig selv og for andre.
  • Er indstillet på, i en ånd af dialog, at lade dig udfordre både i din praksis og dine tanker/ideer – ligesom du er generøs med din viden og positivt bidragende til den fælles opgave med at skabe høj faglighed, godt kollegaskab og god trivsel.
  • Arbejder samskabende og forebyggende sammen med de voksne, der omgiver børn og unge.
  • Har erfaring for at arbejde med målgruppen for heldagstilbuddet Nørregård.

Kort om PPR Brøndby 

PPR’s arbejde har afsæt i en systemisk, kontekstuel og relationel forståelse af børn og unges adfærd, trivsel, oplevelser og muligheder for udvikling og deltagelse. PPR er en enhed under Børne-, Kultur- og Idrætsforvaltningen i Brøndby kommune. PPR understøtter Brøndby Kommunes Strategi 2030 og Sammenhængende Børne- og Ungepolitik, herunder det fælles børnesyn som lyder:

”Børn og unge gør det bedste, de kan, med de kompetencer, de har. Det er de voksnes ansvar at inddrage børn og unge i positive fællesskaber og læringsmiljøer med lige adgang til at udfolde og udvikle sig og trives”.

PPR Brøndby udgøres aktuelt af 6 sansemotoriske terapeuter, 9 specialpædagogiske vejledere, 14 logopæder, 19 psykologer, 3 administrative medarbejdere, 4 fagkoordinatorer, 2 teamledere og 1 PPR-leder. 

Du kan læse mere om PPR på https://www.brondby.dk/Borger/Familie-og-boern/Skole/Saerlig-stoette/PaedagogiskPsykologiskRaadgivning.aspx

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår:

Tiltrædelse: 1. januar 2027, eller før hvis muligt.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst.

Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt, eller ned til 32 timer hvis du ønsker det.

 

Yderligere information:

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte os. Teamleder, Trine Bornhøft kan kontaktes på tlf. 23 71 21 92. TR, Christian Lau Godskesen kan kontaktes på tlf. 92 43 25 14.

PPR har til huse på Brøndby Rådhus, Park Alle, 2605 Brøndby samt på distriktskontorer i kommunen, men vores opgaver løses primært ude på Brøndby kommunes skoler og dagtilbud. I forbindelse med ansættelse vil der blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest. I forbindelse med ansættelse vil der blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest.

Rekrutteringsprocessen: 

Ansøgningsfrist: d. 12.november 2026

Vi udvælger kandidater d. 16. november 2026 og inviterer efterfølgende til samtaler

Første samtaler: 19. november 2026 

Anden samtaler: 24. november 2026

 

Søg stillingen via 'ansøg'-knappen. Her kan du uploade din ansøgning og CV samt evt. relevant dokumentation. Alle interesserede ansøgere uanset alder, køn, handicap, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold opfordres til at søge stillingen.I Brøndby Kommune er der en generel politik om, at nyansatte skal forevise straffeattest. Ved beskæftigelse og direkte kontakt med børn under 15 år, indhentes der også en børneattest.Brøndby Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Brøndby er en centralt beliggende hovedstadskommune med cirka 40.000 indbyggere. Byens puls er præget af fællesskab, mangfoldighed og en stærk idrætskultur. Vi er en kommune med kant og spændende kontraster med bolig- og erhvervsområder, skove, grønne områder og Strandparken med havet og indsøerne.

jobs.title: Gram Equipment Graduate Program
jobs.description:
Unleash your potential in the Gram Equipment Graduate talent program - Experience hands-on learning in real business settings, open doors to global career opportunities, and join a community of change-makers!

About Us:

Gram Equipment is a global leader in providing innovative solutions for the ice cream and dairy industry. We are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology and driving forward the future of our industry. As part of our commitment to nurturing talent and fostering excellence, we are excited to announce our Graduate Program, designed to provide an immersive experience for aspiring professionals who are passionate about both mechanical engineering and commercial business.

Program Overview:

Our Graduate Program offers a unique opportunity for candidates with diverse backgrounds to gain a well-rounded experience in our organization. The program spans a duration of 24 months, divided into four rotations of six months each. This structure ensures that participants gain a comprehensive understanding of both mechanical engineering and commercial aspects of our business.

Qualifications:

We are seeking candidates who have or will graduate either in 2026 or in 2027, and who meet the following criteria:

  • Mechanical Engineering Background with Commercial Interest:

Candidates with a mechanical engineering background who possess a strong interest in commercial business and project management.

  • Commercial Engineering Background with Mechanical Engineering Interest:

Candidates with a commercial/business-oriented Engineering background who are keen to explore the world of mechanical engineering.

Key Program Highlights:

  • Mentorship: Participants will have the opportunity to work closely with a personal mentor from our global management team, offering valuable insights and guidance throughout the program.
  • Continuous Development: Gram Equipment is committed to fostering the growth and development of its talent. Participants will have access to the Gram Academy, a platform dedicated to ongoing learning and skill development.
  • International Rotation: Possibility for an international 6 month rotation in either our Turkish or US location.
  • Community Building: Join a vibrant and peer -based community of talented individuals within our organization, creating opportunities for networking, knowledge sharing, and collaboration.

How to Apply & Our Recruitment Process:

Our recruitment process is designed to identify and nurture potential talent. We believe in comprehensive evaluation, from video interviews and cognitive assessments to in-depth interviews and real-world business case evaluations during the Assessment Day, ensuring we welcome the best fit for our Graduate Program.

  1. Application and Assessment: Apply before 1st of March 2027, and if shortlisted, you'll complete a video interview and cognitive assessment.
  2. Interview and Evaluation: Promising candidates proceed to a comprehensive evaluation phase, which evaluates their behavioral competencies and business acumen, including a detailed assessment of a business case.
  3. Contract and Start Date: Upon impressing us at every stage, you'll sign a contract and officially begin your journey with the Gram Equipment Graduate Program on 1st of September 2027.

Join Us in Shaping the Future:

At Gram Equipment, we believe that innovation is driven by diverse perspectives and talents. Join our Graduate Program to embark on a journey that will equip you with the skills, knowledge, and experiences needed to excel in both the mechanical engineering and commercial aspects of our dynamic industry.

We look forward to welcoming the next generation of leaders to our team.

“For me, the biggest value being part of the Gram Equipment Graduate Program has been the people I have worked with along the way and the understanding I have gained of how the different parts of the organization come together.”Tommy Bui (ENG Integrated Design - SDU) - Project Manager at Gram Equipment

“The Graduate program gave me a strong network across the entire company and useful insights into many of our internal processes.” / “Contributing to such a significant change as a graduate was both empowering and a clear example of how my work could make a meaningful difference.”Luciana Apachitei (ENG in Global Business Engineering - VIA University College) - Engineering Excellence Project Manager "At Gram Equipment, I have shaped the company's direction and the projects related to it. I have had the chance to choose the projects that interested me. Many of the things I have learned in my studies, I have been able to apply to what I am doing at Gram Equipment, from engineering work to business understanding. I am actively involved in the strategy work, engineering practices and various digitalization tools. I use a lot of theoretical knowledge that I have acquired in my Engineering studies in relation to my daily work. My business background helped me understand how the business is working, and because the company foundation is at the technical aspect, my background has helped me identify its strengths and weaknesses very fast." -Rudy Mandrup Cazelles (ENG Product Development and Innovation - SDU) - Business Developer at Gram Equipment

Gram Equipment is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Store Design Associate
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Associate Store Designer supports our franchise expansion from an own HQ point of view by delivering high-quality, on-brand store designs through structured processes and strong governance. The role ensures all projects meet global design standards, timelines, and approval requirements, while maintaining full documentation and alignment between design intent and final build.

The job is a full-time role. We expect the start date to be 1st of December.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee 3rd party designers and ensure design packages aligned with Design Manual and Design Hardgates.

  • Review and acknowledge project kick-offs.

  • Maintain design timelines and update project trackers.

  • Safeguard design compliance with design manuals, materials, and concept standards.

  • Manage design documentation to internal platforms.

  • Support external designers and franchise partners to ensure correct implementation.

  • Assist with design audits and ensure alignment between design and final store outcome.

  • Contribute to maintaining and improving design manuals, tools, and processes.

WHO YOU ARE

  • An early-career professional ready to apply your developing design and project management skills to franchise store execution.

  • Someone who takes ownership of defined tasks and delivers accurately, on time, and in line with global standards.

  • Comfortable handling straightforward design and coordination challenges independently, and confident escalating more complex issues when needed.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Developing design and project management skills, with an eye for detail and brand consistency.

  • A structured approach to documentation, timelines, and tracking.

  • The ability to collaborate with external designers and franchise partners across markets.

OUR BENEFITS

We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

  • Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

  • Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

  • At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

  • Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

  • As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

You will act as a technical project leader in a multidisciplinary environment, working closely with engineering, systems, product development, and productization teams to ensure successful project execution from concept through product readiness.We are looking for a person with strong technical curiosity, the ability to understand complex systems, and a passion for bringing new products from development to market. jobs.title: Internal Sales Advisor Industry
jobs.description:
Als Internal Technical Sales Advisor Industry verleen je commerciële en technische ondersteuning aan elektrische installateurs en bouw je een nauwe relatie met hen op.

Je staat dagelijks via meerdere kanalen in contact met de klanten.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het volledige offerteproces: het identificeren van de klantbehoefte, een passende oplossing uitwerken op basis van een uitgebreid productengamma en de opmaak van de bijhorende prijsofferte. Offertes worden commercieel bij de klant verdedigd en nauwgezet opgevolgd, zodoende de offerte om te boeken naar een bestelling. Bij goedkeuring geef je de bestelling in.

Je bent in staat om bijkomend technisch advies te verlenen of dit in te winnen bij jouw collega’s specialisten.

Je volgt het logistiek traject op, waaronder het bijhouden van de levertermijnen en het informeren van de klanten over de voorraadstatus, geplande levering en lopende opdrachten.

Je bezit voldoende commerciële drive en doet proactief aan cross-selling. Bovendien informeer je de klant over lopende commerciële acties, incentives, …

Je hebt een goede kennis van het productengamma in de sector Industry en bent bereid om voortdurend jouw kennis te verrijken door het volgen van producttrainingen bij onze partner-leveranciers of via onze interne platformen Rexel Skill Up en intranet.

Je werkt nauw samen met jouw team en de commerciële buitendienst, het logistiek team en de partner-leveranciers en rapporteert aan de Branch Manager.

Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands.

jobs.title: Aide-soignant de jour pour le Val d'Orbais
jobs.description:
Rejoindre Le Val d'Orbais, c’est rejoindre une institution qui place son énergie dans le maintien et l’évolution de l’autonomie de chacun et porte à cœur l’épanouissement individuel et collectif de ses bénéficiaires et de ses travailleurs.

Située à Perwez dans le Brabant Wallon, notre MRS comprend une maison de repos et de soins, d’une capacité d’accueil de 98 résidants (dont un Cantou de 15 places) et une résidence services de 20 appartements.

Vos missions

En tant qu’aide-soignant, vous exercez une fonction essentielle auprès de nos résidants. Votre mission principale est de leur donner des soins globaux afin de maintenir, d’améliorer ou de rétablir leur santé et leur bien-être et de favoriser leur autonomie.

  • Vous réalisez les soins de base et les actes infirmiers délégués
  • Vous stimulez et aidez les résidants lors des repas et leur amenez l’aide nécessaire lors des déplacements
  • Vous veillez au confort général des résidants
  • Vous assurez le premier relais de communication entre le résidant et l’équipe pluridisciplinaire
  • Vous créez une relation de confiance avec les résidants et leur famille, vous êtes à l’écoute et les soutenez dans les moments difficiles ou émotionnels
  • Vous créez un climat favorable au bien-être relationnel et environnemental
  • Vous effectuez également les tâches administratives liées au bon fonctionnement du service et au bon suivi du résidant
Votre profil
  • Vous êtes en possession d'un diplôme d'aide-soignant ou tout autre diplôme donnant accès à la profession d'aide-soignant
  • Vous disposez du Visa délivré par le SPF Santé publique
  • Vous aimez le contact avec les personnes âgées et vous êtes à l’écoute de leurs besoins
  • Vous êtes motivé et vous faites preuve de patience, d’empathie et de rigueur
  • Vous avez le sens des responsabilités et vous savez être discret
  • Vous avez de bonnes capacités d’organisation et d’observation
  • Vous adhérez au projet de vie institutionnel et aux valeurs de MMI
Nous vous offrons
  • Un CDD de 3 mois (renouvelable et pouvant déboucher sur un CDI)
  • Un horaire à temps partiel (19h ou 28,5h)
  • Un cadre de travail épanouissant au sein d'une équipe nouvelle et dynamique
  • Un environnement de travail agréable sur un site flambant neuf qui a ouvert ses portes en janvier 2021
  • Une prime et un cadeau de fin d’année
  • Une direction humaine à votre écoute au moindre souci
  • Une formation continue assurée et encouragée par la direction

L’entraide, le respect, le bien-être, l’innovation et l’excellence, voilà ce qui anime les équipes de MMI chaque jour. Autour de ses 6 pôles géographiques, MMI forme un véritable réseau de lieux de vie dans le Hainaut, le Brabant Wallon et à Bruxelles, offrant à la fois aux personnes âgées et aux tout-petits des environnements adaptés à leurs besoins spécifiques.

Rejoindre MMI, c’est rejoindre une institution qui place son énergie dans le maintien et l’évolution de l’autonomie de chacun et porte à cœur l’épanouissement individuel et collectif de ses bénéficiaires et de ses travailleurs.

Site flambant neuf situé en pleine campagne à Odenge, Le Val d’Orbais offre un superbe environnement de travail et un lieu de vie chaleureux pour nos ainés dans l’entité de Perwez.

Notre maison qui accueille, héberge et accompagne 98 résidants (dont un Cantou de 15 places et une résidence services de 20 appartements) est le fruit d’une collaboration type « Chapitre XII » entre le CPAS, la commune de Perwez et MMI asbl.

jobs.title: Asiakkuuspäällikkö
jobs.description: **Asiakkuuspäällikkö Pääkaupunkiseudulle ja Turkuun****Haluatko myydä ratkaisuja, joilla asiakkaiden työt saadaan tehtyä turvallisesti, tehokkaasti ja ajallaan?**Me Nostolava-auto Jalo & Jalo Oy:ssä etsimme nyt kahta asiakkuuspäällikköä vahvistamaan kasvavaa tiimiämme pääkaupunkiseudulla ja Turun alueella.Tässä tehtävässä et myy pelkästään palvelua tai kalustoa, vaan autat asiakkaitamme löytämään parhaat ratkaisut vaativiin työkohteisiin. Onnistuminen edellyttää asiakkaan liiketoiminnan ja tarpeiden ymmärtämistä, kykyä rakentaa toimivia kokonaisratkaisuja, sekä halua ja kykyä kehittää pitkäjänteisiä asiakassuhteita. Tavoitteena on löytää jokaiseen kohteeseen ratkaisu, joka tuottaa asiakkaalle todellista arvoa.**Keitä olemme?**Jalo & Jalo on yksi Suomen ja Pohjoismaiden johtavista nostopalveluiden ja henkilönostoratkaisujen tarjoajista. Olemme rakentaneet toimintamme vahvan ammattitaidon, luotettavan palvelun ja modernin kaluston varaan.Asiakkaamme luottavat meihin, kun nostotyöt on toteutettava turvallisesti, tehokkaasti ja suunnitelmien mukaisesti. Palvelemme asiakkaitamme valtakunnallisesti Suomessa ja muualla Pohjoismaissa.Kehitämme toimintaamme jatkuvasti yhdessä asiakkaidemme ja henkilöstömme kanssa. Menestyksemme rakentuu osaavista ihmisistä, modernista teknologiasta ja halusta löytää entistä parempia ratkaisuja asiakkaidemme tarpeisiin.**Mitä työ sisältää?**- Uusien asiakkuuksien hankintaa ja nykyisten asiakassuhteiden tavoitteellista kehittämistä - Asiakastapaamisia ja aktiivista kenttämyyntiä - Asiakkaiden tarpeiden kartoittamista ja ratkaisujen suunnittelua - Tarjousten laatimista ja sopimusneuvotteluja - Yhteistyötä ajojärjestelyn, kuljettajien ja muun asiantuntijaorganisaation kanssa toimivien ratkaisujen varmistamiseksi - Oman myyntialueen ja asiakaskannan pitkäjänteistä kehittämistä sekä uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistamista Tehtävässä pääset suunnittelemaan ja johtamaan omaa työtäsi sekä vaikuttamaan suoraan myyntialueesi kasvuun. Odotamme sinulta oma-aloitteisuutta, tavoitteellisuutta ja kykyä priorisoida tekemistäsi. Viet sovitut asiat määrätietoisesti eteenpäin myös kiireisissä tilanteissa ja tartut aktiivisesti uusiin mahdollisuuksiin.**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**Sinulla on kokemusta esimerkiksi palvelumyynnistä, teknisestä myynnistä tai rakennus- ja teollisuusalan asiakastyöstä. Tärkeintä ei kuitenkaan ole se, että osaat jo kaiken valmiiksi, vaan halu oppia, rohkeus tarttua uusiin mahdollisuuksiin ja kyky löytää asiakkaalle toimivia ratkaisuja. Me autamme sinua kasvamaan tehtävässä.Arvostamme erityisesti:- Aikaisempaa kokemusta nostinalalta tai valmiutta oppia alan erityispiirteet - Tavoitteellista ja oma-aloitteista työskentelyotetta ja halua saavuttaa tuloksia - Kykyä luoda luottamuksellisia ja pitkäjänteisiä asiakassuhteita - Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja neuvottelutaitoja - Itsensä johtamisen taitoja, kykyä priorisoida ja viedä asioita määrätietoisesti eteenpäin - Hyvää paineensietokykyä ja kykyä toimia muuttuvissa tilanteissa - B-ajokorttia **Mitä tarjoamme?**- Nuorekkaan, kunnianhimoisen ja matalahierarkisen työyhteisön, jossa tekeminen ja yhteistyö ratkaisevat - Alan edelläkävijän tuotteet, palvelut ja modernin kaluston, joiden avulla voit tarjota asiakkaille aidosti toimivia ratkaisuja - Modernit työvälineet ja digitaaliset järjestelmät työsi tueksi - Laadukkaan perehdytyksen ja kokeneen tiimin tuen onnistumisesi varmistamiseksi - Vapauden ja vastuun kehittää omaa työtäsi sekä mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa suoraan tuloksiisi - Vakavaraisen ja kasvavan suomalaisen yrityksen tuen sekä mahdollisuuden kasvaa ja kehittyä ammattilaisena **Kenelle tehtävä sopii?**Viihdyt asiakkaiden parissa ja innostut työstä, jossa yhdistyvät ihmisten kohtaaminen, liiketoiminnan kehittäminen ja tekniset ratkaisut. Haluat ymmärtää asiakkaan tarpeita, löytää niihin toimivia ratkaisuja ja rakentaa pitkäjänteisiä asiakassuhteita.Otat vastuun omasta tekemisestäsi, viet asioita määrätietoisesti eteenpäin ja uskot yhteistyön voimaan. Sinulle myynti ei ole vain tuotteiden tai palveluiden myymistä, vaan asiakkaan auttamista onnistumaan.**Kiinnostuitko?**Lähetä hakemuksesi, ansioluettelosi (CV) ja palkkatoiveesi meille.Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja etenemme prosessissa heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Toimi siis nopeasti ja jätä hakemuksesi jo tänään!Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa: Oskari Rytilahti 0504766641 oskari.rytilahti@jalojalo.fi

  • Performing cell culture processes, including media preparation, cell expansion, and harvesting

  • Identifying, documenting, and reporting deviations while supporting quality investigations

  • Strong attention to detail with a quality-focused mindset
  • Good communication skills in English
  • A collaborative and proactive approach to teamwork
  • Willingness to work in a 5-shift rotation

Please note: This position is intended for manufacturing professionals. Candidates with a PhD are not eligible for this vacancy and will not be considered.

Employment Conditions

  • The organization offers excellent long-term career prospects and opportunities for professional growth.

jobs.title: Dossierbeheerder
jobs.description:
Hou jij van structuur, klantencontact én afwisseling?Dan ben jij misschien de administratieve kracht die wij zoeken!

Bij Carrosserie & Garage De Backer ben jij als dossierbeheerder de schakel tussen klanten, verzekeraars, experten en onze werkplaats. Je zorgt ervoor dat elk schadedossier vlot en correct wordt opgevolgd, van de eerste melding tot de aflevering van het herstelde voertuig. Ervaring is zeer belangrijk, maar een stevige werklust is een must. Elke dag is een nieuwe uitdaging, om kwaliteit en service tegen deadlines te kunnen leveren.

Al jarenlang staan wij, Carrosserie De Backer, bekend om onze kwaliteitsvolle herstellingen en klantgerichte service. Met een gedreven team zetten we elke dag alles op alles om onze klanten snel en professioneel weer op weg te helpen.

Jouw takenpakket:

  • Professioneel onthaal en begeleiding van klanten
  • Beheer en opvolging van schadedossiers van A tot Z
  • Contact onderhouden met verzekeringsmaatschappijen, makelaars en experten
  • Opvolgen van herstellingen, onderdelenbestellingen en retours in samenwerking met de werkplaats
  • Opmaken en verwerken en opvolgen van facturen
  • Afleveren van afgewerkte voertuigen aan klanten
  • Debiteurenbeheer
  • Je hebt minstens 2 jaar ervaring in klantenonthaal en administratie in schadebeheer in de autosector.
  • Ervaring met Planmanager, Informex of Claims 360 en UBench zien we als een groot pluspunt
  • Je bent administratief sterk en werkt nauwkeurig.
  • Je communiceert vlot en klantgericht.
  • Je houdt van verantwoordelijkheid en neemt initiatief.
  • Je kan verschillende dossiers tegelijk opvolgen zonder het overzicht te verliezen.
  • Je hebt een proactieve werkhouding en neemt graag initiatief.
  • Leergierigheid, motivatie en een positieve werkhouding vinden wij zeer belangrijk.
  • Kennis van verzekeringswezen.

Wij zoeken geen perfecte mensen. Wij zoeken gemotiveerde mensen.

jobs.title: Bliv en del af hjemmeplejen som social- og sundhedsassistent eller -hjælper
jobs.description:
Vil du være en del af et fagligt og socialt fællesskab, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe tryghed, kvalitet og gode hverdage for borgerne?Én ansøgning. Flere muligheder. Dit valg. Og det starter med enkle spørgsmål i et ansøgningsskema.En samlet hjemmepleje med fire områderI Fredensborg Kommune er hjemmeplejen samlet på tværs af fire geografiske områder og en fælles aften- og natsygepleje, som ledes af hjemmeplejechef Anne Rønne. Du søger én samlet stilling og kan angive, hvor du helst vil arbejde:
  • Nivå – et område med ca. 58 kollegaer, som ledes af områdelederne Anne Grann og Tanya Pedersen
  • Kokkedal – et område med ca. 39 kollegaer, som ledes af områdeleder Jumana Mahmud
  • Humlebæk – et område med ca. 58 kollegaer, som ledes af områdelederne Agnethe Søgaard og Birgitta Warnke
  • Fredensborg – et område med ca. 66 kollegaer, som ledes af områdelederne Jane Tangholm og Carina Forsberg-Madsen
Har du ikke en klar præference? Så angiver du det blot i ansøgningsskemaet – vi finder sammen det rette match.Vi søger dig, der
  • Er uddannet social og sundhedshjælper eller social- og sundhedsassistent
  • Arbejder selvstændigt og har overblik
  • Har gode samarbejdsevner
  • Har lyst til at bidrage til udvikling og kvalitet
Dine muligheder
  • Dagvagt eller aftenvagt
  • 28–37 timer om ugen
  • Weekendvagt hver 2. eller 3. uge
Din rolle som social- og sundhedsassistentDu har en central faglig rolle i borgerens forløb og arbejder selvstændigt i tæt samarbejde med dit team.Dine opgaver er at:
  • Varetage pleje, behandling og sygeplejefaglige opgaver
  • Observere og handle på ændringer i borgerens tilstand
  • Sikre sammenhæng og kvalitet i borgerforløb
  • Bidrage til triagering, dokumentation og faglig sparring
Hos os udvikler du dig løbende:
  • Du styrker dine faglige og kliniske kompetencer i praksis
  • Du får mulighed for nye opgaver og øget ansvar
  • Du indgår i et miljø med sparring og læring i hverdagen
Vi tilbyder
  • En god introduktion og tryg opstart
  • Faglig og personlig udvikling
  • Dialog om fleksibilitet - så hverdagen kan hænge sammen for dig, teamet og borgerne
  • Et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på kvalitet og samarbejde
  • Medarbejderfordele med fx rabat på træning, motionsforening og sociale arrangementer. Læs mere her.
Et fællesskab du kan mærkeDu bliver en del af en arbejdsplads med stærkt kollegialt samarbejde, videndeling og fokus på trivsel og et godt arbejdsmiljø.“Selv på travle dage er der overskud til grin og smil.”En hverdag med faglighed og udviklingHos os er udvikling en naturlig del af arbejdet:
  • Daglig triagering, koordinering og faglig sparring
  • Tæt tværfagligt samarbejde med bl.a. sygeplejersker og terapeuter
  • Fokus på rehabilitering og borgerens egne ressourcer
  • Mulighed for at bidrage til nye løsninger og arbejdsgange
Vi klæder dig godt på til opgaven med en grundig introduktion og løbende sparring, så du får de bedste forudsætninger for at lykkes i rollen.Du søger stillingen via vores ansøgningsskemaI skemaet angiver du:
  • Hvilket område du foretrækker – eller om du er åben
  • Om du ønsker dag- eller aftenvagt
  • Eventuelle ønsker til timetal
Er du fleksibel, hjælper vi med at finde det rette match, så du lander et sted, hvor faglighed og trivsel passer godt sammen.Hvis du også er interesseret i at arbejde på et plejehjem, kan du oplyse det i skemaet.Vi tager samtaler løbende og glæder os til at møde dig.Hvis du vil vide mere, kan du kontakte os på telefon 30 34 25 19 mellem kl. 08.30 og kl. 15.00.AnsættelsesvilkårVi kan tilbyde uddannede social- og sundhedsassistenter ansættelse hurtigst muligt, når vi har fundet det rette match. Du bliver ansat efter gældende overenskomst, og din løn bliver forhandlet på baggrund af erfaring og kvalifikationer.Søg via linket senest den torsdag 10. december 2026. Vi holder samtaler løbende, men modtager ansøgninger helt frem til fristen.I forbindelses med ansættelsen indhenter vi referencer og straffeattest.I Fredensborg Kommune ser vi mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge stillingen uanset personlig baggrund.

jobs.title: Assistant.e Dentaire – CDD 3 mois (0,7 équivalent temps-plein) - 2026-133
jobs.description:
Le service de Dentisterie et Stomatologie du CHU Saint-Pierre prend en charge les patients adultes et pédiatriques pour le diagnostic, la prévention et le traitement des pathologies bucco-dentaires et oro-faciales. Il réunit une équipe multidisciplinaire composée de dentistes, stomatologues, assistants dentaires, infirmiers et personnels administratifs qui collaborent afin de garantir une prise en charge de qualité, centrée sur le patient. Le service propose des consultations spécialisées ainsi que des interventions ambulatoires, en étroite collaboration avec les autres spécialités médicales et chirurgicales de l'hôpital.

Au sein du service de Dentisterie et Stomatologie du CHU Saint-Pierre, vous rejoignez une équipe dynamique et spécialisée prenant en charge une grande diversité de patients et de situations cliniques. Notre mission est d'offrir des soins de qualité, accessibles à tous, dans un environnement hospitalier universitaire favorisant la collaboration interdisciplinaire, l'innovation et le développement des compétences.

Vos responsabilités au quotidien sont :

  • Assister les praticiens lors des soins
  • Prendre en charge les patients : communication professionnelle, empathie, installation au fauteuil, accompagner aux toilettes. Mise au planning d’intervention
  • Accomplir les procédures de prise en charge, de nettoyage, de désinfection, de conditionnement, de stérilisation, de rangement et la distribution de l’instrumentation du service
  • Assurer l’entretien hygiénique des équipements de stomatologie, de radiologie et le conditionnement des cabinets de dentisterie

Profil recherché :

  • Disposer d’un diplôme d’études secondaires supérieures
  • Disposer de la formation d’assistante dentaire
  • Disposer d’une expérience en milieu hospitalier est un réel atout
  • Satisfaire aux conditions légales de bilinguisme : vous avez de bonnes connaissances de la seconde langue nationale ou vous êtes disposé à les acquérir (cours de langues organisés en interne sur le temps de travail, possibilité d’obtenir une prime de bilinguisme SELOR de 150€ bruts sous réserve de la remise du Selor Art. 10)
  • Satisfaire à l’examen de sélection ou de promotion
  • Satisfaire aux conditions du profil.

Qualités requises :

  • Être capable de comprendre et maîtriser les indications et procédures d’entretien du matériel du service de stomatologie
  • Être rigoureux, précis et ordonné
  • Être capable de s’adapter à la variété des tâches, à de nouvelles procédures et technologies
  • Avoir un esprit d’équipe et de collaboration interdisciplinaire
  • Avoir le sens des responsabilités
  • Assurer une communication professionnelle avec le patient.

Le CHU Saint-Pierre est un hôpital public et universitaire de référence, offrant des soins de grande qualité accessibles à tous.

Dans ce cadre, il relève quotidiennement les défis de la santé publique tout en déclinant son caractère universitaire via une implication active dans l’enseignement et la recherche.

Les chiffres clés qui caractérisent l’hôpital sont les suivants :

  • 450.000 consultations/an
  • 45.000 admissions/an
  • 23.000 opérations chirurgicales/an
  • 85.000 passages aux urgences/an
  • 2900 accouchements/an
  • 3200 collaborateurs dont 400 médecins

Le respect, l’innovation, l’engagement, la qualité et la solidarité sont les valeurs clés de l’hôpital. Toutes et tous s’attèlent à placer le patient au centre de leur action. Les réponses aux réalités sociales, la tolérance, le libre-examen et la capacité à se mobiliser au quotidien pour les patients, bruxellois et non-bruxellois, sont les moteurs de ses actions.

La quête de l’excellence en médecine de pointe et l’approche multidisciplinaire, font de l’hôpital une référence sur le plan national.

Le CHU St Pierre travaille également en étroite collaboration avec de nombreux partenaires comme les médecins généralistes, médecins spécialistes référents, les CPAS et les autres institutions d’aides et de soins en Région bruxelloise.

Travailler au CHU Saint-Pierre, c’est à la fois faire partie d’un hôpital ancré dans la Ville depuis plusieurs siècles et d’un réseau hospitalier moderne en développement rapide, CHORUS, plus grand réseau hospitalier en Belgique. Travailler au CHU Saint-Pierre, c’est faire partie d’un groupe soudé, soutenant, au sein duquel chaque personne a sa place, afin d’offrir un service optimal. La satisfaction de nos patients et notre bien-être au travail sont nos priorités.

Offre:

Nous vous offrons un salaire en rapport avec votre niveau de formation et d’expérience.

Barème de rémunération

jobs.description:
Vi søger en frisk, præsentabel og udadvendt person, der har lyst til at blive en del af vores salgsteam i Løgumkloster

Din baggrund er ikke det vigtigste – din personlighed og indstilling er!

Hvem er du?

  • Du interesserer dig oprigtigt for biler.

Vi forestiller os en person i alderen 25–50 år, men det vigtigste er, at du er den rette person.

Hvad skal du lave?

Du bliver en vigtig del af hele processen fra bilen kommer ind, til den står flot og salgsklar i vores udstilling.

Klargøring og præsentation af biler

Praktiske og tekniske opgaver omkring bilerne

Kundekontakt og på sigt bilsalg

Et spændende og alsidigt job i et moderne bilhus med masser af muligheder, gode kollegaer og en hverdag, hvor ikke to dage er ens.

Vi søger ikke nødvendigvis en erfaren bilsælger – vi søger den rette person, som vi kan gøre til en dygtig bilsælger!

ER DET DIG, VI MANGLER?

Så tøv ikke med at kontakte os!

jobs.title: Dygtig erfaren sous chef
jobs.description:
Sous chef på Bryggens Spisehus

 

 

Erfaringsrig og passioneret souschef søges til Bryggens Spise

Brænder du for gastronomi, højt tempo og god ledelse i køkkenet? Bryggens Spisehus søger en engageret og kvalificeret souschef, der kan være køkkenchefens højre hånd og gå forrest i den daglige drift af vores travle køkken.

 

Om jobbet og dine ansvarsområder:Som vores nye souschef får du en nøglerolle i køkkenet. Du vil indgå aktivt i den daglige madlavning, men også have fokus på struktur og ledelse. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet indebære:

  • Daglig drift og service: Sikre at maden altid leveres i højeste kvalitet – uanset om det gælder hurtig burgerservice, selskabsmad eller den klassiske a la carte.

  • Køkkenledelse: Gå forrest som det gode eksempel, motivere teamet og uddelegere opgaver under service.

  • Kvalitets- og egenkontrol: Medansvar for at køkkenets hygiejnestandarder, egenkontrol og råvarehåndtering altid sidder lige i skabet.

  • Varebestilling: Assistere med lagerstyring og tæt dialog med vores leverandører.

 

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har dokumenteret erfaring fra et lignende koncept med både a la carte, selskaber og burgerservice i højt tempo.

  • Er faglært kok eller har solid, praktisk erfaring på et tilsvarende niveau.

  • Har et skarpt overblik og formår at bevare det gode humør – selv i de mest hektiske timer.

  • Er en holdspiller, der kommunikerer tydeligt, konstruktivt og professionelt med både køkken og tjenere.

 

Vi tilbyder:

  • En attraktiv fuldtidsstilling med opstart hurtigst muligt.

  • En spændende, dynamisk og levende arbejdsplads med fart på og plads til faglige ambitioner.

  • Et stærkt og socialt fællesskab med engagerede og dygtige kolleger.

  • Gode personalegoder og ordnede arbejdsforhold, der matcher dine kvalifikationer.

 

Ansøgning og kontakt:Lyder det som det rette match for dig? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Send dit CV (med billede) samt en kort ansøgning til: Marianne@bryggens.dk.Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

jobs.title: Raskaskoneasentaja, Kankaanpää
jobs.description: Raskaan kaluston asentaja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Etsitkö vakaata työpaikkaa, jossa on reilu meininki, mahdollisuus kehittyä ja osaamista arvostava palkkaus?Asiakkaamme on pitkään toiminut ja hyvämaineinen huoltokorjaamo, joka etsii nyt tiimiinsä kokoaikaista ja vakituista raskaan kaluston asentajaa. Tässä roolissa pääset työskentelemään monipuolisesti kuorma-autojen, perävaunujen ja erilaisten työkoneiden parissa. Työskentelet pääasiassa arkipäivisin klo 7.00–17.30 välillä. Toivomme kuitenkin joustavuutta, sillä työpäivien pituudet saattavat vaihdella työtilanteen mukaan. Tulevaisuudessa yrityksessä on mahdollista siirtyä 2-vuorotyöhön, ja toisinaan töitä tehdään myös viikonloppuisin. Saat vahvan tuen ja perusteellisen perehdytyksen – meillä kaveria ei jätetä yksin. Palkkaus määräytyy AKT:n huoltokorjaamoalan työehtosopimuksen ja kokemuksesi mukaan. Erikoisosaamisesta olemme valmiita maksamaan erillistä ekstraa.Mikäli muutat työn perässä toiselta paikkakunnalta, voimme auttaa sinua asunnon hankinnassa. Odotamme sinulta alan koulutusta ja jonkin verran aikaisempaa työkokemusta raskaan kaluston parista, oikeaa asennetta ja vastuuntuntoa sekä tiimihenkeä. Suomen kielen C1 (Taitavan kielitaidon perustaso) vaaditaan työturvallisuuden vuoksi, sekä sujuvaan kommunikointiin muiden työntekijöiden ja asiakkaiden kanssa. Mikäli tämä työ kiinnostaa sinua, laita hakemuksesi tulemaan samantien sillä käymme niitä läpi jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Toivomme sinulta:- Hyvää asennetta ja halua sitoutua mukavaan työpaikkaan ja työympäristöön- Joustavuutta työaikojen suhteen- Voimassa olevaa Työturvallisuuskorttia- Hyvää fyysistä kuntoa- Ajokorttia c-kortti iso plussa hakijalle- Oma-aloitteisuutta ja ahkeruutta- Mielellään kokemusta raskaan kaluston asennuksista  Tarjoamme sinulle: - Luotettavan ja hyvän työnantajan- Kattavan perehdytyksen työhön- Laadukkaat työvarusteet- Mahdollisuuden työllistyä pitkäaikaiseen työhön- Työterveyshuollon Palkkausperuste: Tuntipalkka 16,47-19,85 €/hBenevanilla arvostamme: - Luotettavuutta - tehdään mitä sovitaan- Asennetta -teet aina parhaasi ja olet oma-aloitteinen- Työturvallisuutta - arvostamme työntekijöitä, joille työturvallisuus on tärkeää- Uskallus tarttua uusiin haasteisiin

jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren koeltechnieker die graag werkt aan uitdagende HVAC-installaties? Wil je aan de slag binnen een groeiende organisatie waar techniek, kwaliteit en vakmanschap centraal staan? Dan ben jij misschien de collega die wij zoeken.

Voor onze divisie TMS Facility Technics zijn wij op zoek naar een Koeltechnieker.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in AI Native Networking for Healthcare
jobs.description:
We seek a PhD Research Fellow for a 3-year position in the SYNAPSE project. The successful candidate will have a solid background in computer networking and an interest in developing machine-learning methods for network control and network-aware distributed learning.

Section for Medical Information and Communication Technology (Medical ICT Research), The Intervention Centre (see: http://www.ivs.no), at Oslo University Hospital offers a full-time PhD Fellowship. The recruited PhD Fellow will be part of the Wireless Sensor Network Research Group of Professor Ilangko Balasingham and will be enrolled in the PhD program at the University of Oslo

We seek candidates with a solid background in computer networking who want to develop machine-learning methods for network control and network-aware distributed learning.

Oslo University Hospital is a workplace with great diversity. We believe this is crucial for solving our tasks in the best possible way. We want this diversity to be reflected among the applicants for our positions, and we encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of background, to apply!

Arbeidsoppgaver

About SYNAPSE

SYNAPSE, funded by the Research Council of Norway, develops networks that adapt their decisions to network conditions and the clinical urgency of the information they carry. Learning is integrated into network control to support decisions about scheduling, routing and resource allocation. For example, an urgent clinical alert should reach its destination promptly even when links are congested and patients are moving.

The project also develops distributed and federated learning methods that adapt to connectivity, available resources and clinical priorities. Network control and distributed learning are designed together, so that the network supports learning and learning remains effective when communication is constrained. The methods are evaluated in remote patient monitoring and hospital-at-home scenarios.

This position focuses on network protocols and their control at the MAC, network, transport and cross-layer levels, combined with machine learning. It does not cover hardware, antennas, circuits or physical-layer signal processing, and is not a general data-science position. Applicants must document relevant computer-networking knowledge and experience.

Research areas

  • Learning-based network control, including scheduling, link selection, routing and resource allocation in wireless and edge networks.
  • Reinforcement learning and multi-agent reinforcement learning for distributed network decision-making.
  • Graph and hypergraph representation learning of network state, including temporal graph neural networks.
  • Network- and urgency-aware distributed and federated learning, adapting the exchange of data and model updates to network conditions and clinical priorities.
  • Evaluation through network simulation and emulation, and with real remote patient monitoring data.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and evaluate learning-based methods for urgency-aware network control and network-aware distributed learning.
  • Implement and test the methods using network simulation or emulation and real monitoring data.
  • Publish in leading networking and machine-learning venues and complete a PhD at the University of Oslo, Faculty of Medicine.
Kvalifikasjoner (overskrift)

Required qualifications

  • A master’s degree (120 ECTS), including a thesis, in computer science, network or communication engineering, electrical engineering or equivalent.
  • A relevant bachelor’s degree (180 ECTS), with a total of five years of higher education.
  • A solid foundation in computer networking, demonstrated through relevant coursework and a substantial project, thesis or research experience involving network protocols, wireless or mobile networks, routing or network performance.
  • Coursework or project experience in machine learning, and good programming skills in Python.
  • A weighted average grade of B or better on the master’s degree, as required by the University of Oslo.
  • A master’s thesis graded B or better (Norwegian grading scale or equivalent).

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with reinforcement learning or graph neural networks.
  • Experience with network simulation or emulation tools, such as ns-3, OMNeT++ or Mininet.
  • Publications or a master’s thesis combining networking and machine learning.

Language Requirements Applicants who are not proficient in a Scandinavian language must document English proficiency through one of the following: TOEFL: at least 600 (paper-based) or 92 (internet-based); IELTS Academic: at least 6.5, with no section below 5.5; Cambridge CAE/CPE: grade A or B.

Personal Qualities

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • A structured, precise and adaptable working style.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • A positive attitude and ability to manage a dynamic work environment.
  • A high level of professionalism and work ethic.

We offer

  • A fully funded, full-time three-year PhD position. Salary according to the Norwegian state salary scale (approximately NOK 550,800–587,000 per year).
  • Supervision by Dr Roufaida Laidi (PI), Prof. Ilangko Balasingham and Dr Hemin Ali Qadir, in collaboration with Prof. Tarik Taleb (Ruhr University Bochum).
  • A clinical research environment at The Intervention Centre, Oslo University Hospital.
  • Access to high-performance computing infrastructure at OUS and national e-infrastructure services.
  • An inclusive, interdisciplinary research environment at the Intervention Centre, OUS.
  • Pension, insurance and welfare schemes through the Norwegian public sector.
  • Family-friendly surroundings with cultural and outdoor opportunities in Oslo.

Your application

  • Submit a cover letter of at most one page explaining your interest in SYNAPSE and your fit with the position.

Identify:

  • Your computer-networking background, naming relevant coursework, a thesis, substantial projects or publications and explaining your own contribution.
  • Your experience implementing machine-learning methods and using network simulation, emulation or testbeds.
  • The research area or areas above that best match your background and interests.

Supporting documents

  • A CV.
  • Transcripts for your bachelor’s and master’s degrees, with the grading scale or diploma supplement.
  • Copies of your diplomas.
  • Documented English proficiency.
  • Names and contact details of two referees, at least one academic. Referees must not be family members.
  • Documents not in English or a Scandinavian language must be accompanied by a certified translation. Applications without transcripts and diplomas will not be assessed.

Submit your application electronically through Webcruiter

KontaktinformasjonDr. Roufaida Laidi, Project leader, PI, roufaida.laidi@ous-hf.no Prof. Ilangko Balasingham, Section leader, ilangko.balasingham@ous-research.no ArbeidsstedSognsvannsveien 20 0372 Oslo Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Oslo universitetssykehus HF Referansenr.: 5199969633 Stillingsprosent: 100% Engasjement Startdato: 01.01.2027 Sluttdato: 31.12.2029 Søknadsfrist: 15.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oslo University Hospital is a highly specialised hospital in charge of extensive regional and local hospital assignments and the provision of high quality services for the citizens of Oslo. The hospital also has a nationwide responsibility for a number of national and multi-regional assignments and has several national centres of competence. The hospital is Scandinavia's largest and we each year carry out more than 1.2 million patient treatments. Oslo University Hospital is responsible for approximately 50 percent of all medical and healthcare research conducted at Norwegian hospitals and is a significant role player within the education of a large variety of health care personnel. We are an emergency hospital for East and Southern Norway and have national emergency assignments. The hospital has a total budget of NOK 17 billion. More than 20,000 employees are engaged with activities at more than 40 different locations.

 

The University of Oslo is Norway's oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 28 000 students and 7000 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. The Faculty of Medicine was established in 1814 and is the oldest medical faculty in Norway. The Faculty is organized into three basic units and has approximately 1,500 employees and about 2000 students. The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. With about 800 employees spread over approximately 425 man-labour years, Klinmed is the university's largest institute.
