jobs.title: Doctoral Fellowship in the field of Art History (Kunsthistoriker/in)
jobs.description: In the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, researchers from the Social Sciences and Humanities as well as artists explore the relationships between technology, science, and society. The Lab was initiated by The Schaufler Foundation together with TUD Dresden University of Technology. The Lab's guiding theme for the upcoming third funding phase (April 2027–September 2030) is "Energy Cultures in Transition". The guiding theme is investigated from a humanities, cultural, social, and educational science perspective, explored through artistic practice, and communicated to the public. For the third funding phase, the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden comprises eight doctoral fellowships and an annually changing Artist in Residence program.TUD embodies a university culture that is characterized by cosmopolitanism, mutual appreciation, thriving innovation and active participation. For TUD, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.The Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden offers, subject to the availability of resources, aDoctoral Fellowshipfor a period of 2 years, with the option of extension by 1.5 years, starting on April 1, 2027. The fellowship (EUR 1,850 per month, plus a grant for material costs of EUR 150 and, where applicable, a family supplement of EUR 315 per child) is aimed at early-career researchers in the field of Art History. Primary supervision will be provided by Prof. Dr. Kerstin Schankweiler, Chair of Visual Studies and Art History.The guiding theme Energy Cultures in Transition understands energy as a cultural phenomenon deeply inscribed in aesthetic, historical, political, ecological, economic, and socio-technological practices and systems. Building on the dynamically growing research fields of the Energy Humanities, Science & Technology Studies, and the Digital Humanities, the aim is to examine how modern energy regimes—from petromodernity, to nuclear culture, and post-carbon futures—have shaped not only material infrastructures but also subjectivities, power relations, progress narratives, geopolitical orders, ecologies, and knowledge systems, while simultaneously being shaped by them. Interdisciplinary perspectives from the social sciences, cultural studies, humanities, and educational research represented at the Schaufler Kolleg@TU Dresden enable the analysis of the multifaceted entanglements of energy, culture, and society. The focus is on questions concerning the representation, communication, and aesthetics of energy transitions and resource paradigms as well as continuities between resource economies and information economies, the relationships between energy, labor, environment, and consumer culture, and the role of colonialism, gender, nationalism, geopolitics, education, and social justice in deciding energy futures and navigating collective transformation processes. In the field of Art History, the focus is on the twentieth and twenty-first centuries. The following research areas and questions are of particular relevance to the guiding theme:- Artistic engagements with ecological crises and their intersections with social, gender-related, and political conflicts, with a particular interest in art in the context of the GDR and the post-1989 transformation period- Extractivism, material resources, and artistic practice in the context of (neo-)colonial power relations and global resource economies, with a particular interest in art from Africa and the African diaspora- AI and digital image cultures, with a focus on the material and energy infrastructures of digital image production and artistic practice- Visual politics of protest and activism in energy, climate, and resource conflicts, as well as their circulation across analog and digital publicsTasks:Your tasks include independent research and academic further qualification with the goal of completing a doctorate at TUD, as well as writing a dissertation on a topic within the guiding concept "Energy Cultures in Transition" in the discipline of Art History. The fellowship requires a high degree of willingness to engage in interdisciplinary dialogue, particularly with the STEM partnerships of the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, as well as to conduct joint research with artists within the framework of the Schaufler Residency. In addition, engagement in the areas of science communication and outreach is expected. Shared office spaces will be made available to the fellows. Participation in the Kolleg's English-language training program is mandatory.Requirements:You hold an excellent university degree in Art History or Visual Culture Studies. You have a strong ability to work in teams and enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration. As the training program is conducted in English, you have English skills at a minimum of C1 level. In accordance with the doctoral regulations of the Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Social Science, the dissertation may be written in either German or English—if you choose to write it in German, corresponding German language skills are required. Beyond this, German language skills are desirable but not mandatory.We offer:The opportunity to pursue a doctorate within the Schaufler Kolleg with a structured qualification program and integration into an interdisciplinary research project. You will receive a fully equipped office workspace on the premises of TUD and access to an excellent research infrastructure, including participation in Research Studios and writing retreats. The Graduate Academy and other central institutions of TUD offer numerous further training and qualification opportunities. In addition, within the limits of the available project funds, the Schaufler Lab will cover the costs of conference travel. Inclusion and equal opportunities are important to us. We therefore look forward to receiving applications from people regardless of gender, origin, sexual orientation, worldview, or disability. TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The University is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment. The fellowship does not constitute an employment relationship.Application:Your detailed application, in German or English, should contain, in addition to the completed online application form (https://tu-dresden.de/gsw/schauflerlab/schaufler-kolleg/phase-3/anmeldung-registration) , a letter of motivation, a curriculum vitae in tabular form including an account of your academic career, a copy of your most recent university degree certificate, an exposé of your research project including a work and time schedule (max. 20,000 characters). Please send us your application documents, including the online application form, quoting the reference number s26-006, by November 20, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de (https://securemail.tu-dresden.de)  by sending it as a single pdf file to schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de) or to:TU Dresden, Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, Prof. Dr. Kerstin Schankweiler, Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.Reference to data protection: Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website: https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis)

jobs.title: Doctoral Fellowship  in the field of Civil and Digital Law (Jurist/in)
jobs.description: In the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, researchers from the Social Sciences and Humanities as well as artists explore the relationships between technology, science, and society. The Lab was initiated by The Schaufler Foundation together with TUD Dresden University of Technology. The Lab's guiding theme for the upcoming third funding phase (April 2027–September 2030) is "Energy Cultures in Transition". The guiding theme is investigated from a humanities, cultural, social, and educational science perspective, explored through artistic practice, and communicated to the public. For the third funding phase, the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden comprises eight doctoral fellowships and an annually changing Artist in Residence program.TUD embodies a university culture that is characterized by cosmopolitanism, mutual appreciation, thriving innovation and active participation. For TUD, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.The Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden offers, subject to the availability of resources, aDoctoral Fellowshipfor a period of 2 years, with the option of extension by 1.5 years, starting on April 1, 2027. The fellowship (EUR 1,850 per month, plus a grant for material costs of EUR 150 and, where applicable, a family supplement of EUR 315 per child) is aimed at early-career researchers in the field of Civil and Digital Law. Primary supervision will be provided by Jun.-Prof. Dr. Katharina Kaesling, LL.M., Juniorprofessorship in Civil Law, Intellectual Property Law, especially Patent Law and Legal Issues of AI.The guiding theme Energy Cultures in Transition understands energy as a cultural phenomenon deeply inscribed in aesthetic, historical, political, ecological, economic, and socio-technological practices and systems. Building on the dynamically growing research fields of the Energy Humanities, Science & Technology Studies, and the Digital Humanities, the aim is to examine how modern energy regimes—from petromodernity, to nuclear culture, and post-carbon futures—have shaped not only material infrastructures but also subjectivities, power relations, progress narratives, geopolitical orders, ecologies, and knowledge systems, while simultaneously being shaped by them. Interdisciplinary perspectives from the social sciences, cultural studies, humanities, and educational research represented at the Schaufler Kolleg@TU Dresden enable the analysis of the multifaceted entanglements of energy, culture, and society. The focus is on questions concerning the representation, communication, and aesthetics of energy transitions and resource paradigms as well as continuities between resource economies and information economies, the relationships between energy, labor, environment, and consumer culture, and the role of colonialism, gender, nationalism, geopolitics, education, and social justice in deciding energy futures and navigating collective transformation processes. In the field of Civil and Digital Law, the following research areas and questions are of particular relevance to the guiding theme:- Energy- and resource-intensive digital infrastructures as a subject of EU regulation- Systemic risks of digital platforms and AI systems in the context of energy use, resource consumption, and ecological sustainability, particularly under the Digital Services Act and the AI Act- Ecological sustainability as a European value and as an interpretative principle in digital law- Law and legal culture as elements of energy and technology cultures, particularly the interactions between legal categories, technological development, societal transformations, and concepts of sustainability- Territorial and extraterritorial limits of European digital regulation in addressing global ecological impactsTasks:Your tasks include independent research and academic further qualification with the goal of completing a doctorate at TUD, as well as writing a dissertation on a topic within the guiding concept "Energy Cultures in Transition" in the discipline of Civil and Digital Law. The fellowship requires a high degree of willingness to engage in interdisciplinary dialogue, particularly with the STEM partnerships of the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, as well as to conduct joint research with artists within the framework of the Schaufler Residency. In addition, engagement in the areas of science communication and outreach is expected. Shared office spaces will be made available to the fellows. Participation in the Kolleg's English-language training program is mandatory.Requirements:You hold an above-average university degree in law and have prior knowledge of, or at least a strong interest in, the regulation of digital services and AI, as well as in the role of energy (cultures) and/or ecological sustainability. You have a strong ability to work in teams and enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration. As the training program is conducted in English, you have English skills at a minimum of C1 level. In accordance with the applicable doctoral regulations, the dissertation may be written in either German or English—if you choose to write it in German, corresponding German language skills are required. Beyond this, German language skills are desirable but not mandatory.We offer:The opportunity to pursue a doctorate within the Schaufler Kolleg with a structured qualification program and integration into an interdisciplinary research project. You will receive a fully equipped office workspace on the premises of TUD and access to an excellent research infrastructure, including participation in Research Studios and writing retreats. The Graduate Academy and other central institutions of TUD offer numerous further training and qualification opportunities. In addition, within the limits of the available project funds, the Schaufler Lab will cover the costs of conference travel. Inclusion and equal opportunities are important to us. We therefore look forward to receiving applications from people regardless of gender, origin, sexual orientation, worldview, or disability. TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The University is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment. The fellowship does not constitute an employment relationship.Application:Your detailed application, in German or English, should contain, in addition to the completed online application form (https://tu-dresden.de/gsw/schauflerlab/schaufler-kolleg/phase-3/anmeldung-registration) , a letter of motivation, a curriculum vitae in tabular form including an account of your academic career, a copy of your most recent university degree certificate, an exposé of your research project including a work and time schedule (max. 20,000 characters). Please send us your application documents, including the online application form, quoting the reference number s26-004, by November 24, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de (https://securemail.tu-dresden.de/)  by sending it as a single pdf file to schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de) or to:TU Dresden, Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, Jun.-Prof. Dr. Katharina Kaesling, LL.M., Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.Reference to data protection: Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website: https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis) .

jobs.title: Doctoral Fellowship in the field of International Politics (Politologe/Politologin)
jobs.description: In the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, researchers from the Social Sciences and Humanities as well as artists explore the relationships between technology, science, and society. The Lab was initiated by The Schaufler Foundation together with TUD Dresden University of Technology. The Lab's guiding theme for the upcoming third funding phase (April 2027–September 2030) is "Energy Cultures in Transition". The guiding theme is investigated from a humanities, cultural, social, and educational science perspective, explored through artistic practice, and communicated to the public. For the third funding phase, the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden comprises eight doctoral fellowships and an annually changing Artist in Residence program.TUD embodies a university culture that is characterized by cosmopolitanism, mutual appreciation, thriving innovation and active participation. For TUD, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.The Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden offers, subject to the availability of resources, aDoctoral Fellowshipfor a period of 2 years, with the option of extension by 1.5 years, starting on April 1, 2027. The fellowship (EUR 1,850 per month, plus a grant for material costs of EUR 150 and, where applicable, a family supplement of EUR 315 per child) is aimed at early-career researchers in the field of International Politics. Primary supervision will be provided by Prof. Dr. Anna Holzscheiter, Chair of Political Science with a focus on International Politics.The guiding theme Energy Cultures in Transition understands energy as a cultural phenomenon deeply inscribed in aesthetic, historical, political, ecological, economic, and socio-technological practices and systems. Building on the dynamically growing research fields of the Energy Humanities, Science & Technology Studies, and the Digital Humanities, the aim is to examine how modern energy regimes—from petromodernity, to nuclear culture, and post-carbon futures—have shaped not only material infrastructures but also subjectivities, power relations, progress narratives, geopolitical orders, ecologies, and knowledge systems, while simultaneously being shaped by them. Interdisciplinary perspectives from the social sciences, cultural studies, humanities, and educational research represented at the Schaufler Kolleg@TU Dresden enable the analysis of the multifaceted entanglements of energy, culture, and society. The focus is on questions concerning the representation, communication, and aesthetics of energy transitions and resource paradigms as well as continuities between resource economies and information economies, the relationships between energy, labor, environment, and consumer culture, and the role of colonialism, gender, nationalism, geopolitics, education, and social justice in deciding energy futures and navigating collective transformation processes. In the field of International Politics, the following research areas and questions are of particular relevance to the guiding theme:- Research on the transnational transition of energy cultures by linking Political Science and International Relations with Social Movement Studies, Sociology, or Conflict Studies- Energy transformation as a political and social distributional conflict in the context of global governance and transnational networks- Challenges of cross-border labour relations in the context of the energy transition, and as objects of analysis for Global Social Policy, Transnational Advocacy Networks, and international norm research- Analysis of legitimation strategies for international objectives (e.g., CO2 reduction) at the national and local levels, particularly in the context of labour- Investigation of global and transnational issues in local contexts, for example through the application of qualitative, comparative, and ethnographic methodsTasks:Your tasks include independent research and academic further qualification with the goal of completing a doctorate at TUD, as well as writing a dissertation on a topic within the guiding concept "Energy Cultures in Transition" in the discipline of Political Science/International Relations/Political Sociology. The fellowship requires a high degree of willingness to engage in interdisciplinary dialogue, particularly with the STEM partnerships of the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, as well as to conduct joint research with artists within the framework of the Schaufler Residency. In addition, engagement in the areas of science communication and outreach is expected. Shared office spaces will be made available to the fellows. Participation in the Kolleg's English-language training program is mandatory.Requirements:You hold an excellent university degree (Master's or equivalent) in Political Science or a comparable social science discipline. Furthermore, you have relevant prior experience in the application of social science methods as well as in the fields of International Politics and Social Movement Studies. You have a strong ability to work in teams and enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration. As the training program is conducted in English, you have English skills at a minimum of C1 level. In accordance with the doctoral regulations of the Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Social Science, the dissertation may be written in either German or English—if you choose to write it in German, corresponding German language skills are required. Beyond this, German language skills are desirable but not mandatory.We offer:The opportunity to pursue a doctorate within the Schaufler Kolleg with a structured qualification program and integration into an interdisciplinary research project. You will receive a fully equipped office workspace on the premises of TUD and access to an excellent research infrastructure, including participation in Research Studios and writing retreats. The Graduate Academy and other central institutions of TUD offer numerous further training and qualification opportunities. jobs.title: Strategic Procurement Manager - Semiconductor Materials (f/m/d) (Category-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Strategische/r Einkäufer/in; Technische/r Einkäufer/inStellenbeschreibung:About usWe see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects.About our technologyThe semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude.In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution.The RoleBlack Semiconductor is looking for a Strategic Procurement Manager (f/m/d) or Category Manager (f/m/d) to strengthen our growing team in Aachen, Germany. In this role, you will lead strategic sourcing and supplier management activities for materials critical to semiconductor manufacturing. You will ensure continuity of supply, optimize total cost of ownership, and maintain quality compliance while adapting to evolving technology requirements and market conditions.To join our team, you should be excited to take ownership of:- Develop and execute global sourcing strategies for semiconductor materials, including wafers, photoresists, CMP slurries, specialty gases, chemicals, and other critical materials.- Identify, qualify, and manage strategic suppliers while ensuring alignment with technology roadmaps, quality standards, and production requirements.- Negotiate contracts, pricing, and commercial terms to achieve cost targets while securing reliable supply.- Monitor semiconductor material markets, supplier performance, pricing trends, and supply chain risks to identify opportunities and mitigation strategies.- Collaborate with R&D, process engineering, quality, and manufacturing teams to align material requirements with technology and production needs.- Support new product introductions by sourcing materials that meet emerging process requirements and scalability targets.- Manage procurement performance, supplier relationships, and reporting activities to support business objectives.Your Profile- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in supply chain management, engineering, physics, materials science, business, or a related field.- 5+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, or supply chain management, preferably within semiconductors, electronics, or advanced manufacturing.- Proven experience negotiating contracts, managing suppliers, and driving cost optimization initiatives.- Strong understanding of semiconductor materials and processes, including wafers, specialty gases, chemicals, photoresists, lithography, etching, and metallization materials.- Strong analytical skills with experience using ERP/procurement systems and data analysis tools.- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with fluent English; Your work focuses on strengthening donor engagement and increasing fundraising revenue. You will work across two connected pillars, namely content development and programme development, that together drive donor acquisition, retention and development for IRC Germany.MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES- Create engaging content for donor journeys and donor communications across- digital acquisition, email, direct mail, and telemarketing to increase donations- and donor engagement.- Support colleagues in the private market with audience-specific content, such- as face-to-face pitches and website copy.- Work with colleagues in other national markets and the global support team to- keep content aligned and share ideas.- Test and improve content and formats on an ongoing basis to raise income- and impact with different audiences.- Analyse web and digital campaign performance across IRC Germany's- fundraising efforts, and use the findings to guide content and testing decisions- and give prospects and supporters a great digital experience.- Take responsibility for how your activity performs against agreed KPIs and- income targets, and make sure campaign reports capture learnings for future activity.YOUR PROFILEEssential:- Relevant university degree or equivalent practical experience (at least 2-4- years) in donor and/or customer acquisition, retention, and content- development, ideally in a non-profit or NGO context- Proven ability using analytics and reporting to inform channel and content- decisions and measure success against key KPIs, primarily ROI- Experience creating and adapting fundraising content and messaging across- formats and channels, including design tools such as Canva or Adobe- Creative Cloud, especially Adobe Premiere- Experience using Salesforce or an equivalent CRM- Excellent written and spoken communication skills in German (C1 level or- above, according to the Common European Framework of Reference for- Languages, CEFR), and fluent in English- Strong IT skills, particularly Microsoft Office (especially Excel)- Desirable:- Experience working with agencies, external consultants, and vendors- Experience and knowledge in applying AI tools to support fundraising- activities, such as content creation, campaign optimization, or data analysisPreferred:- Experience working in a centralized or international organization, or in other- cross-team and cross-country collaborationWe Offer- Meaningful work within a collaborative team- A starting salary of 51,428.58 Euro gross per year as well as an annual salary- increase- Attractive employee benefits such as gym membership, company pension scheme,- shopping vouchers, childcare subsidy, job bike leasing, subsidized Deutschlandticket- (national public transport), and access to timely and confidential psychological- support if needed- 30 days of annual leave and special leave days- Flexible hybrid-work options (working hours, office/homebased)- Training and professional development opportunities, including access to free- language courses- Assistance services for people with disabilities, if required.We look forward to receiving your application (including CV and – if available – three references) via our application portal – even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.Unfortunately, we are unable to consider applications submitted by email.For questions regarding the position, please contact Burrhus Njanjo (HR.Deutschland@rescue.org).As an organization committed to an empowering work environment, equal opportunities, and against any form of discrimination, we welcome applications from people regardless of their origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disabilities, age, or other characteristics protected by applicable law. jobs.title: Projektleiter:in Regulatory Affairs – Medizinsoftware (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description: Große Projekte, komplexe Anforderungen und jede Menge Verantwortung sind genau Dein Ding? Bei uns bringst Du die Zertifizierung unserer medizinischen Software voran, hältst die Fäden zwischen verschiedenen Teams zusammen und kannst Deine regulatorische Expertise einbringen oder gezielt weiterentwickeln.Wo Du mit anpacken kannst- Du übernimmst die Steuerung unserer Zertifizierungsprojekte nach der Medizinprodukteverordnung (MDR) und hältst Meilensteine, Abhängigkeiten und Risiken im Blick – von der ersten Planung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.- Ob Entwicklung, Produktmanagement, Qualitätsmanagement oder externe Partner: Du bringst alle Beteiligten an einen Tisch und sorgst dafür, dass alle auf dasselbe Ziel hinarbeiten.- Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Expert:innen aus Qualitätsmanagement und Regulatorik zusammen. Dabei bringst Du Deine eigene Expertise ein oder baust sie gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter aus.- Bei Dir verliert sich nichts im Papierdschungel. Du behältst Nachweise, Dokumente und Verantwortlichkeiten im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Zertifizierungsunterlagen vollständig und aktuell bleiben.- Regulatorik und agile Softwareentwicklung müssen sich nicht im Weg stehen. Du hilfst dabei, Freigabe- und Änderungsprozesse so zu gestalten, dass Qualität und Entwicklungstempo zusammenpassen.- Zeitpläne, Ressourcen und Budgets hast Du fest im Griff. Du berichtest regelmäßig an unsere Geschäftsführung und sprichst offen an, wenn irgendwo nachgesteuert werden muss.- Du arbeitest überwiegend remote und kommst für regelmäßige persönliche Abstimmungen nach Jena.Was Du mitbringen solltest- Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer, bereichsübergreifender Projekte mit.- Idealerweise kennst Du bereits ein reguliertes Umfeld, beispielsweise Medizintechnik, Pharma, Automotive, Luftfahrt oder Finanzwesen, in dem Dokumentation und Nachweise zum Alltag gehören.- Du behältst nicht nur das große Ganze im Blick, sondern schaust auch bei den Details genau hin. Schließlich sollen am Ende nicht nur die Ergebnisse stimmen, sondern auch die Nachweise dazu.- Neue Themen schrecken Dich nicht ab – im Gegenteil! Du hast Lust, Dich tief mit Medizinprodukten und Regulatorik zu beschäftigen und Deine Expertise weiter auszubauen.- Auch wenn viele Fäden gleichzeitig zusammenlaufen, behältst Du einen kühlen Kopf, setzt Prioritäten und sorgst dafür, dass Fristen nicht heimlich an Dir vorbeiziehen.- Du kommunizierst klar, bringst unterschiedliche Interessen zusammen und sprichst Risiken lieber frühzeitig an, statt sie unter den Teppich zu kehren.- Erfahrung mit der MDR oder der Zertifizierung von Medizinprodukten ist ein großes Plus – egal ob Du bereits Zertifizierungsprojekte begleitet hast oder erste Berührungspunkte mitbringst. Auch Kenntnisse in Softwareentwicklung, Qualitätsmanagementsystemen wie ISO 9001, ISO 13485 oder ISO 27001 sowie Audits sind willkommen.- KI-Tools gehören für Dich bereits zum Arbeitsalltag. Du nutzt sie gerne, um Informationen aufzubereiten, Zusammenhänge zu durchdringen und Deine Arbeit effizienter zu gestalten.- Um bei uns richtig Fuß zu fassen, beherrschst Du Deutsch fließend auf mindestens C1-Niveau und bringst gute Englischkenntnisse mit.Warum wir?Wir sind ein offenes und ambitioniertes Team von über 500 Mitarbeitern, das Kundenorientierung wirklich lebt und gleichzeitig Spaß hat. Bei uns herrscht auch nach über 10 Jahren eine Startup-Atmosphäre, die neben dem legendären Obstkorb auch vielseitige Perks wie eine steuerfreie Shoppingkarte, Dienstrad-Leasing und Gesundheitskurse (z.B. Yoga, Rückentraining und mental Health) anbietet - sowohl online als auch im Büro.Je nach Einsatzgebiet (und das sind mindestens 75% aller Unternehmensbereiche) bieten wir all unseren Kollegen flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home Office an. Wir verstehen uns als eng zusammenhaltendes Team mit Kooperations- statt Wettbewerbs-Atmosphäre. Außerhalb der Arbeit organisieren wir Events wie Beachvolleyball im Sommer, Grillfeste, Kochabende oder Paddeltouren.Deine Vorteile bei uns:- Super Team und flache Hierarchien- Job Crafting/individuelle Arbeitsgestaltung- Flexible Arbeitszeiten- Weiterentwicklung- Home Office/Mobiles Arbeiten- Team Events- Förderung der physischen und psychischen Gesundheit- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge- Betriebliche Krankenversicherung- Dienstradleasing/Jobrad- Hardwareleasing- Mitarbeiterrabatte- Betreuungkostenzuschuss/ Kita-Zuschuss- Erholungsbeihilfe- Essenszuschuss- Fahrtkostenzuschuss- AuslandsarbeitÜberzeugt? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt bei uns!Lade deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung inklusive Anschreiben, Lebenslauf und der relevanten Zeugnisse (Schul-, Ausbildungs-, Uni- und Arbeitszeugnisse) ganz einfach online auf unserer Homepage hoch. jobs.description: Company DescriptionAs the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.Job DescriptionWe are on the lookout for a (Senior) Product Manager in Logistics Customer Choice to own the demand management solutions that keep ordering smooth when delivery capacity is stretched. You'll work hands-on with Engineering and Data Science to turn real-time fleet saturation signals into product decisions that lift peak-time conversion and reduce cancellations. You'll be accountable for execution as much as strategy, bringing Operations, regional teams, and engineers along as features go live.We are building the Choice products that decide which options customers see, balancing real-time fleet saturation with customer intent so logistical saturation doesn't get in the way of ordering.In our Logistics Team, you'll tackle high-impact challenges that make last-mile delivery efficient, affordable, and sustainable. Your work will directly improve experiences for riders, end customers, and merchants across the globe. Each enhancement you contribute will help Delivery Hero optimize delivery operations, supporting expansion into new areas like grocery and retail.- Own the roadmap for demand management solutions that balance fleet capacity with customer ordering.- Take features from idea to launch with Engineering, writing clear requirements and prioritizing the backlog.- Partner with Data Science to shape and evaluate models and AI-driven configurations that replace manual operational settings.- Run experiments and track conversion, cancellation, and fleet saturation metrics to decide what ships next.- Align Operations, regional product teams, and engineers on priorities, trade-offs, and timelines throughout delivery.- Coordinate with multiple internal stakeholders to ensure the services we use are being consumed and to understand the end-to-end impact.Qualifications- 3-5 years of product management experience, ideally in marketplace, logistics, or e-commerce environments.- A track record of managing stakeholders through execution and aligning diverse teams on complex initiatives.- Hands-on ownership: you're comfortable working through details with engineers, including APIs and system behavior.- Comfort using data to define success measures and assess impact.- Experience working with data scientists, plus a working understanding of ML concepts and experimentation frameworks.- Ability to manage several competing priorities when operational conditions change quickly.Nice to have- Experience in logistics, delivery, or other supply-and-demand balancing problems.- Experience building internal tools for operations teams.- Exposure to rules engines, ranking, or personalization systems.- Experience launching AI-driven product features.Additional InformationEnsuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. jobs.title: Erzieher / Kindheitspädagoge (m/w/d) im Kindergarten Marktstraße (Erzieher/in)
jobs.employer: FRÖBEL Bildung und Erziehung gGmbH Einrichtungen Köln
jobs.description: Über unsDu weißt, dass Lernen nicht still sitzen muss: Es kann hüpfen, trommeln, malen, draußen stattfinden und dabei sogar Verantwortung für die Umwelt übernehmen.Insgesamt 45 Kinder im Alter von 6 Monaten bis 6 Jahren freuen sich seit Februar 2022 über den Fröbel-Kindergarten Marktstraße. Die Schwerpunkte der Einrichtung liegen auf kultureller Bildung und Stadtteilgeschichte und das hat einen guten Grund. Die Kita liegt in einem der ältesten Stadtteile Essens. Unweit der Einrichtung befindet sich das Schloss Borbeck, das für das ganze Viertel eine große Bedeutung hat. Der Geschichte und Kultur des Stadtteils gemeinsam mit den Kindern auf die Spur zu kommen – das hat sich die Einrichtung zur besonderen Bildungsaufgabe gemacht.Der Kindergarten liegt mitten in einer Einkaufsstraße, in einem ehemaligen Fachgeschäft. In insgesamt neun Räumen im Erdgeschoss finden die Kinder viele Anregungen zum Forschen, für kreatives Gestalten oder Rollenspiel. Auch ein Bewegungsraum ist vorhanden. Die Kinder können sich in den altersgemischten Bildungsbereichen nach ihren individuellen Interessen bewegen. In der Küche der Einrichtung wird täglich frisch gekocht.Für Bewegung an der frischen Luft sorgt nicht nur der nahe gelegene historische Schlosspark: Hinter der Einrichtung gibt es einen schönen Außenbereich mit Hochbeeten, einem Sandspielplatz und naturnahen Spielgeräten. In den verschiedenen Beeten pflanzen die Kinder Obst, Gemüse und Kräuter an, die in unserer Küche verwendet werden. So erleben sie ganzheitlich, wo ihre Lebensmittel herkommen, und entwickeln ein Bewusstsein für Nachhaltigkeit und gesunde Ernährung.Die Kita orientiert sich an Nachhaltigkeitszielen – das spiegelt sich auch in der nahezu plastikfreien Inneneinrichtung und Ausstattung wider. Viele hochwertige und nachhaltige Spiel-, Experimentier- und Lernmaterialien schaffen eine Umgebung, in der sich Kinder, pädagogische Fachkräfte und Familien wohlfühlen.Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die pädagogische Qualität mit Fachlichkeit, Engagement und eigenen Ideen mitgestalten möchte. Die Stelle ist mit einem Wochenstundenumfang von 35 Std. zu besetzen.Aufgaben im Überblick- Gestaltung eines pädagogischen Alltags, der die Bildungs- und Entwicklungsprozesse der Kinder fördert – auf Basis des landesspezifischen Bildungsplans, der Fröbel-Rahmenkonzeption und der jeweiligen Hauskonzeption- Wahrnehmung jedes Kindes als kompetente Persönlichkeit und wertschätzende Begleitung seiner individuellen Bildungs- und Entwicklungsprozesse- Beobachtung und Dokumentation von Entwicklungsständen, Interessen und Bedürfnissen der Kinder als Grundlage für die pädagogische Planung- Planung und Umsetzung altersgerechter Bildungsangebote nach aktuellen fachlichen und wissenschaftlichen ErkenntnissenProfil und Voraussetzungen- Anerkannte Qualifikation als Erzieher:in oder ein abgeschlossenes Studium im pädagogischen Bereich- Begeisterung daran, Kinder individuell zu begleiten und ihre Entwicklung aktiv zu fördern- Offenheit für fachliche Weiterentwicklung und Interesse an pädagogischen Schwerpunktthemen- Haltung und Engagement für Bildungsgerechtigkeit und gelebte VielfaltDas bieten wir- Kinderrechte im Fokus: Innovativer Arbeitgeber, der sich für die Rechte von Kindern stark macht.- Tarifbindung: Faire Vergütung und viele Vorteile gemäß unserem Fröbel-Haustarifvertrag.- Mehr Freizeit: 33 Urlaubstage und zusätzlich am 24.12. und 31.12 bezahlt frei.- Flexible Zusatzleistungen: Wahl zwischen 46,55 Euro Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket und 50 Euro Fröbel BenefitCard oder bis zu 99 Euro Mobilitätszulage für ein JobRad – bei Teilzeit anteilig.- Zukunft sichern: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge in Höhe von 4%.- Finanzieller Bonus: Monatlich bis zu 62 Euro Ergänzungszulage und eine Jahressonderzahlung.- Fort- und Weiterbildungen: Innovative Personalentwicklung mit Präsenzseminaren, Live-Online-Seminaren und E-Learning-Kursen.- Fach- und Führungskarrieren: Entwicklungschancen durch Spezialisierung als Multiplikator:in für besondere Bildungsbereiche oder als Koordinator:in mit stellvertretenden Leitungsfunktion bis hin zur Kita-Leitung oder Fachberatung.- Starker Zusammenhalt: Regelmäßige Teamtage zur Stärkung der Zusammenarbeit.- Professionelle Unterstützung: Zentrale Ressourcen, z.B. für Kinderschutz, Krisenmanagement und Familienbildung.- Netzwerkaufbau: Hospitationsmöglichkeiten und Erasmusreisen.- Online-Curriculum: 733 Euro Zulage für das Absolvieren unseres Online-Curriculums in den ersten sechs Monaten.- Prämien und Rabatte: Bis zu 600 Euro für die erfolgreiche Empfehlung einer Fachkraft und Zugang zu den Rabattportalen Corporate Benefits und Benefits.me für Fitness, Shopping und mehr.Gut zu wissen: Viele Vorteile gelten ab dem ersten Arbeitstag. Einzelne Leistungen werden gemäß Fröbel-Haustarifvertrag (https://www.froebel-gruppe.de/htv) nach der Probezeit gewährt.KontaktinformationenWenn Du Kinder mit Energie und Einfühlungsvermögen begleiten möchtest, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung!Bewerbungen können bequem über unser Online-Bewerbungsformular eingereicht werden.Fröbel-Kindergarten Marktstraßez. H. jobs.title: Quality Management & Regulatory Affairs Manager – Medical Devices (m/f/d) (Fachkraft - Qualitätssicherung/-management)
jobs.description: As Quality Management & Regulatory Affairs Manager (m/f/d), you ensure that our medical device portfolio meets the highest quality and regulatory standards. You are responsible for key QM processes for the companies of Avia Pharma Germany, keep us audit-ready at all times in line with ISO 13485 and MDR, and report directly to the Director of Scientific Affairs DACH. Short decision-making processes and flat hierarchies help us implement exciting ideas quickly and without red tape.On top of that, you can look forward to:- First-name culture: We treat each other as equals – from apprentices to management- Flexibility: Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model- Fit & Active: eGym Wellpass membership and (e-)bike leasing- Time off: 30 days of vacation per year- Securing your future: Company pension scheme included- Team spirit: Regular team events- Little things that matter: Birthday gift, subsidy for computer glasses, plus fruit & drinksWould you like to help shape our success story? Then we look forward to receiving your meaningful application, including your salary expectations.

jobs.title: Pflegehilfskraft Ambulant (m/w/d) (Altenpflegehelfer/in)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Pflegehelfer/in in der ambulanten PflegeStellenbeschreibung:Was den Job auszeichnetHier sind deine Vibes gefragt - flexibel, verlässlich und nah am Menschen.Für den Aufbau unseres neuen Flex-Teams Ambulante Pflege suchen wir engagierte Pflegehilfskräfte, die Lust haben, Wachstum aktiv mitzugestalten.Unser Ziel ist es, neue Kundinnen und Kunden in der ambulanten Pflege aufzunehmen, neue Touren aufzubauen und unsere Standorte in der Region Hannover weiterzuentwickeln. Als Mitarbeitende*r im Flex-Team wirst du zunächst standortübergreifend eingesetzt und unterstützt insbesondere dort, wo neue Versorgungsstrukturen entstehen.Wir stellen mit unterschiedlichen Stellenanteilen ein. Da sich das Flex-Team im Aufbau befindet, sind verschiedene Arbeitszeitmodelle denkbar. Den konkreten Beschäftigungsumfang stimmen wir gemeinsam ab - abhängig von deinen Möglichkeiten, unseren Einsatzbedarfen und der weiteren Entwicklung des Teams.Sobald neue Kundinnen und Kunden zu vollständigen Touren zusammengeführt wurden, kann - sofern beidseitig gewünscht - eine feste Anbindung an eine bestehende Einrichtung oder einen ambulanten Standort erfolgen.Pflegen m****it Sinn - und mit BewegungIm Flex-Team bist du Teil eines neuen, dynamischen Arbeitsbereichs. Du unterstützt Menschen zuhause in unterschiedlichen Lebenslagen und trägst gleichzeitig dazu bei, neue ambulante Versorgungsangebote in der Region Hannover aufzubauen.Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, lernst verschiedene Teams, Standorte und Touren kennen und bringst deine Fachlichkeit genau dort ein, wo sie gebraucht wird.Dabei lassen wir dich nicht allein: Du erhältst eine strukturierte Einarbeitung, klare Ansprechpartner*innen und regelmäßige Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.Deine Aufgaben- Unterstützung neuer Kundinnen und Kunden in der ambulanten Pflege- Mitarbeit beim Aufbau neuer Touren und Versorgungsstrukturen- Standortübergreifende Einsätze innerhalb der Region Hannover- Durchführung der Grundpflege und im pflegerischen Alltag- Durchführung delegierbarer Tätigkeiten nach Qualifikation, Einarbeitung und Anleitung- Dokumentation der erbrachten Leistungen und Weitergabe wichtiger Beobachtungen- Zusammenarbeit mit Pflegefachkräften, ambulanten Teams und Leitungskräften- Mitgestaltung eines wachsenden, flexiblen EinsatzbereichsWas für uns zählt- Freude an ambulanter Pflege und an der Arbeit mit Menschen zuhause- Flexibilität und Bereitschaft zu standortübergreifenden Einsätzen- Einfühlungsvermögen, Zuverlässigkeit, Teamgeist und eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten- Menschlichkeit uns ein gutes Gespür für das, was gerade zählt- gerne einen Führerschein der Klasse "B"- Bereitschaft, Wachstum aktiv mitzugestalten und neue Versorgungsstrukturen aufzubauenDu startest im Flex-Team und unterstützt zunächst übergreifend den Aufbau neuer Kundentouren in der ambulanten Pflege. Wenn sich aus neuen Kundinnen und Kunden vollständige Touren ergeben, kann perspektivisch - sofern du das möchtest und es organisatorisch passt - eine feste Zuordnung zu einem bestehenden Standort oder einer Einrichtung erfolgen.Auch der Stellenanteil kann sich im weiteren Verlauf gemeinsam entwickeln - passend zu deinen Wünschen, den Anforderungen im Flex-Team und den entstehenden Tourenstrukturen.Bewirb dich jetztUnsere Vorteile- Faire Bezahlung nach Tarifvertrag - ist für uns selbstverständlich- Jahressonderzahlung- Lebensphasenorientiertes Arbeiten (36h / Woche mit 4-Tage-Option)- Springerpauschale- Zuschuss zu Sport- und Gesundheitseinrichtungen- Zusatzrente VBL- Fort- und Weiterbildung- Firmenfahrzeug für dienstliche Zwecke (im ambulanten Bereich)- JobRad - wir sind dabei- Betriebliches GesundheitsmanagementIhr AnsprechpartnerDRK-Pflegedienste Hannover gGmbHKarlsruher Straße 2 b, 30519 Hannover Tel.: 0511 367-1234 auch gerne per WhatsAppMail: pflegen@drk-hannover.de

jobs.description: Was den Job auszeichnetDie 3-jähringe Ausbildung zum Notfallsanitäter (m/w/d) beinhaltet den theoretischen und praktischen Unterricht in der DRK-Rettungsschule Niedersachsen und die praktische Ausbildung in unseren Lehrrettungswachen sowie im klinischen Bereich der Krankenhäuser. Während der Ausbildung wirkst du in der notfallmedizinischen Versorgung und dem Transport von Patienten mit. Du erlernst den situationsgerechten Umgang mit Menschen in Krisen- und Notfallsituationen und begleitest dabei die Kommunikation mit allen Beteiligten (u.a. Patienten, Behörden, Institutionen) im Rahmen der Einsätze. In Zusammenarbeit mit den Kolleginnen und Kollegen übernimmst du die Dokumentation der Einsätze, stellst die Einsatz- und Betriebsfähigkeit der Rettungsmittel sicher und führst Hygienemaßnahmen durch.Wir suchen Auszubildende für die 3-jährige Ausbildung zum Notfallsanitäter (m/w/d) für unsere Lehrrettungsstandorte in der Region und Landeshauptstadt Hannover. Ausbildungsbeginn ist der 01. August 2027.Was für uns zählt- Mindestens ein mittlerer Schulabschluss- Volljährigkeit und ein Führerschein Kl. B- eine freundliche und zuverlässige Umgangsweise- Spaß an der Arbeit mit Menschen und im Team- eine aufgeschlossene, einfühlsame Persönlichkeit- Zuverlässigkeit, Flexibilität und Engagement- Identifikation mit den Grundsätzen des Deutschen Roten Kreuzes- Der Schutz der uns Anvertrauten ist uns besonders wichtig, daher benötigen wir von unseren Auszubildenden ein erweitertes Führungszeugnis sowie einen Nachweis der Masernimpfung bereits zum Arbeitsbeginn. Bereitschaft zur Umsetzung der aktuell geltenden Impfempfehlungen (z.B. Hepatitis A und B, Corona)Für Ihre Bewerbung reichen Sie bitte folgende Unterlagen bis zum 15.01.2027 ein:- Lebenslauf- Nachweis Fahrerlaubnis Klasse B- letztes Schulzeugnis/Schulabschlusszeugnis- Deutsches Sportabzeichen, alternativ Schwimmabzeichen in Silber (nicht älter als 6 Monate)Unsere Vorteile- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge- hohe Übernahmechancen nach erfolgreichem Abschluss- Kostenloser Zugang zum Hansefit-Netzwerk für Sport- Fitness- und Wellnessangebote- Mitarbeitenden-Vorteile wie Einkaufsvergünstigungen und Rotkreuz-Auslandshilfe- Vermögenswirksame Leistungen- Jahressonderzahlung- verantwortungsvoller krisensicherer Arbeitsplatz- Mitarbeit in einem engagierten, kollegialen Team- Moderner Fuhrpark mit hochwertig ausgestatteter Medizintechnik

jobs.title: PhD position or Postdoctoral researcher (m/f/d) (Geophysiker/in)
jobs.description: PhD position or Postdoctoral researcher (m/f/d): Effects of global livestock management on wildlife movementSenckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre (SBiK-F), starting as of 01 January2027:PhD position or Postdoctoral researcher (m/f/d):Effects of global livestock management on wildlife movementitel (m/f/d)(Part-Time)Location: Frankfurt am MainEmployment scope: PhD position (65%) / PostDoc (up to 60%)Type of contract: Temporary, limited to 4 years, until 31.12.20230Remuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E 13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.The mission of the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre is to study the complex interactions between biodiversity, climate and society.As part of the Centre, the group “Global Land Systems and Biodiversity” takes a system perspective on how production, trade and consumption of food and other biomass products affect ecosystems and people.The VEBITA project, conducted jointly by SGN, the Marburg University and the Institute for Social-Ecological Research (ISOE) brings together researchers and practice partners to work towards utilizing animal movement data for early-warning systems for nature conservation. By analyzing GPS and sensor data from animals with statistical and AI-based methods, VEBITA aims to detect how animal behaviors change in response to land use, climate change, habitat loss, infrastructure development, and other environmental pressures.The adverstised position focuses on the effects of livestock management on wildlife movements contributes a use-case for state-of-the art animal movement data. Currently, livestock keeping has the largest spatial footprint of all land uses and the global biomass of mammalian livestock exceeds that of all remaining wild mammals by an order of magnitude. How and where livestock are kept greatly impacts the movements of the remaining wild mammals.In this context, we seek to develop a refined biodiversity footprint approach that captures how different livestock management strategies impact movement of wild mammals and how management can be adapted to achieve more sustainable outcomes. This subproject is part of VEBITA’s transdisciplinary focus, and the design of the novel footprint approach will consider perspectives of different relevant societal stakeholder groups such as livestock farmers, conservationists, and regulators. jobs.description: Senckenberg – Leibniz Institution for Biodiversity and Earth System Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at its Department of River Ecology and Conservation in Gelnhausen, starting as soon as possible2 Postdoctoral Researchers (ecologists) (m/f/d)(full-time / part-time)Location: GelnhausenEmployment scope: full-time / part-time options are availableType of contract: limited two years / an extension is be possibleRemuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) E 13Senckenberg is one of the world’s leading research institutions in the field of Biodiversity and Earth System Research, with eight research institutes and three natural history museums across Germany and scientists from over 40 nations. Our headquarter is located in the thriving commercial metropolis of Frankfurt in the heart of Germany, which also hosts one of our most famous facilities, the Senckenberg Natural History Museum. The location of the available position is in a Senckenberg institute about 40 kilometers east of Frankfurt in Gelnhausen, a historic town accessible via public transport (rail and bus).We are looking for enthusiastic ecologists with a background in broad-scale biodiversity change, community ecology, macroecology, metacommunities, and/or analysis of ecological time series.The two positions are embedded in one or more of the following projects:1. Synthesis Center on Freshwater Biodiversity Change in Europe The Synthesis Center brings together and supports a broad variety of researchers and practitioners investigating a broad variety of fundamental and applied ecological questions, with a particular focus on broad-scale and long-term biodiversity change, community ecology, freshwater ecology, time series analyses, multiple stressor impacts, and conservation (see doi.org/10.1038/s41586-023-06400-1 for an example). Data for > 30,000 freshwater biodiversity time series across 30 European countries have already been compiled from rivers and lakes, covering invertebrates, fish, macrophytes, diatoms, and benthic algae, in collaboration with a large pan-European network of > 200 researchers. Positions involved in this project are expected to pursue similar questions using the already available data.2. EU Horizon Europe project BEAGLE (started on 1st October 2026)BEAGLE (Biodiversity methods for advanced monitoring at large scales) is an EU-funded project using new technology to enhance biodiversity monitoring across terrestrial, freshwater, and marine environments. Specifically, the project uses sensors, environmental DNA (eDNA) and AI, as well as citizen science to collect large-scale and high-quality biodiversity data across a consortium of 17 partners. Positions involved in this project will focus on several tasks, including European-scale biodiversity data mobilization activities (e.g., tracking down datasets and preparing them for use), and the learning and deployment of field-based methods for data collection (e.g., Malaise traps). Participating researchers will gain experience in broad-scale biodiversity data collection and management, biodiversity monitoring, and participation in European-scale research networks.Your tasks• Contributing scientifically to one or more of the above-described projects (you can indicate a preference in your application if you have one)• Analyzing spatial and temporal biodiversity data, and accompanied environmental data, to elucidate spatial patterns and temporal trends and drivers thereof• Preparing scientific manuscripts• Attending project meetings and preparing project reports• Mentoring graduate students• Giving oral presentations at national and international conferences• Attending virtual and physical project meetingsYour profile• PhD in Ecology or a related field• Solid background in fields related to the above expected tasks for a given project or projects.• Advanced skills in statistical analyses, using R• Skills in project management and report writing are preferred but not essential• Strong publication record for your current career level• Excellent written and oral communication and project presentation skills in EnglishWe offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. jobs.title: PostDoc position (m/f/d) in  Data-Driven Social-Ecological Research (Umweltwissenschaftler/in)
jobs.description: Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre (SBiK-F), starting as soon as possible:PostDoc (m/f/d) in Data-Driven Social Ecological Research(Full-Time / Part-Time** **options available)Location: Frankfurt am MainEmployment scope: Full-Time; Part-Time options are availableType of contract: Temporary, limited to 3 yearsRemuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.The mission of the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre is to study the complex interactions between biodiversity, climate and society.SBiK-F has strong cooperations with the Institute for social-ecological research (ISOE) and the position will work closely with both institutions.The position develops quantitative approaches to (1) better characterize and measure human–nature interactions, or (2) use these analyses to identify leverage points for more effective stewardship or monitoring of nature under climate change.Your tasks- Develop quantitative approaches to measure and analyze human–nature interactions- Integrate multiple data streams (ecological, social, remote-sensing, citizen-science) into coherent models of social-ecological system dynamics- Identify leverage points where intervention or monitoring most effectively supports biodiversity- Advance biodiversity or stewardship monitoring frameworks to better incorporate social dimensions- Publish in leading international journals- Contribute to and connect with ongoing research at SBiK-F- Collaborate across the natural- and social-science groups at Senckenberg, ISOE, and partner institutionsYour profile- PhD in ecology, environmental science, quantitative social science, or a related field- Demonstrated experience working with empirical ecological data and preferably also social data- Strong proficiency in R (and/or comparable statistical/programming environments)- Excellent quantitative and statistical skills- Strong publication record in international peer-reviewed journals- Fluency in written and spoken EnglishDesirable skills- Experience with integrating heterogeneous data streams (eg. ecological, social, remote sensing or citizen science data)- Familiarity with AI/ML methods- Track record of interdisciplinary collaboration across natural and social sciences- Experience in quantitative social science methods and working with social or socio-economic data- Experience in acquiring third-party funding- Familiarity with trait-based approaches to social-ecological questions- Familiarity with adaptive capacity and resilience of social-ecological systems- Familiarity with impacts of climate change on the interactions between biodiversity and societyWe offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Die Patienten stehen im Vordergrund und Sie haben die Zeit, auf sie einzugehen. Sie erwartet ein motiviertes Team in einem kollegialen Arbeitsklima, welches Ihnen die Möglichkeit bietet, sich sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.Bringen Sie Ihre medizinische Leidenschaft dort ein, wo andere Urlaub machen.Unser Team vor Ort coacht und begleitet Sie durch den kompletten Bewerbungsprozess sowie die Erlangung der MEBEKO-Anerkennung durch das SRK. Dazu gehören unter anderem Herz-Kreislauf-Erkrankungen, Diabetes, Erkrankungen der Atemwege (Lunge), Verdauungserkrankungen, Nierenleiden, hormonelle Störungen, rheumatische Erkrankungen, Infektionskrankheiten und Bluterkrankungen.- Patientenanamnese und körperliche Untersuchung:Sie erheben eine detaillierte Krankengeschichte (Anamnese) und führen umfassende körperliche Untersuchungen durch.- Anordnung und Interpretation von Untersuchungen:Sie entscheiden, welche Labor-, bildgebenden (z.B. Röntgen, Ultraschall) oder funktionellen Untersuchungen (z.B. EKG, Lungenfunktion) notwendig sind, ordnen diese an und interpretieren die Ergebnisse.- Erstellung von Behandlungsplänen:Basierend auf der Diagnose entwickeln sie individuelle Behandlungspläne, verschreiben Medikamente und überwachen den Therapieerfolg.- Betreuung chronischer Erkrankungen:Sie sind häufig die erste Anlaufstelle und betreuen Patienten mit chronischen Erkrankungen.- Beratung zu Krankheitsmanagement und Prävention:Sie beraten Patienten umfassend zum Umgang mit ihrer Krankheit, zu präventiven Maßnahmen und zur Gesundheitsförderung.- Koordination der Patientenversorgung:Sie arbeiten eng mit anderen Fachärzten (z.B. Chirurgen, Kardiologen, Rheumatologen) und anderen Gesundheitsberufen zusammen, um eine ganzheitliche und interdisziplinäre Betreuung zu gewährleisten. Sie überweisen Patienten an Spezialärzte, wenn spezielle Behandlungen erforderlich sind.- Notfallmedizinische Versorgung:In der Notfallversorgung überwachen und behandeln Sie Patienten mit akut bedrohlichen Zuständen.- Umfassende Betreuung:Sie kümmern sich um Patienten aller Altersstufen, wobei besonders in der Praxis ältere und multimorbide Patienten (Patienten mit mehreren chronischen Erkrankungen) häufig sind. Sie sind auch in der Palliativmedizin tätig, um Patienten mit nicht heilbaren Krankheiten zu betreuen.- Führungsverantwortung, Lehre und Forschung:Sie übernehmen auch Führungsaufgaben in Kliniken, engagieren sich in der Ausbildung des medizinischen Nachwuchses und sind an wissenschaftlicher Forschung beteiligt.Qualifikationen / Anforderungen- Facharzttitel für Allgemeine Innere Medizin (AIM) gerne mit Spezialisierung sowie erfüllte Voraussetzungen für die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen(EU-Facharzttitel, EU-Approbation und EU-Staatsbürgerschaft)- Berufserfahrung mindestens 2 Jahre- Freude an Teamarbeit, am Teaching von Kolleginnen/Kollegen in Weiterbildung und an konstruktiver, interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit- Eine offene, kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit einer patienten-, kunden- und mitarbeiterorientierten Grundhaltung und hohem Engagement- Erfahrung in einer angiologischen (Kader-)StellungQualifikation für die Durchführung von PTA von Vorteil- Interesse und Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit- Die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen müssen beim Bewerbungsbeginn nicht vorhanden sein, jedoch beim Stellenantritt. jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect (f/m/d)  IT/OT Security Platforms (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description: Together, we make the differenceSiemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.As a Solution Architect (f/m/d) for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts.As part of our team, you will have- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interestsSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.What part will you play?- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security Platforms (SINEC Secure Connect), ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements. - You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases. - You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints. - You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps. - You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens. - You define integration concepts between connectivity services, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems. - You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape. - You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability. - You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services.What you bring to the table- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification. - Experience & Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443. - You have proven experience with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures. - You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps. - You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design. - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- Ways of working:- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments. - You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).- Languages: Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. That’s why you are always our top priority.Our global,diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? jobs.description: CONTACT Software Schweiz AG Sie sind erfahren in der Leitung von Softwareprojekten und suchen nach einer neuen Rolle, bei der Sie Ihr bisheriges Wissen einsetzen und kontinuierlich erweitern können? und partnerschaftlichen Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Geschäftspartnern Aufbereitung und Präsentation von aktuellen Projektständen und Ergebnissen gegenüber dem Lenkungskreis und unserer Geschäftsleitung spannende Projekte im IT-Umfeld auf Basis der leistungsfähigsten Plattform für PLM, Kollaboration und IoT flache Hierarchien innerhalb einer stark wachsenden Organisation mit ,,Du"-Kultur bis zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung eigene Wahl der Entwicklungsumgebung Teilnahme an verschiedenen Sportgruppen, regelmäßigen Team- und Firmen-Events Wahl zwischen der Arbeit aus dem Home-Office, Hybrid oder aus dem schweizer Büro offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur, in der eigene Ideen nicht nur erlaubt, sondern auch gern gehört werden flexible Arbeitszeiten mit jobs.title: strážníci městské policie JH, Strážníci
jobs.description: Požadavky:-    dovršení věku 18 let,-    občanství České republiky,-    ukončené střední vzdělání s maturitní zkouškou,-    bezúhonnost podle zákona o obecní policii,-    spolehlivost podle zákona o obecní policii,-    zdravotní způsobilost k výkonu práce strážníka,-    rozšířené zbrojní oprávnění výhodou; uchazeč, který není jeho držitelem, je povinen splnit podmínky pro jeho získání ve lhůtě stanovené zaměstnavatelem,-    řidičské oprávnění skupiny B,-    dobré komunikační schopnosti, odpovídající úroveň vystupování a jednání s lidmi, důslednost, schopnost kvalifikovaného a včasného plnění úkolů a flexibilita.Informace o pracovním místě:-    druhem práce je zabezpečování místních záležitostí veřejného pořádku dle zákona o obecní policii a dalších zvláštních právních předpisů se zaměřením na: ochranu bezpečnosti osob a majetku, dodržování pravidel občanského soužití, ochranu veřejného pořádku, dodržování obecně závazných vyhlášek a nařízení obce, provádění dohledu nad bezpečností a plynulostí silničního provozu, podílení se na prevenci kriminality, odhalování přestupků.-    pracovní poměr na dobu určitou v prvním roce, dále pak na dobu neurčitou.-    výkon služby je vykonáván v nepřetržitém provozu podle rozpisu směn. -    do doby získání „Osvědčení“ pobírá čekatel nástupní plat odpovídající 5. platové třídě. Po zařazení do přímého výkonu služby je strážník zařazen do 8. platové třídy s poskytnutím osobního a zvláštního příplatku, příplatku za směnnost, příplatku za noční práci, za práci v sobotu a v neděli, za práci přesčas nebo ve svátek. -    stabilní zaměstnání, zaměstnanecké benefity (příspěvek na stravování a na penzijní pojištění, Flexi Pass, sick days a další), možnost profesního růstu (vzdělávání v oboru).Předpoklady k podání přihlášky do výběrového řízení:Přihlášku může podat občan, který splňuje výše uvedené podmínky a požadavky. Obsah, přílohy, způsob a termín podání přihlášky:Přihláška musí obsahovat, na jaké pracovní místo zájemce přihlášku podává, jméno, příjmení a titul, datum a místo narození, státní příslušnost, číslo dokladu totožnosti, místo trvalého pobytu (též skutečného, pokud se uchazeč zdržuje na jiné adrese), telefonní a e-mailový kontakt, datum a podpis zájemce.K přihlášce se připojí:-    nestrukturovaný pracovní a osobní životopis psaný vlastní rukou,-    motivační dopis,-    výpis z Rejstříku trestů ne starší 3 měsíců,-    ověřená kopie dokladu o nejvyšším dosaženém vzdělání,-    kopie vysvědčení z posledního ročníku základní školy (z osmé nebo deváté třídy). Přihlášky se podávají na podatelně MěÚ nebo zasílají na adresu:    Městský úřad Jindřichův Hradec    Klášterská 135/II    Jindřichův Hradec    PSČ 377 01Přihlášky na předepsaném tiskopise (viz příloha) je nutné podat v zalepené obálce označené „Neotvírat – VŘ – strážník - MěPol“ nejpozději do 31.12.2026 do 10:00 hod.
