jobs.description: Ref 2587540 \| Date: 26 Oct 2026![Unilabs]( )Team Leader des infirmiers à domicile 80% \- Genève**À propos de nous**Unilabs est l'une des principales entreprises de diagnostic en Europe et propose aux patients, sur quatre continents, une offre complète de services de laboratoire, de pathologie et d'imagerie. En tant que leader du numérique couvrant l'ensemble du domaine du diagnostic, les plus de 13'000 collaborateurs d'Unilabs dans le monde sauvent des vies chaque jour. Unilabs investit massivement dans la technologie, l'équipement et le personnel et utilise les technologies numériques de pointe dans ses laboratoires et instituts d'imagerie pour améliorer la vie de près de 100 millions de personnes chaque année.**Vos responsabilités**Vous aimez accompagner une équipe et rester proche du terrain ?  Unilabs recherche une ou un Team Leader à 80%, basé à Genève, pour encadrer son équipe d'infirmiers à domicile en Suisse romande, dès le 1er janvier 2027\.  Vous jouez un rôle clé dans l'organisation des tournées, la qualité des prélèvements et l'accompagnement des collaborateurs.**Compétences requises****Vos missions:**  Encadrer, motiver et accompagner l'équipe au quotidien.  Organiser les plannings et les tournées selon les besoins des patients et les disponibilités de l'équipe.  Accueillir les nouveaux collaborateurs et suivre leur intégration, leurs compétences et leurs besoins de formation.  Veiller au respect des procédures de prélèvement, des règles d'hygiène et de sécurité ainsi que des conditions de conservation des échantillons.  Assurer une coordination efficace avec la responsable, les laboratoires.  Suivre l'activité, identifier les difficultés et proposer des améliorations.  Veiller à la disponibilité du matériel et participer aux prélèvements à domicile selon les besoins.**Votre profil:**  Formation en soins infirmiers et expérience confirmée dans les prélèvements sanguins.  Une expérience à domicile et dans l'encadrement d'équipe constitue un atout.  Sens de l'organisation, autonomie et capacité à gérer les imprévus.  Maîtrise du français ; anglais souhaité**Vos qualités humaines sont essentielles:**  Nous recherchons une personne à l'écoute, bienveillante et fiable, capable de créer une relation de confiance avec les patients et les collaborateurs.  Vous savez fédérer une équipe, reconnaître les contributions de chacun et encourager l'entraide. Vous communiquez avec clarté et respect, donnez des retours constructifs et gérez les tensions avec calme et équité. Votre disponibilité et votre exemplarité font de vous un véritable soutien pour l'équipe.  **Envie de nous rejoindre ?**  Adressez\-nous votre CV accompagné de quelques lignes présentant votre motivation.  Lieu de travail : Genève, avec un périmètre d'activité en Suisse romande  Taux d'activité : 80%  Entrée en fonction : 1er janvier 2027**Nous offrons*** Un environnement de travail passionnant et dynamique, avec une dimension internationale* La possibilité de prendre des responsabilités et de développer votre potentiel* Une atmosphère de travail positive dans un cadre collaboratif et une culture d'entreprise pronant le respect et la reconnaissance* Des avantages sociaux attractifs, ainsi qu'une semaine de travail de 40 heures et 5 semaines de vacances par année* Un forfait annuel pour vos analyses personnelles et tarifs spéciaux pour les actes de radiologie effectués au sein du Groupe Unilabs**Contact**  Envoyer cette annonce à un amijpidafd84e3jm jpit1044jm jpiy26jm

jobs.employer: International School of the Basel Region AG
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Middle School (Language and Literature) Teacher (ideally able to teach Science and/or Individuals and Societies in )--- Middle School (Language and Literature) Teacher (ideally able to teach Science and/or Individuals and Societies in )====================================================================================================================**SCHOOL PROFILE**The International School Basel (ISB) is an English\-language international day school for students from ages 3 to 18\. ISB is home to approximately 1,110 students who enjoy modern purpose\-built facilities on three campuses clustered a few kilometers south of Basel in the towns of Reinach and Aesch. ISB is an International Baccalaureate World School offering the Primary Years Programme (PYP) for younger students aged 3 to 11, the Middle Years Programme (MYP) for students aged 11 to 16 and the Diploma Programme (DP) for students in the final two years of their school careers. ISB is accredited by the New England Association of Schools and Colleges (NEASC). At ISB, we live our Mission and are committed to creating safe, caring, and affirming learning spaces for our international community. It is our aim to create a welcoming environment for students and families from across the globe and to promote learning and respect for people of all nationalities, religions and cultures. ISB's commitment to hiring and retaining quality employees has created a community of professional and dynamic teaching and administrative staff with low turnover rates and a high degree of involvement in professional development programmes. For more information about the school and our mission we invite you to visit our website at **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**International School Basel is an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and national origin. **COMMITMENT TO SAFE RECRUITMENT**International School Basel is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of students in its care. As an employer, the school expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are appointed subject to satisfactory **Criminal Records Checks, Social Media Check, Civil Litigation Check, Global Sanctions Check, and Reference Checks** with past employers. **THE POSITION**ISB seeks to appoint a passionate and dedicated Teacher of (Language and Literature) to join our Middle School Modern Languages Team. The successful candidate will teach to our Middle School students in Grades 6 to 8 within the IB Middle Years Programme. Ideally the candidate could additionally teach **Science** and/or **Individuals \& Societies** in as part of our new Middle School Dual Language Programme.Candidates applying for this role should have proven experience teaching in an international environment, ideally within an MYP context and hold a classroom teaching license and have a minimum of four years teaching experience. We will provide training to a successful candidate who does not have prior MYP experience.Please see the Description for more details. **OUR OFFER**ISB offers an excellent employment package and relocation support in an international and welcoming environment including free after\-school childcare, lessons, professional development opportunities, onsite fitness facilities and first\-class accident insurance worldwide together with an employee friendly pension plan. **HOW TO APPLY**Please apply by sending your application directly to us or by using the link available on Search Associates, the TES or the website. Your application should include: Letter of Application (2 pages maximum); up\-to\-date Curriculum Vitae; and names and contact details of at least two (although three is preferred) professional referees who have line\-managed you: one of whom must be your current Head of School (if this poses major difficulties, please state reasons in your letter of application). If you have been at your current school for less than 2 years, one of your referees must also be the Head of your previous school. Referees will be contacted once a candidate has accepted an invitation to interview for the role. ======================================

Pour les concevoir, les gérer et les entretenir dans le respect des plus hauts standards de qualité que nous nous fixons, nous pouvons compter sur les compétences et l’engagement d’une équipe performante d’une soixantaine de collaboratrices et collaborateurs.*

 

Afin de renforcer le secteur technique de notre Service Immobilier, nous recherchons :

 

### Un·e **Technicien·ne de maintenance à 100 %**

 

**Votre mission**

 

Basé\-e à proximité de la Place des Nations à Genève, vous travaillerez en lien direct avec le Chef d’Unité du secteur Technique, votre mission principale est d’assurer la maintenance technique des installations CVCSE du parc immobilier propriété de notre Fondation.

 

**Vos responsabilités**

* Effectuer la maintenance des installations CVC, sanitaires, éclairages, courant fort, courant faible ainsi que des systèmes de régulation numérique.

jobs.title: Senior Primary Teacher for Innovative Private School in Zurich (Grades 1–3)
jobs.description: Teaching jobs like this don’t come around often. The chance to know each child deeply because class sizes are deliberately small, one teacher for every seven children. To reimagine education for a rapidly changing world. To work alongside a deeply passionate and high-performing team of educators. To let your creative ideas flow and actually bring them to life.Full job description here  here https://tinyurl.com/2c3crwud Role at a glance-Role:Senior Primary Teacher, grades 1–3- Location: Adliswil, Switzerland- Start date: August 2027, with the possibility of starting part-time earlier if available- Commitment:80–100% (additional part-time arrangements may also be possible)- Languages:Fluent English; German proficiency is a strong plus but not required- Experience: Substantial teaching experience, typically 7+ years- Compensation:Typically 15–25% higher than most Zurich private schools, with salaries benchmarked to the official Zurich public teacher scale.About UsAt Lumos School, we believe education should be both academically rigorous and joyful. We are a small, innovative German–English bilingual private school in Zürich, currently serving Grades 1–7 and growing towards Grade 9.Our exceptionally low student-to-teacher ratio of 1:7 allows us to provide personalized learning, individual coaching and meaningful relationships with every child.Our educational philosophy focuses on four principles: learning how to learn, combining challenge with enjoyment (“hard fun”), developing student independence and balancing academic mastery with exploration.We embrace hands-on projects, mixed-age learning, creativity and innovative teaching methods.The RoleWe are looking for an experienced, passionate and creative Senior Primary Teacher to join our Grades 1–3 team.You will take responsibility for curriculum planning, classroom teaching, assessment and student development while working collaboratively with another experienced teacher.We encourage our teachers to go beyond prescribed curricula, using their expertise and creativity to design engaging, meaningful learning experiences.You will play a particularly important role in developing English language and literacy, including phonics, reading, writing, vocabulary and communication skills, while supporting multilingual learners at different proficiency levels.Our two-teacher classroom model encourages shared planning, flexible responsibilities, constructive feedback and genuine collaboration.What We're Looking ForA teaching degree and typically 7+ years of classroom experience, preferably in Grades 1–3.Fluent English; German is a strong advantage but not required.Strong expertise in early primary education, literacy, phonics and numeracy.Experience in curriculum planning, assessment and differentiated instruction.Understanding of bilingual education and multilingual learners.Excellent classroom organization and management skills.Confidence working with mixed-age groups and personalized learning approaches.Experience with Montessori, project-based learning or other innovative educational methods is advantageous.Familiarity with Swiss Lehrplan 21 is helpful but not essential.Eligibility to work in Switzerland.Who You AreWe are looking for someone who genuinely loves teaching young children and understands their need for warmth, encouragement, structure, movement and play.You are confident, creative, organized and proactive. You enjoy taking responsibility but are equally comfortable sharing ideas, decisions and classroom ownership.You value collaboration, communicate clearly, welcome feedback and continuously seek ways to improve your teaching.Most importantly, you are excited about helping children reach their potential while contributing to a thoughtful, ambitious and growing school.What We OfferCompetitive salaries: Typically 15–25% above most Zürich private schools, benchmarked against the Zürich public teacher salary scale.16+ weeks of school holidays.Significant protected planning time.Relocation support where needed.Exceptionally low student-to-teacher ratio of 1:7.Professional autonomy and freedom to develop creative teaching approaches.Supportive leadership and highly experienced international colleagues.Engaged families who share our educational values.A collaborative, innovative and forward-thinking working environment.The opportunity to contribute ideas and help shape the future of our school.Join UsAt Lumos, we believe exceptional teachers make exceptional schools.We are looking for someone who sees teaching as more than a profession: someone who brings experience, imagination, warmth and genuine enthusiasm to the classroom.If you believe children learn best when they are inspired, challenged and supported, we would love to hear from you.

The main responsibilities of the role include: - receiving incoming raw materials; - preparing raw materials for production (cutting, assembling recipes, and preparing the necessary tools and equipment); - operating and monitoring production equipment (grinder, slicer, drying chamber, cutting machine); - loading, unloading, and maintaining drying chambers; - packaging finished products using packaging machinery; - picking and preparing customer orders; - maintaining cleanliness in the workplace and following hygiene and quality requirements. Production Worker is responsible for receiving and preparing raw materials, operating production equipment, carrying out quality control of finished products, performing microbiological analyses, packaging finished products, and filling customer orders.

We offer: - a friendly and supportive team; - on-the-job training; - opportunities to learn new skills and work with a variety of production equipment; - stable employment in a growing Estonian company; - work based on a rotating work schedule; - modern tools and the necessary training for their use; - work clothing and personal protective equipment; - diverse and varied daily tasks.

Other requirements: The position requires good physical endurance, as it involves regular manual handling, lifting, and moving of raw materials and products, as well as frequent movement within production facilities.

Option to work from home: No

Sinu tööülesanneteks on: • klientide sõbralik ja kiire teenindamine; • tellimuste vastuvõtmine ja kassatoimingute tegemine; • toitude ja jookide valmistamine vastavalt meie retseptidele ja kvaliteedistandarditele; • toodete, külmikute ja riiulite täitmine ning väljapaneku korrashoid; • vajalike kaupade ja tooraine tellimine ning laoseisu jälgimine; • kaupade vastuvõtmine ja nõuetekohane hoiustamine; • kohviku, töövahendite ja seadmete puhtuse ning korrasoleku tagamine; • müügiala ja kohviku ümbruse korrashoid; • väliala puhtuse ja korrasoleku eest hoolitsemine; • toiduohutuse ja hügieeninõuete järgimine; • iseseisev töökorraldus – märkad ise, mida on vaja teha, ja tegutsed. See töö sobib inimesele, kellele meeldib olla aktiivne, iseseisev ja käed-külge tegutsemisega. Meie juures ei ole kahte täpselt ühesugust tööpäeva – Sina oled see, kes hoolitseb selle eest, et klient saaks hea toidu, kohvik oleks korras ja kõik vajalik õigel ajal olemas.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meie poolt ootab Sind midagi enamat kui lihtsalt töökoht – tahame, et tunneksid end meie tiimis hästi, oleksid väärtustatud ja saaksid koos ettevõttega areneda. Omalt poolt pakume: • konkurentsivõimeline ja tulemust väärtustav töötasu; • tasuta lõuna tööpäevadel; • ettevõttesiseseid töötajasoodustusi ning soodustusi ka meie teistes tegevussuundades; • paindlik graafik, mida arvestame võimalusel Sinu vajadustega; • kaasaegne, stiilne ja mõnus töökeskkond; • toetav ja sõbralik meeskond; • võimalus õppida, areneda ja võtta ettevõtte kasvades rohkem vastutust; • reaalsed arenemis- ja karjäärivõimalused kasvavas ettevõttes • sporditoetus (jõusaali kasutamise võimalus); • ühisüritused ja tiimitegevused; • töötajatele mõeldud eripakkumised ja boonused; • väljaõpe ja vajalik juhendamine – varasem kogemus ei pea olema ideaalne; • võimalus olla uue ja kasvava ettevõtte algusest peale selle meeskonna osa. Me hindame oma inimesi ning usume, et hea töö sünnib keskkonnas, kus inimesed tunnevad ennast hästi. Kui Sina annad endast parima, tahame ka meie Sulle vastu anda.

Muud nõuded: • kehtiv toidukäitleja tervisetõend;• hügieenikoolituse läbimine (vajadusel aitame selle korraldamisega); • valmisolek töötada iseseisvalt ja võtta vastutus kioski igapäevase toimimise eest; • hea suhtlemisoskus, kohusetundlikkus ja positiivne hoiak; • valmisolek teha erinevaid tööülesandeid – siin ei ole „see pole minu töö“ suhtumist.

Michael Page est un acteur mondial de référence dans le recrutement spécialisé, mettant en relation les meilleurs talents avec des entreprises leaders dans leurs secteurs. Présent à l'international, le groupe se distingue par une culture d'entreprise ambitieuse, collaborative et centrée sur l'humain, où la performance, l'esprit entrepreneurial et l'évolution professionnelle sont pleinement valorisés.

Jobomschrijving

En tant que Consultant(e) en Recrutement, vous jouez un rôle clé dans le développement de votre activité et l'accompagnement de vos clients et candidats.Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :

  • Piloter l'ensemble du processus de recrutement, de l'identification du besoin jusqu'à la finalisation des embauches.

  • Identifier, approcher et évaluer les meilleurs talents du marché au travers d'entretiens approfondis.
  • Accompagner clients et candidats tout au long du processus afin de garantir une expérience de qualité.
  • Apporter votre expertise du marché, des conseils stratégiques et des recommandations adaptées aux enjeux de recrutement.
  • Négocier les offres d'emploi et faciliter la conclusion des recrutements avec succès.
  • Participer activement à la croissance de l'activité grâce à votre approche commerciale et à votre esprit de développement.

Nous recherchons une personne dynamique, ambitieuse et orientée résultats, souhaitant évoluer dans un environnement stimulant et à forte dimension commerciale.Vous vous reconnaissez dans les critères suivants :

  • Une expérience en vente, développement commercial, relation client ou recrutement constitue un réel atout.
  • Un fort tempérament commercial et une excellente capacité à créer des relations de confiance.
  • Un esprit de conquête, de la résilience et une forte orientation vers l'atteinte des objectifs.
  • D'excellentes compétences en communication, en négociation et en influence.
  • Une maîtrise courante du français et du néerlandais, du français et de l'anglais, ou du néerlandais et de l'anglais.
  • L'envie d'évoluer dans un environnement international, dynamique et axé sur la performance.

jobs.title: VP, Communication
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


VP of Communications, Replit

Replit is changing who gets to build software. As an agentic software creation platform, Replit enables anyone, from individual creators to teams inside the world’s largest companies, to turn natural language into applications, internal tools, dashboards, workflows, websites, and software that solves real problems.

We are looking for a Director or VP of Communications to lead Replit’s next chapter of storytelling, trust building, and market leadership.

This is a senior communications role for a creative, strategic, and hands-on leader who can build and scale the communications function as Replit grows from a beloved developer platform into a defining company in AI, software creation, and enterprise transformation. This person will own Replit’s external and internal communications strategy, including strategic positioning and company narrative, media relations, analyst relations, executive communications, internal communications, crisis communications, customer storytelling, flagship thought leadership, policy-related communications, and global awareness.

The role requires someone who can push through the noise, make the Replit story heard, and keep it part of the conversation. The Director / VP of Communications will develop a compelling narrative that evolves with the company, the product, and the market, and deliver it across media, policymakers, partners, customers, prospects, and employees. The role will also support Replit’s international awareness, with a focus on key markets in Europe and Asia.

This person must be both strategic and execution-oriented. They should have built or helped lead a communications function at a fast-growing technology company, or led communications and positioning for a leading institution. This is not a traditional press office role of adopting another company’s playbook in its entirety.

The person must be creative, scrappy, maybe even spiky: able to take what they know works as a foundation and build on it to make Replit a unique player that punches above its weight in a crowded, competitive marketplace.

Role

 - Lead and scale Replit’s communications function, including communications strategy, team structure, agency management, operating rhythms, and execution standards.

 - Build an AI-native communications function, with agents running repeatable work so a lean team focuses on judgment, relationships, and creative leaps.

 - Develop and evolve Replit’s corporate narrative as the company expands across AI, developer tools, enterprise, consumer, education, and global markets.

 - Own Replit’s strategic positioning: the upstream frameworks and intellectual capital that make every launch, stage, and story land better.

 - Lead communications programs across company announcements, product launches, enterprise momentum, customer stories, partnerships, policy-related issues, executive visibility, awards, events, and thought leadership.

 - Shape how the market understands Replit as an agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language.

 - Build clear, credible narratives around AI-powered software creation, developer productivity, enterprise adoption, security, governance, education, and the future of work.

 - Develop flagship thought leadership, signature reports, and third-party validator relationships that build enterprise and institutional trust.

 - Partner with the CEO, executive team, and functional leaders on positioning, reputation, media strategy, internal communications, and high-stakes company moments.

 - Build and maintain strong relationships with technology, business, AI, enterprise, developer, policy, and international media.

jobs.title: Investment Analyst / Investment Manager - Green Energy & Infrastructure
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by making green commercial investments across Africa, Asia, and Latin America?

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark’s largest impact fund and is internationally recognized as a best-in-class impact investor.  We manage our own private equity funds, debt capital, and concessional capital with a focus on creating sustainable businesses that deliver measurable social, economic and climate impact alongside solid financial returns.

We are strengthening our Green Energy and Infrastructure team and are looking for an Investment Professional to join us in our headquarters in Copenhagen. Depending on your experience, you may join us as Investment Analyst or Investment Manager.

Green Energy and Infrastructure invests in businesses and infrastructure that accelerate the green transition in emerging markets. Our investment focus spans renewable energy, circular economy, electric mobility, and water infrastructure. Through equity and debt investments, active ownership and strategic partnerships, we drive impact and value creation aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals. We typically invest between DKK 100-350 million per transaction.

You will be reporting to a Managing Director in Green Energy and Infrastructure and work closely with colleagues in Copenhagen and our regional offices across Europe, Africa, Asia and Latin America on investments throughout the investment lifecycle.

 

Investment Analyst

As an Investment Analyst, you will be a key analytical resource in transaction teams, focusing on commercial and financial analysis of investment opportunities.

You will:

  • Screen and analyse new investment proposals using Impact Fund Denmark’s tools and processes.

  • Assist in preparing investment papers, financial analyses and financial modelling.

  • Support due diligence, valuation and deal structuring.

  • Contribute to preparing and presenting investment recommendations and materials for the investment committee and board.

  • Collect and analyse commercial and financial data for deal teams.

  • Help maintain information systems for pipeline tracking and portfolio data.

  • Participate in networking activities to support investment sourcing and promotion.

  • Support project managers in active ownership and portfolio monitoring.

  • Ensure timely and accurate updates of systems with project documents, and financial and sustainability reporting.

  • Assist in assessing exit timing and support execution.

 

Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in a relevant field, such as finance or economics with strong academic results.

  • 1-2 years of relevant experience from impact investing, private equity, M&A, corporate finance or consulting.

  • Solid understanding of financial analysis and valuation.

  • Skilled user of Excel and with an interest in and aptitude for financial modelling.

  • Detail-oriented with a structured working approach.

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).

  • Curious to broaden your understanding of the world and keen to travel.

 

Investment Manager

As an Investment Manager, you will take the lead on many of the tasks performed by an Investment Analyst. You are thus expected to work independently, drive workstreams, and take ownership of parts of the investment process.

You will:

  • Screen and analyse new investment proposals using Impact Fund Denmark’s tools and processes.

  • Lead preparation of parts of investment papers, financial analyses and financial modelling with guidance from the project manager (Senior Investment Manager or Investment Director).

  • Support and lead due diligence, valuation and deal structuring workstreams.

  • Contribute to preparing and presenting investment recommendations and materials for the investment committee and board.

  • Lead the analysis of commercial and financial data for deal teams.

  • Take part in negotiating terms and drafting legal documentation.

  • Help maintain information systems for pipeline tracking and portfolio data.

  • Participate in networking activities to support investment sourcing and promotion.

  • Support project managers in active ownership and portfolio monitoring.

  • Assist in assessing exit timing and support exit negotiations and execution.

 

Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in a relevant field such as finance or economics with strong academic results.

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience from impact investing, private equity, M&A, corporate finance or consulting.

  • Independent mindset and experienced in owning and managing workstreams.

  • Solid understanding of financial analysis and valuation.

  • Expert user of Excel and with an interest in and aptitude for financial modelling.

  • Detail-oriented with a structured working approach.

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).

  • Strong interpersonal skills and business judgment.

  • Curious to broaden your understanding of the world and keen to travel.

  • Experience in emerging markets and green energy is an advantage but not a prerequisite.

 

Working at Impact Fund Denmark

Learning is an important element of working in Impact Fund Denmark, and we will support your personal development through training, sparring and by ensuring that you get exciting and challenging tasks and new opportunities for growth. When joining Impact Fund Denmark, you will take part in our extensive onboarding program to get the best possible start in your new role.

We have a diverse and inclusive working environment with more than 170 talented individuals from 30+ different nationalities. We work seamlessly together with colleagues around the corner, across the organisation and between offices in Asia, Africa, Latin America and Europe.

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark (IFU – the Investment Fund for Developing Countries) is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. Capital under management will be growing from EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 5.0 billion over the next few years. Read more at Impact Fund Denmark

jobs.title: Vi søger en sælger/mødebooker – deltid eller fuldtid | Varme leads, fleksibelt skema og meningsfuldt salg
jobs.description:
Vi søger en elevrådgiver til Vinduespudserskolen – deltid eller fuldtid

Kunne du tænke dig at arbejde med mennesker og hjælpe dem med at finde ud af, om de skal tage springet og starte deres egen forretning?

På Vinduespudserskolen hjælper vi personer med at skifte deres nuværende job ud med deres egen vinduespudserforretning. Eleverne lærer håndværket fysisk på skolen i København og modtager grundig undervisning i forretningsudvikling. Tilsammen giver det dem fundamentet til at bygge en succesfuld vinduespudserforretning.

Vi søger nu en ny kollega, der skal tale med de mange personer, som henvender sig til os med interesse for skolen, og hjælpe dem med at finde ud af, om det er det rigtige valg for dem.

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:

  • Tale med potentielle elever, der allerede har vist interesse for Vinduespudserskolen.

  • Sætte dig ind i deres nuværende situation, baggrund, ambitioner og hvad de gerne vil opnå.

  • Rådgive dem om vores undervisningsforløb, og hvad det kræver at starte sin egen vinduespudserforretning.

  • Hjælpe dem med at vurdere, om skolen og livet som selvstændig er det rigtige match for dem.

  • Følge op på interesserede elever via telefon, SMS og e-mail.

  • Hjælpe de rette personer videre med tilmeldingen til skolen.

Du kommer til at tale med mennesker med vidt forskellige baggrunde og livssituationer. Nogle har været lønmodtagere hele livet, andre driver allerede virksomhed, og nogle står måske midt i et større skifte i deres liv.

For mange er det en stor beslutning, både personligt og økonomisk. Derfor handler jobbet ikke om at overtale nogen til at starte, men om at forstå deres situation og rådgive dem ordentligt.

Vi optager heller ikke nødvendigvis alle, der ønsker at starte. Vores elever bliver en del af et fællesskab, hvor vi kommer til at bruge mange timer sammen, både under undervisningen og efterfølgende. Derfor er det vigtigt for os, at vi lærer folk ordentligt at kende, inden de starter.

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med Asger og Malte, som også står for din oplæring. Vi forventer ikke, at du kender noget til vinduespudsning på forhånd, men du skal have lyst til at sætte dig grundigt ind i vores forløb, så du med tiden kan rådgive potentielle elever på egen hånd.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring med rådgivning, salg eller anden form for kundekontakt, eller blot har lyst til at lære det.

  • Kan lide at tale i telefon og gerne tager mange samtaler i løbet af en dag.

  • Er god til at forstå forskellige mennesker og deres situation.

  • Er god til at lytte, stille spørgsmål og give ærlig rådgivning, også når skolen ikke er det rigtige valg for personen.

  • Kan arbejde fysisk fra vores kontor i København.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine egne opgaver.

  • Trives i en virksomhed, der arbejder som en startup med mange selvstændige og engagerede mennesker.

  • Føler dig hjemme i jargonen på en skole med over 500 elever, som nok bedst kan beskrives som ”en masse meget friske fyre”.

Du behøver ikke have mange års erfaring med salg eller rådgivning. Det vigtigste er, at du er god til mennesker, nysgerrig og har lyst til at lære.

Arbejdstid og praktisk information

Vi er åbne for både deltids- og fuldtidsansættelse, men forestiller os især, at stillingen kunne passe godt til en studerende, der gerne vil have et fleksibelt job ved siden af studiet.

Arbejdstiden ligger mellem kl. 9 og 18 på hverdage, og vi er meget fleksible med planlægningen. Det betyder eksempelvis, at du sagtens kan arbejde 10 timer den ene uge og 30 timer den næste, alt efter hvordan det passer med dit studie eller andre forpligtelser.

Arbejdet foregår fysisk på vores kontor på Vestergade i København, hvor du bliver en del af teamet og får en grundig oplæring.

Løn efter kvalifikationer med mulighed for bonusordning.

Er du ikke selv den rette, men kender du en, så anbefal endelig vedkommende. Vi ansætter, så snart vi finder den rigtige, med opstart hurtigst muligt.

Læs mere og ansøg på linket her https://www.vinduespudserskolen.dk/job-key-account-manager

jobs.title: Infirmier(ère)s SIAMU pour les urgences adultes - CDD/CDI - temps-partiel/temps-plein - 2026-114
jobs.description:
Le service des urgences adulte accueille 50.000 patients par an. Il assure des missions PIT & SMUR et est doté d’une hospitalisation provisoire de 8 lits. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec son alter ego pédiatrique, avec le plateau des soins intensifs, ainsi qu’avec le quartier opératoire et le service d’imagerie médical ouverts 24h/24.

Il a pour missions :

  • La prise en charge rapide et précise d'un patient en état critique
  • Evaluer une situation critique (identifier et anticiper)
  • Planifier les soins en fonction de l’état du patient, des imprévus et des urgences

Vos responsabilités au quotidien seront :

1.     La prise en charge rapide et précise d'un patient en état critique.

2.     D’assurer votre expertise sur votre secteur spécifique (triage, simple care, medium care, Siamu…)

3.     L’information au patient sur les soins prodigués, les examens programmés et les traitements instaurés, en vérifiant le niveau d'intégration des informations fournies.

4.     L’apport des soins nécessaires aux patients en service de réanimation ou aux urgences tout en faisant preuve d'écoute et de psychologie

5.     L’application des mesures d'urgence en étant apte à analyser les besoins du patient

6.     L’élaboration de la programmation des soins pour chaque patient en adéquation avec le projet de soins et son évaluation

7.     L’application de toutes les mesures de préventions requises envers les patients afin d'éviter l'apparition d'évènements sentinelles.

Profil recherché :

  • Être en possession d’un Bachelier en soins infirmiers.
  • Une spécialisation en SIAMU est demandée.
  • Une expérience dans un service d’urgence est un avantage.
  • Satisfaire aux conditions légales de bilinguisme : vous avez de bonnes connaissances de la seconde langue nationale ou vous êtes disposé à les acquérir (cours de langues organisés en interne sur le temps de travail, possibilité d’obtenir une prime de bilinguisme SELOR de 150€ bruts sous réserve de la remise du Selor Art. 10)
  • Satisfaire à l’entretien de sélection.

Qualités requises :

  • Vous êtes motivé et dynamique ;
  • Vous êtes flexible ;
  • Vous faites preuve de capacités d’adaptation ;
  • Vous êtes méthodique, rigoureux et organisé ;
  • Vous êtes résistant au stress ;
  • Vous êtes autonome et capable de travailler dans différentes équipes ;
  • Vous êtes capable de prendre des initiatives et gérer vos émotions dans un contexte d’urgence ;
  • Vous faites preuve de capacités relationnelles avec le patient ;
  • Vous faites preuve d’aisance communicationnelle avec le patient, ses proches, les membres de l’équipe pluridisciplinaire et les autres services de l’hôpital
  • Vous faites preuve de discrétion et respectez le secret professionnel.

Le CHU Saint-Pierre est un hôpital public et universitaire de référence, offrant des soins de grande qualité accessibles à tous.

Dans ce cadre, il relève quotidiennement les défis de la santé publique tout en déclinant son caractère universitaire via une implication active dans l’enseignement et la recherche.

Les chiffres clés qui caractérisent l’hôpital sont les suivants :

  • 450.000 consultations/an
  • 45.000 admissions/an
  • 23.000 opérations chirurgicales/an
  • 85.000 passages aux urgences/an
  • 2900 accouchements/an
  • 3200 collaborateurs dont 400 médecins

Le respect, l’innovation, l’engagement, la qualité et la solidarité sont les valeurs clés de l’hôpital. Toutes et tous s’attèlent à placer le patient au centre de leur action. Les réponses aux réalités sociales, la tolérance, le libre-examen et la capacité à se mobiliser au quotidien pour les patients, bruxellois et non-bruxellois, sont les moteurs de ses actions.

La quête de l’excellence en médecine de pointe et l’approche multidisciplinaire, font de l’hôpital une référence sur le plan national.

Le CHU St Pierre travaille également en étroite collaboration avec de nombreux partenaires comme les médecins généralistes, médecins spécialistes référents, les CPAS et les autres institutions d’aides et de soins en Région bruxelloise.

Travailler au CHU Saint-Pierre, c’est à la fois faire partie d’un hôpital ancré dans la Ville depuis plusieurs siècles et d’un réseau hospitalier moderne en développement rapide, CHORUS, plus grand réseau hospitalier en Belgique. Travailler au CHU Saint-Pierre, c’est faire partie d’un groupe soudé, soutenant, au sein duquel chaque personne a sa place, afin d’offrir un service optimal. La satisfaction de nos patients et notre bien-être au travail sont nos priorités.

En outre, vous bénéficiez, ainsi que les personnes qui cohabitent avec vous, des tarifs médicaux préférentiels appliqués dans les hôpitaux du réseau IRIS.

Des avantages extra légaux

  • des réductions chez de nombreux fournisseurs via le système Benefits@work

jobs.title: Verzorgende oproepzorg - regio Kortrijk (deeltijds)
jobs.description:
Familiehulp ondersteunt mensen in hun dagelijks leven, met aandacht voor zorg, welzijn en huishouden. Binnen onze dienstverlening oproepzorg geef je zorg en ondersteuning aan personen met een beperking die zelfstandig wonen. 

Als verzorgende oproepzorg (zorgkundige) geef je samen met je collega's zorg op maat aan personen met een beperking die zelfstandig wonen. Je reageert op oproepen en geeft ondersteuning wanneer bewoners die nodig hebben. Zo help je hen om zo zelfstandig mogelijk te blijven wonen en maak je elke dag het verschil.

Je maakt deel uit van een hecht team dat 24 uur per dag en 7 dagen op 7 klaarstaat voor de bewoners. Samen zorgen jullie voor een permanente dienstverlening, zonder dat iedereen alle shiften hoeft op te nemen.

Je beantwoordt oproepen van bewoners en helpt onder meer bij:

  • Noodoproepen, bijvoorbeeld wanneer een bewoner gevallen is.
  • Dringende hulpvragen, zoals ondersteuning bij een toiletbezoek.
  • Kortere hulpvragen, bijvoorbeeld iets aanreiken of ophalen.
  • Gewone zorgvragen, waarbij je maximaal 60 minuten ondersteuning geeft.

Daarnaast geef je persoonlijke verzorging, ADL-ondersteuning en hulp bij dagelijkse activiteiten, zoals:

  • Persoonlijke verzorging en hygiëne.
  • Hulp bij maaltijden, zoals een maaltijd opwarmen, een broodmaaltijd voorbereiden en ondersteuning tijdens het eten.

  • Kleine dagelijkse handelingen en lichte huishoudelijke taken, zoals opruimen en wassen.

  • Verplaatsingen in en rond de woning, zoals in en uit bed, van en naar het toilet en ondersteuning bij transfers met een tillift.
  • Diploma als zorgkundige / verzorgende of gelijkwaardig (zie www.familiehulp.be/diploma).
  • Je houdt van sociaal contact en communiceert vlot.
  • Betrouwbaarheid en respect voor privacy zijn voor jou vanzelfsprekend.
  • Bereidheid om avond- en weekendwerk.
  • Eigen vervoer (wagen, fiets).

jobs.title: Kelner

jobs.title: Metallurgist
jobs.description:
Job Description

In this hands-on position with the European Customer Analytical Services - Technology Centre of Excellence, you will perform root cause investigations into metallurgical failures and assess corrosion mechanisms. Serving clients throughout Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, you will analyze samples from hydrocarbon process and water treatment operations-such as petroleum refineries, cooling towers, heat exchangers, and boilers. Your expertise in metallurgy and failure analysis will directly drive critical materials and reliability decisions across water and hydrocarbon process systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive metallurgical failure analyses and corrosion mechanism assessments, gathering necessary process information and determining required analytical approaches to determine root causes of failures in industrial water and hydrocarbon process systems

  • Act as the technical go-to for metallurgical evaluations and materials selection, providing consulting support across the organization

  • Operate the Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM-EDXA) and other analytical instrumentation to support metallurgical examinations

  • Execute failure analysis investigations on membrane systems (reverse osmosis, ultra-/nanfiltration membranes, flat sheet and spiral wound, as well as hollow fibre configurations), delivering clear findings and recommendations

  • Collaborate with other laboratory departments (organic analyses, microbiological examinations, etc.) to gather comprehensive analytical data

  • Prepare detailed, professional analytical reports and provide high-level technical input to Technology and Commercial teams

  • Deliver work on schedule in a fast-paced, high-volume environment while maintaining compliance with all EHS policies and procedures

  • Take ownership of customer application and R&D projects on membrane systems, including planning, execution, and reporting

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Science & Engineering, or equivalent professional experience

  • Minimum 3 years of metallurgical laboratory experience, including leading failure analysis investigations (academic and/or industrial/commercial)

  • Strong technical writing and verbal communication skills suitable for all organizational levels

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

  • Strong computer proficiency and comfort working in a high-volume environment

  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects and manage priorities

  • Fluency in English

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of industrial water treatment processes and experience performing failure analyses tied to industrial water or process systems

jobs.title: Collaborateur·trice Maintenance Génération Europe
jobs.description:
Nous recherchons un·e collaborateur·trice maintenance pour assurer la maintenance préventive, les petites réparations et le suivi technique quotidien de deux de nos auberges bruxelloises.

Ton terrain : Génération Europe (Molenbeek) est une auberge de jeunesse dont le batiment est plus ancien mais toujours en mouvement.

Une auberge bruxelloise, des centaines de voyageurs, un lieu qui bouge... et toi au centre, pour faire en sorte que tout fonctionne, tout reste sûr et accueillant.

Ce poste, à temps-plein sur site, te permet de e travailler en lien étroit avec les équipes et d’apporter ta touche à un lieu qui accueille chaque jour des voyageurs du monde entier.

Tes missions

  • Effectuer les réparations et dépannages : électricité, plomberie, serrurerie, mobilier, peinture, etc.

Ton profil

  • Tu es autonome, réactif·ve et soigneux·se, et tu sais t’adapter à différents lieux et contextes

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
About Lemon.io

Lemon.io is a profitable, growing talent marketplace that connects vetted senior engineers with companies that need them. We’ve been in business for 10 years, have 60 people across Ukraine, Europe, Canada, and the US, and process over $16M in annual GMV. We compress the traditional 2–5 week hiring timeline down to 24–48 hours through a curated, pre-vetted supply of developers.

Hiring is still broken. Recruiters spend weeks building candidate pipelines on traditional platforms, burning energy on unqualified leads. We’re building the product that changes that. Giving recruiters qualified, vetted candidates within 24 hours without the grind. This is a pivotal moment: we’re transitioning from a services-driven marketplace to a technology-driven platform. We need an engineering leader who can drive that transformation.

 

The Role

You will own engineering at Lemon.io. You’ll lead a growing team of engineers, make critical architecture and prioritization decisions, and be directly accountable for the speed and quality of what we ship. This is not a management-layer role. You’ll be hands-on, deeply involved in product decisions, and working side by side with the founder.

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the technical roadmap and make sure every engineering effort maps directly to business impact. No features for features’ sake.

  • Lead and grow an engineering team that ships fast, iterates constantly, and treats complexity as a cost.

  • Tackle the hard, multi-layered problem: automated vetting, intelligent matching at scale, demand-side bottlenecks. And figure out where the real leverage is.

  • Make hard prioritization calls. Decide what we build, what we skip, and what we kill.

  • Work directly with the founder and product team to define what success looks like before writing a single line of code.

  • Build the engineering culture: high ownership, high speed, low bureaucracy.

Who You Are:

  • Product-minded, business-first

  • Obsessed with simplicity

  • First principles thinker

  • Fast. Bias toward action

Experience:

  • You’ve led engineering teams (5–30+ people) at a startup or high-growth company.

  • You have hands-on experience with modern stacks and are comfortable with AI/ML tooling.

  • You’ve worked in a distributed, async-first team.

Why Lemon.io:

  • Profitable and growing. No fundraising pressure, real business fundamentals.

  • A pivotal moment: you’re not maintaining an engine, you’re building one. The product roadmap is wide open.

  • Direct access to the founder. No layers. Your decisions ship.

  • A massive, unsolved problem: hiring is still broken. We’re building the product that makes it radically faster for companies to find qualified engineers.

  • A team of 60 people who move fast, care deeply, and have survived the hard years together.

jobs.title: Hulpkok

jobs.title: Leefgroepbegeleider
jobs.description:
Madee is een welzijnsvoorziening binnen GO! scholengroep Fluxus, die aan 153 kinderen met een beperking verblijf, dagbesteding en mobiele begeleiding aanbiedt.

Wil jij een verschil maken in het leven van jongeren?Heb je een warm hart, een stevige pedagogische basis en werk je graag in een hecht team? Vind je het fijn om structuur, veiligheid en vertrouwen te bieden? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Als leefgroepbegeleider krijg je de kans om jongeren van dichtbij te ondersteunen in hun ontwikkeling. Je helpt hen om stap voor stap zelfstandiger te worden, successen te ervaren en hun talenten te ontdekken.

Jouw rol

Als leefgroepbegeleider ben je een belangrijke vertrouwenspersoon voor de jongeren. Je biedt dagelijkse begeleiding, creëert een warme en voorspelbare omgeving en ondersteunt hen bij kleine en grote uitdagingen.

Sommige jongeren kunnen vanuit hun beperking en ondersteuningsnoden gedrag stellen dat extra begeleiding en rust vraagt. Jij weet in zulke momenten kalm te blijven, duidelijkheid te bieden en samen met je collega’s te zorgen voor een veilige omgeving. Uiteraard sta je er nooit alleen voor: je werkt in een ervaren team dat elkaar ondersteunt en expertise deelt.

Geen dag is hetzelfde: je begeleidt dagelijkse routines, organiseert activiteiten, viert successen en helpt jongeren omgaan met moeilijke momenten.

Wie zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken een collega die:

  • Een warme en betrokken houding combineert met duidelijkheid en structuur
  • Rustig en doordacht blijft in situaties die extra aandacht vragen
  • Beschikt over de nodige maturiteit en zelfreflectie
  • Consequent en respectvol communiceert
  • Graag samenwerkt en zich flexibel opstelt
  • Gelooft in de groeikansen van elke jongere

Extra troeven

  • Ervaring in het begeleiden van jongeren met een beperking of gedrags- en emotionele moeilijkheden
  • Kennis van de-escalerende technieken

jobs.title: System Engineer

Als System Engineer sta je mee in voor het beheer, de optimalisatie en de verdere uitbouw van de IT-infrastructuur. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's en externe partners binnen een innovatieve omgeving waar verbetering en vernieuwing centraal staan.

Jouw taken:

• Je staat in voor het beheer, onderhoud en de verdere uitbouw van de server-, netwerk- en cloudomgeving.• Je bewaakt de performantie van systemen en netwerken en zorgt voor een snelle oplossing van technische storingen.• Je installeert, configureert en onderhoudt hardware, software en IT-systemen.• Je biedt ondersteuning aan collega's en zorgt voor een professionele en klantgerichte IT-service.• Je werkt mee aan lokale en internationale IT-projecten en draagt bij aan een succesvolle implementatie.• Je denkt proactief mee over optimalisaties, automatisering en innovatieve oplossingen.• Je helpt bij het uitwerken en realiseren van de IT-strategie voor de komende jaren.• Je houdt technische documentatie en procedures up-to-date.• Je draagt actief bij aan een veilige IT-omgeving en het versterken van de cybersecurity.

 • Je behaalde een bachelor in IT of beschikt over een gelijkwaardige ervaring binnen een gelijkaardige functie.• Zowel ervaren professionals als kandidaten met een eerste relevante werkervaring komen in aanmerking.• Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en kan je goed uitdrukken in het Engels.• Je hebt een sterke interesse in IT-infrastructuur, cloudoplossingen en cybersecurity.• Je bent leergierig, denkt oplossingsgericht en neemt graag initiatief.• Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de ICT Manager..

• Kennis van Windows Server-omgevingen• Ervaring met Microsoft 365 en Azure• Goede kennis van Active Directory• Ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server• Vertrouwd met Microsoft Defender en moderne security-oplossingen• Kennis van virtualisatietechnologieën• Ervaring met Veeam Backup & Replication• Inzicht in netwerkinfrastructuur zoals VLAN's, MPLS, firewalls, routers en switches• Basiskennis of sterke interesse in cybersecurity en security best practices

jobs.title: Service Technieker Waterbehandeling - regio West-Vlaanderen
jobs.description:
JOUW PASSIE

jobs.title: Begeleider in de kinderopvang - Overijse
jobs.description:
Hou jij van werken met jonge kinderen? Wil jij hun talenten zien groeien en ze laten stralen? Vind je contact met ouders ook belangrijk? Dan is dit jouw kans! Word kinderbegeleider in ons nieuw kinderdagverblijf te Overijse en groei mee met ons team. Bij Helan Kinderopvang zorgen we niet alleen voor kinderen, maar ook voor onze medewerkers.

Dit maakt je job zo waardevol:

“Ik voel me helemaal thuis bij Helan Kinderopvang. Het is een organisatie die groeit maar die niet vergeet om zorg te dragen voor z’n medewerkers. Je mag zelf dingen in handen nemen en dat houdt je job boeiend en afwisselend. Tegelijk sta je er nooit alleen voor. Als collega’s zijn we er voor elkaar en ik voel me altijd gewaardeerd als persoon!”

Tom – Kinderbegeleider bij Helan Kinderopvang

Hier zet jij graag je tanden in:

  • Spelen en leren: Je doet leuke activiteiten en gaat vaak naar buiten met de kinderen.
  • Zorg en warmte: Jij geeft knuffels en troost. Eten en slapen maak jij gezellig en rustig.
  • Kijken en helpen: Je kijkt hoe kinderen groeien en past jouw aanpak aan. Zo wordt onze opvang beter.
  • Praten met ouders: Jij geeft info over hun kind en helpt bij een goede start.
  • Samen sterk: Je werkt samen met collega’s en coaches. Jullie helpen elkaar en leren samen.

Kortom: Jij maakt elke dag fijn voor kinderen én ouders. Doe je mee?

Dit ben jij helemaal:

  • Diploma kinderzorg: Kijk of jouw diploma past: kwalificaties-kinderopvang-schema-max18plaatsen.pdf
  • Taalvaardigheid: Je spreekt goed Nederlands en hebt minimaal taalniveau 2.4 behaald.
  • Levensreddend handelen: Je hebt een attest of bent bereid dit op korte termijn te behalen.
  • Onze visie: bekijk de Pedagogische waarden van Helan kinderopvang - Jij voelt de match hierin!
  • Groot hart voor kinderen: Hun groei maakt jou blij!
  • Collegiaal en flexibel : Je springt bij waar nodig, ook in een ander kinderdagverblijf van Helan in jouw regio. Samen staan we sterker.
  • Communicatie: Jij praat open met ouders en collega’s. Jij ziet signalen en durft ze benoemen.

Bij Helan Kinderopvang maken we samen een warme plek voor kinderen. Wij willen jou in ons team! Groei mee en maak verschil. Solliciteer vandaag nog!

jobs.title: Satellit - Senior .NET Developer
jobs.description:
Satellit is seeking an experienced .NET developer with Java know-how to join a multi-disciplinary team delivering digital identity and authentication capabilities for a major energy-sector engagement. The role involves building, validating and documenting reusable authentication/authorization components, contributing to deployment automation, collaborating with IT stakeholders, and participating in agile squad activities. This position follows a hybrid work model with an expectation of being on-site about two days per week and is planned to start in the mid-October to mid-November timeframe. Full-time commitment is required.

Who are you?

Skills & competences:
  • Autonomy
  • Teamwork
  • Presentation skills
  • Communication
  • Continuous learning
  • Technical documentation
  • Analytical problem solving
  • Resilience
  • Versatility and adaptability
  • Continuous integration and deployment practices
  • Agile methodologies and Scrum

What will you do?

  • Design, implement, unit-test and document libraries, services or components that handle user authentication and authorization.
  • Create example applications and code samples to illustrate how to integrate identity and access services into new or existing systems, and communicate these to engineering teams.
  • Customize and extend commercial or open-source products (for example access managers, authorization engines, API gateways, reverse proxies and directory services) and produce supporting documentation for those extensions.
  • Improve and automate continuous integration and continuous delivery workflows, including configuration and release automation.
  • Work closely with IT and application teams to identify integration points, diagnose issues, and resolve problems when connecting to identity Fabric services.
  • Install and configure third-party and open-source components by following technical guides and producing any required deployment notes.
  • Take part in squad sprint activities, including planning, execution and retrospective work.
  • Own assigned backlog items, drive tasks to completion and report progress to the squad.
  • Prepare for and actively participate in meetings and workshops, tracking actions and follow-ups.
  • Propose technical solutions that align with requirements and constraints, present them to stakeholders and refine based on feedback.
  • Continuously acquire new technical knowledge, standards and tooling needed to fulfill assigned work.

Technologies (mandatory)

  • Hash Function
  • cookie
  • SAML/OAuth
  • Keystore
  • MicroServices Architecture
  • Bash
  • TypeScript
  • OAuth 2
  • Security
  • Symmetric Encryption
  • Proxy
  • JSON
  • cors
  • Innovation
  • Scrum
  • Vue.js
  • OpenID
  • Azure AKS
  • asymmetric encryption
  • Java
  • LDAP
  • Collaboration
  • Solution Architect
  • Azure MFA
  • SSO
  • .NET
  • C#
  • IDP Platform
  • PowerShell
  • GIT
  • agile
  • MS Teams
  • product backlog management
  • SAP IDM
  • Continuous Integration
  • Kubernetes
  • Google OIDC
  • SQL Server
  • React Native
  • advanced rest
  • HTTPS
  • SQL
  • DevOps
  • JavaScript
  • YAML
  • Blazor
  • PKI
  • Proven experience with C# and the .NET ecosystem in a production environment.
  • Practical knowledge of Java and familiarity with interoperation between Java and .NET components.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and working with JSON and YAML configurations.
  • Hands-on skills with front-end technologies such as JavaScript and frameworks like Vue.js or Blazor.
  • Understanding of directory services and authentication protocols (LDAP, OAuth2, OpenID Connect).
  • Solid grasp of web security fundamentals including HTTPS, cookies, CORS, single sign-on and multifactor concepts.
  • Familiarity with cryptographic basics including symmetric and asymmetric key usage, hashing and keystore concepts.
  • Experience deploying and operating containerized applications and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes (experience with managed clusters a plus).
  • Comfortable using GIT and participating in DevOps practices for source control and delivery pipelines.
  • Database experience, for instance with SQL Server or similar relational databases.
  • Nice-to-have: TypeScript, PowerShell, Bash scripting, React, SAML2, PKI experience, and familiarity with identity provider solutions (for example Keycloak, Ping, Okta, ADFS, or cloud identity services).
  • Experience designing or operating MicroServices-based systems is an advantage.
  • Strong interpersonal and soft skills: pragmatic problem-solving, autonomy, adaptability, resilience, clear communication, analytical thinking, and the ability to document and present technical work.
  • Language requirements: good command of Dutch and/or French, plus English for technical collaboration.

jobs.title: Maintenance technician in day shift - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

  • Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
  • Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
  • Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
  • Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
  • Supervise external contractors and service providers

You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

  • Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
  • Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
  • Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
  • Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
  • Already living in Belgium, preferably in the greater area of Oostkamp

Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not required, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC...

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Energy Harvesting and EMI Mitigation in High-Voltage Environments - 4391
jobs.description:
The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics at the University of Southern Denmark invites applications for an Assistant Professor position in Energy Harvesting and EMI Mitigation for Drones and Robots in High-Voltage Environments. The position is open from January 1, 2027, and the starting date will be agreed with the successful candidate.

 

Job Content

The Assistant Professor will conduct research within energy harvesting for drones, robotic systems, and IoT applications, with a particular focus on enhancing power density and enabling long-term autonomous operation. The research will further address electromagnetic interference (EMI) mitigation and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) for electronic and robotic systems operating in extreme high-voltage environments, contributing to improved system reliability, safety, and performance in infrastructure inspection and maintenance applications.

The successful candidate is expected to develop and sustain a research agenda aligned with or complementing the section’s activities, establish an internationally recognized research profile, publish in high-impact journals and leading international conference proceedings, and actively contribute to securing external research funding from national and international sources. The role includes collaboration with academic colleagues and industrial partners and participation in national and international research activities.

The position includes planning, teaching, and developing Bachelor’s and Master’s-level courses in relevant areas of electronics and electrical engineering. The successful candidate will supervise Bachelor’s, Master’s, and PhD students, provide academic guidance, and contribute to a supportive and collaborative research and learning environment. The role also includes academic service at section and department levels and participation in relevant professional activities.

 

Required Qualifications

Applicants must hold a PhD degree in Electronics Engineering, Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field.

Applicants must document the following qualifications and experience:

  • A strong research track record in electromagnetic energy harvesting, power conversion, or power management systems.

  • Research experience in electromagnetic interference (EMI) mitigation and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) for operation in extreme high-voltage environments up to 500 kV.

  • Experience in the design, development, and testing of drone systems.

  • Experience in university teaching, course development, and supervision of engineering students, together with pedagogical and subject-specific skills appropriate to the position.

  • A proven ability to attract external research funding as principal investigator or key contributor.

  • A strong publication record in leading international journals and conferences, including publications resulting from international collaborations.

  • Demonstrated experience in international research projects and collaborative activities with academic and industrial partners.

  • Experience serving as reviewer for leading international journals and conferences in relevant research fields.

International research experience gained in an environment other than the institution where the applicant completed their PhD will be considered an advantage.

 

Workplace description

The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics at the University of Southern Denmark conducts research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communications, using advanced reconfigurable computing and sensing technologies. The section develops next-generation electronics and computing solutions to address technological challenges in autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grids, and healthcare.

The section contributes to the electrical engineering programmes in Odense, including Bachelor’s and Master of Science degrees in Electronics Engineering. Over the next few years, the section is expected to expand to at least 30 staff members, including academic staff, PhD students, and engineers, supporting research, industrial collaboration, and education. This growth will strengthen the section’s contribution to electrical engineering and related fields.

SDU’s Odense campus comprises six faculties, providing opportunities for interdisciplinary research and a vibrant student life. Odense offers a culturally rich environment, a growing robotics community, attractive residential areas, and green spaces along the river through the city centre.

Further Information

For further information about the position, please contact Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, Head of the Section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics, at esme@sdu.dk. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application that clearly explains the applicant’s interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages).

  • Curriculum Vitae, including contact information, research experience, relevant projects, technical skills, and teaching and supervision experience.

  • Research plan outlining the proposed research agenda, its alignment with the position and the section’s activities, and plans for developing a research line and research team.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position. 

  • Summary and documentation of teaching qualifications, pedagogical experience, course development, and student supervision. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio. 

  • Names and email addresses of up to three referees who can provide an informed reference at short notice. Reference letters and documentation of other relevant qualifications may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 20, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.
